name: Paracip 500mg Tablet 10'S
introduction:
Introduction About PARACIP 500MG TABLET

PARACIP 500MG TABLET contains Paracetamol which belongs to the group of medicines called Analgesics and Antipyretics. It is used to relieve mild to moderate pain (including headaches, backache, toothache, severe nerve pain, sore throat, period pain, low back and leg pain, muscle, connective tissue and joint pain, symptomatic relief of sprains, strain, joint swelling and stiffness). It is also used to lower fever (high body temperature) and relieve cold or flu symptoms.

Before taking PARACIP 500MG TABLET, inform your doctor if you or your child have liver or kidney problems or any allergies. It should be used with caution in patients with liver problems due to alcohol to manage the risk of liver damage.

PARACIP 500MG TABLET should be used with caution in pregnant women only if clearly advised by the doctor and can be used in breastfeeding women. PARACIP 500MG TABLET is not recommended for use in children less than 10 years of age and should be used with caution in elderly patients.

Consult your doctor if you experience any side effects or unusual effects during management with PARACIP 500MG TABLET.
uses: Relieves mild to moderate pain (such as headache, toothache, joint pain)
Lowers fever and relieves the symptoms of cold or flu
usesDetails:
Uses Of PARACIP 500MG TABLET
Relieves mild to moderate pain (such as headache, toothache, joint pain)
Lowers fever and relieves the symptoms of cold or flu
mechanismOfAction:
How PARACIP 500MG TABLET Works

PARACIP 500MG TABLET relieves pain by increasing the pain threshold by inhibiting certain enzymes (COX-1 and COX-2) involved in the synthesis of chemicals responsible for inducing pain (prostaglandins). It reduces fever by directly acting on heat-regulating centers in the brain, resulting in vessel relaxation, sweating and loss of body heat.
usageDetails:
How to use PARACIP 500MG TABLET

Take PARACIP 500MG TABLET as advised by your physician. It can be taken with or without food.

For Tablet, Capsule: Swallow PARACIP 500MG TABLET with a glass of water. Do not crush or chew the medicine.

For Dispersible Tablet: Disperse the medicine in the specified quantity of water as mentioned on the label. Consume the medicine immediately after reconstitution.

Your doctor will decide the correct dose and duration of therapy for you depending upon your age, body weight and severity of the condition.
sideEffects: Reduced white blood cells (infections are more likely to occur)
Allergic reaction (swelling of the hands, feet, ankles, face, lips or throat which may cause trouble swallowing or breathing, an itchy, lumpy rash or nettle rash, runny nose)
sideEffectsDetails:
Side Effects Of PARACIP 500MG TABLET
Rare
Reduced white blood cells (infections are more likely to occur)

Stop taking PARACIP 500MG TABLET and contact your doctor immediately if you experience any of the following side effects:

Allergic reaction (swelling of the hands, feet, ankles, face, lips or throat which may cause trouble swallowing or breathing, an itchy, lumpy rash or nettle rash, runny nose)

warnings.details: PARACIP 500MG TABLET should be used with caution in pregnant women only if considered clearly necessary. Your doctor may use the lowest possible dose to reduce the pain and fever only for a shorter duration in pregnant women. Consult your doctor before taking PARACIP 500MG TABLET.
PARACIP 500MG TABLET should be used with caution in breastfeeding women. Consult your doctor before taking it.
PARACIP 500MG TABLET has no influence on the ability to drive and operate machinery.
PARACIP 500MG TABLET should be used with caution in patients with chronic alcoholism. Consult your doctor before taking it.
PARACIP 500MG TABLET should be used with caution in patients with severe kidney problems. Consult your doctor before taking it.
PARACIP 500MG TABLET should be used with caution in patients with severe liver problems or liver problems due to alcohol. Consult your doctor before taking it.
Do not take PARACIP 500MG TABLET if you are allergic to Paracetamol or any other ingredients of this medicine.

Others

Before taking PARACIP 500MG TABLET, inform your doctor if you:

Have sepsis (circulation of bacteria and their toxins in the blood leading to organ damage)
Are malnourished

Use in pediatrics:

PARACIP 500MG TABLET is not recommended for use in children less than 10 years of age. It can be used in children and adolescents aged above 10 and your child’s doctor may adjust the dose based on the child’s age and body weight. Consult your child’s doctor for advice.

Use in geriatrics:

PARACIP 500MG TABLET should be used with caution in elderly patients. Consult your doctor before taking it.

interactions:
Interactions

A. Drug - Drug interactions:

Before taking PARACIP 500MG TABLET, inform your doctor if you are taking any of the following medicines:             

Other medicines containing paracetamol
Medicines to manage nausea and vomiting (Ex. metoclopramide, domperidone)
Cholestyramine (used to control blood lipid levels)
Warfarin (used for managing blood clots)
Medicines used to manage bacterial infections (Ex. rifampicin, flucloxacillin, chloramphenicol)

Overdosage:

If you or anyone else accidentally takes too much of PARACIP 500MG TABLET, consult your doctor immediately or visit the nearby hospital, even if you feel well, as it can cause delayed, serious liver damage.

introduction:
Introduction About MEDOMOL 500MG TABLET

Medomol Tablet belongs to antipyretic and analgesic (pain killers) medicine which is used to relieve mild to moderate pain (such as headache, toothache, back and menstrual pain) and fever. It contains paracetamol as an active ingredient which is used to manage a wide range of painful conditions and fever.   

Paracetamol acts as an antipyretic as well as painkiller. It works by inhibiting the production of a chemical called prostaglandins in the body, which are responsible for causing pain and swelling in the body. As a result, it reduces various pain. It also has a direct action on heat regulating centres in the brain, leading to peripheral vasodilation, sweating and loss of body temperature. Thus, it reduces fever.  

Always take Medomol Tablet as advised by the physician. Swallow the medicine as a whole with a glass of water and do not crush or chew the medicine. Do not exceed the recommended daily dosage. Before taking this medicine inform your doctor if you are pregnant or breast-feeding women and if you are suffering from any medical condition to manage the risk of any unusual effects.

introduction:
Introduction About COMBIFLAM TABLET

Combiflam Tablet is commonly chosen for short-term relief from everyday pain and fever. It is often used by people experiencing discomfort due to headache, body ache, toothache, muscle soreness, joint pain, or fever linked to routine conditions. Its dual-action formula combines ibuprofen and paracetamol, offering supportive relief when quick comfort is needed during busy routines or sudden aches.  

The tablet works by helping ease pain signals and lowering raised body temperature. It is ideally used by adults and older children who need convenient and fast relief from mild to moderate discomfort. It suits individuals looking for short-duration support without requiring stronger medicines. However, it should be taken only when needed and not for long-term or chronic pain unless advised by a healthcare professional.   

Combiflam is best taken after food or with a light snack to reduce the chances of acidity or stomach discomfort. Follow the recommended dose and maintain the advised gap between doses. Avoid combining it with other pain relievers or products that contain ibuprofen or paracetamol, as this may unintentionally increase the total dose. People with stomach ulcers, kidney or liver concerns, asthma, or heart-related issues should use it only after medical guidance. Inform your doctor if you are taking blood thinners, diuretics, or multiple medications. 

During pregnancy, especially in later stages, the tablet may not be suitable due to the ibuprofen component and should be used only after medical advice. Breastfeeding mothers should also consult a healthcare provider before taking it. Common side effects may include mild stomach discomfort, nausea, dizziness, headache, or skin reactions in sensitive individuals. If symptoms persist, worsen, or if you notice unusual reactions, seek prompt medical attention.

mechanismOfAction:
How COMBIFLAM TABLET Works
Mechanism of Action of Combiflam Tablet

Combiflam Tablet works through a dual-action formula containing Ibuprofen and Paracetamol, which complement each other to provide effective relief from pain and fever.

Ibuprofen is a non-steroidal anti-inflammatory agent (NSAID). It works by blocking the formation of prostaglandins, the natural chemicals in the body that cause pain, swelling, and inflammation. By reducing these chemicals, ibuprofen helps ease body aches, joint discomfort and headache.

Paracetamol, on the other hand, acts mainly in the brain. It helps reduce fever by acting on the body’s temperature-regulating centre and provides analgesic comfort by lowering the signals that carry pain sensations.
usageInstructions: Take the tablet after food or with a light snack to avoid stomach discomfort caused by ibuprofen.
Swallow the tablet whole with a glass of water; do not crush or chew it.
Use the tablet only when needed for pain or fever and avoid frequent or long-term use without advice.
Follow the dose and interval recommended by your doctor or as written on the product label.
Maintain a minimum gap of 6–8 hours between doses to avoid excess intake of ibuprofen or paracetamol.
Avoid taking it along with other medicines containing paracetamol, ibuprofen, aspirin, or similar pain relievers.
Do not exceed the maximum daily limit of paracetamol from all sources (including cold or flu medicines).
If your pain or fever continues after recommended doses, seek medical guidance rather than increasing the dose.

introduction:
Introduction About ACECLO PLUS TABLET

ACECLO PLUS TABLET is used for pain management associated with osteoarthritis, rheumatoid arthritis and ankylosing spondylitis. It can also be used to reduce pain caused due to sprains, strains, sports injuries, tendon pain, bone fracture pain and minor surgical and other pains. It is a combination of Aceclofenac + Paracetamol which are pain relieving agents.

Take ACECLO PLUS TABLET after food to avoid gastric irritation. Do not take this medicine more than the duration recommended by your doctor. Before taking this medicine inform your doctor if you are having any liver, kidney or heart problems. You must also inform your doctor if you have stomach ulcers, gut inflammation, inflammatory bowel diseases or chronic alcoholism, or if you are pregnant or breastfeeding as a precaution.

The most common side effects of taking ACECLO PLUS TABLET are indigestion, stomach pain, bloating and headache which can be managed by taking this medicine with meals and by following simple diet with less spicy food and limiting alcohol consumption.

name: Dolopar Tablet 15'S
introduction:
Introduction About DOLOPAR TABLET

Dolopar Tablet is an analgesic and antipyretic medicine which is used to manage body pain and fever. It contains paracetamol and caffeine as active ingredients which inhibit the pain-causing mechanism and regulate body temperature.

Paracetamol helps to relieve pain by reducing the production of prostaglandins (pain-producing agents) and elevates the pain threshold. It reduces fever by acting on a specific area of the brain that regulates our body temperature called the hypothalamic heat-regulating centre. Caffeine acts as an adjuvant action in the inhibition of pain signals.

Take Dolopar Tablet as advised by your doctor. Take the tablet with a glass of water and do not crush or chew it. Do not exceed the stated recommended daily dosage. It should be used with caution in patients having liver or kidney diseases. Along with the management, follow a well-balanced diet regime.
sideEffectsDetails:
Side Effects Of DOLOPAR TABLET

Dolopar Tablet may cause nausea, headache, vomiting, nervousness, or insomnia. Consult with your doctor if you experience any such side effects while taking it.

It is also used to lower fever (high body temperature) and relieve the symptoms of the cold or flu. It contains paracetamol, which is an analgesic and antipyretic that helps reduce pain and fever.

introduction:
Introduction About NEOMOL 250MG SUPPOSITORY

NEOMOL 250MG SUPPOSITORY contains Paracetamol which belongs to the group of medicines called Analgesics and Antipyretics. It is used to manage pain and fever (high temperature) in children (from 3 months to 12 years of age) who finds it difficult to take the medicine orally.                                 

Before administering NEOMOL 250MG SUPPOSITORY to your child, inform child’s doctor if your child has liver or kidney problems or any allergies. Do not give your child medicines containing alcohol. Consult your child’s doctor for advice.

Introduction About DOLO 650MG TABLET

Dolo 650 Tablet contains 650 mg of paracetamol (also known as acetaminophen), a trusted active ingredient widely recognized for effectively providing relief from mild to moderate pain and helping to reduce elevated body temperature safely. It is suitable for adults and children above 12 years under medical guidance. Dolo 650 Tablet works by blocking the release of specific chemical messengers in the brain responsible for sensations of pain and fever, making it a reliable choice to ease discomfort from headaches, migraines, toothaches, sore throats, menstrual pains, arthritis-related aches, muscle soreness, and symptoms associated with the common cold.

Dolo 650 Tablet has been widely used, especially during the COVID-19 pandemic, as a trusted paracetamol based medication to help provide relief from pain and fever. It is important to take Dolo 650 Tablet regularly as per the doctor’s instructions, ideally with food to minimize the risk of stomach upset. This medication can be taken alone or alongside other prescribed managements. However, it is crucial not to consume more than four doses within 24 hours, ensuring a minimum gap of at least four hours between consecutive doses. Prolonged use beyond the recommended duration should be avoided to maintain safety and effectiveness.

Generally, Dolo 650 Tablet is well tolerated, with side effects being uncommon. however, some individuals may experience temporary stomach pain, nausea, or vomiting. If any of these effects persist or become bothersome, it is important to consult a healthcare professional for advice.

Dolo 650 Tablet is generally considered safe but may not be suitable for everyone. Before starting this medicine, inform your doctor if you have any liver or kidney conditions, allergies to the medication, or are taking other drugs, as these factors may influence the appropriate dose or suitability. It is advisable to use the lowest effective dose for the shortest recommended duration. This medication is commonly preferred as a pain relief option during pregnancy and breastfeeding, subject to medical guidance.

mechanismOfAction:
How DOLO 650MG TABLET Works
How Dolo 650 Tablet Works in the Body

Dolo 650 Tablet contains paracetamol, which acts centrally in the brain to provide relief by blocking the release of chemicals involved in signaling pain and regulating body temperature, leading to effective management of discomfort and fever.

Understanding Paracetamol’s Mechanism of Action

Paracetamol works primarily by inhibiting the production of prostaglandins in the brain, which are responsible for transmitting pain and triggering fever responses, thereby helping to reduce pain sensations and lower elevated temperatures safely.

Role of Prostaglandins in Pain and Fever

Prostaglandins are chemical messengers released at sites of injury or infection that promote inflammation, pain, and fever. By reducing prostaglandin production, Dolo 650 Tablet helps moderate these symptoms, aiding in symptom relief.

How Dolo 650 Helps Manage Pain and Temperature

Dolo 650 helps control pain by interrupting pain signal pathways in the central nervous system and supports temperature regulation through its action on the hypothalamic heat-regulating center, promoting fever reduction and patient comfort.

Central Nervous System Effects of Paracetamol

Paracetamol influences the central nervous system by blocking pain signals and modulating neurotransmitters involved in pain perception and temperature control, resulting in analgesic and antipyretic effects without significant anti-inflammatory activity.

What Happens After Taking Dolo 650?

After ingestion, Dolo 650 is absorbed and begins to act within 30 to 60 minutes, providing relief from pain and fever that typically lasts 4 to 6 hours, allowing patients to regain comfort and resume daily activities effectively.

More Information
01. Why Do Doctors Recommend Dolo 650 Instead of Other Pain Relief Tablets?

Doctors recommend Dolo 650 over other pain relief tablets for several key reasons, making it a popular and trusted choice for managing pain and fever effectively. Here’s why Dolo 650 is often preferred, 

01.Effective Pain and Fever Relief
Dolo 650 contains paracetamol, which acts by blocking chemical messengers in the brain responsible for pain and fever. It provides rapid relief from mild to moderate pain such as headaches, menstrual cramps, toothaches, muscle aches, and reduces elevated body temperature efficiently.

02.Gentle on the Stomach
Unlike many nonsteroidal anti-inflammatory drugs (NSAIDs), Dolo 650 is gentle on the gastrointestinal tract and less likely to cause stomach irritation, ulcers, or bleeding when taken as directed. This makes it safer for people with sensitive stomachs.

03.Wide Safety Margin
Dolo 650 has a well-established safety profile when taken within recommended doses. It does not have addictive properties or cause dependency, making it a reliable option for repeated use under medical supervision.

04.Suitable for Various Conditions
It is versatile, suitable for managing pain due to a variety of causes including cold and flu symptoms, arthritis-related discomfort, and post-immunization soreness. Its dual action on pain and fever makes it a convenient all-rounder medicine.

05.Fast Onset of Action
The tablet starts working within 30 to 60 minutes, providing relatively quick relief, with effects lasting for 4 to 6 hours. This quick action increases patient comfort and satisfaction.

06.Availability and Affordability
Dolo 650 is widely available and affordable, making it an accessible choice for diverse populations, including during high-demand periods like flu seasons or pandemics.

07.Non-NSAID Classification
Being non-NSAID, it avoids common NSAID-related side effects such as cardiovascular risks and bleeding, offering a safer option for people with contraindications to NSAIDs.

Doctors recommend Dolo 650 for its effective, quick pain relief and fever reduction, favourable safety profile, gastrointestinal tolerance, versatility across conditions, and accessibility, making it a trusted first-line option in pain and fever management.

02. What Are the Best Lifestyle and Diet Tips to Follow While Taking Dolo 650 Tablet?

Lifestyle & Diet Tips

	

Description




Take with Food or Milk

	

Taking Dolo 650 with food or milk helps reduce stomach upset and irritation.




Avoid Alcohol Consumption

	

Alcohol increases risk of liver damage when combined with Dolo 650.




Follow Prescribed Dosage

	

Do not exceed 4 tablets in 24 hours; maintain at least 4 hours gap between doses.




Avoid Fatty and Greasy Foods

	

Limit consumption of fatty, greasy foods as they may delay paracetamol absorption.




Stay Hydrated

	

Take the tablet with a full glass of water for better absorption and comfort.




Avoid Indigestion Remedies Around Intake

	

Do not take antacids within two hours of Dolo 650 to reduce interaction.




Consult Doctor for Long-term Use

	

If used for prolonged periods, monitor liver and kidney functions regularly under medical advice.




Balanced Diet

	

Maintain a balanced diet avoiding foods that cause gastric distress like cabbage, broccoli, etc.




Do Not Overdose or Double Dose

	

In case of a missed dose, take as soon as remembered but never double up doses.




Rest and Moderate Physical Activity

	

Ensure adequate rest and avoid strenuous activity during fever or pain relief with Dolo 650.

PARACIP 500MG TABLET contains Paracetamol which belongs to the group of medicines called Analgesics and Antipyretics. introduction:
Introduction About DICLOTAL SP TABLET

DICLOTAL SP TABLET is a combination of Diclofenac, Paracetamol and Serratiopeptidase which belongs to the group of medicines called Nonsteroidal Anti-inflammatory Drugs (NSAID),  Analgesics and Anti-pyrectics. It is used to relieve symptoms such as fever, pain and inflammation associated with musculoskeletal and joint disorders.

DICLOTAL SP TABLET is not recommended for use in patients with asthma (aspirin sensitive asthma), urticaria or acute rhinitis precipitated by aspirin or other NSAIDs, severe liver disease or kidney disease, severe congestive heart failure, ischemic heart disease (heart attack), blockages of blood vessels to the heart and in patients with history or active peptic ulcer, bleeding (blood in stools, vomiting blood) or perforation or active gastrointestinal bleeding.

DICLOTAL SP TABLET should be used with caution in patients with pre-existing asthma, seasonal allergic rhinitis, nasal polyps, chronic obstructive pulmonary disease or chronic infections of the respiratory tract, mild to moderate congestive heart failure and high blood pressure.

DICLOTAL SP TABLET is not recommended for use in children. It should be used with caution in elderly patients (aged 65 years or above). Consult your doctor before taking DICLOTAL SP TABLET.

The most common side effects of taking DICLOTAL SP TABLET are nausea, vomiting, stomach pain, diarrhoea, indigestion, flatulence and gastritis. Consult your physician if any of the side effects worsen during or after management with DICLOTAL SP TABLET.

Uses Of DICLOTAL SP TABLET
Relieves symptoms such as fever, pain and inflammation associated with musculoskeletal and joint disorders
mechanismOfAction:
How DICLOTAL SP TABLET Works

DICLOTAL SP TABLET helps to manage pain, where Diclofenac inhibits COX-1 and COX-2 and blocks the production of prostaglandins (which are responsible for pain), while paracetamol works by decreasing fever by acting on the hypothalamus (heat-regulation centre in the brain) produces peripheral vasodilation, resulting in increased blood flow through the skin, sweating and heat loss. It also increases the pain threshold by inhibiting COX-1 and COX-2 enzymes and serratiopeptidase is an anti-inflammatory agent which reduces inflammation and swelling in the affected area. It also breaks abnormal proteins at the site of inflammation and promotes healing. Together, relieves fever and pain effectively.

Take DICLOTAL SP TABLET as advised by your physician. Swallow DICLOTAL SP TABLET with a glass of water. Do not crush or chew the medicine. Your doctor will decide the correct dose and duration of DICLOTAL SP TABLET for you depending upon your age, body weight and disease condition.

DICLOTAL SP TABLET is not recommended for use in patients with severe liver disease. It should be used with caution in patients with impaired liver function. Consult your doctor before taking DICLOTAL SP TABLET.

Consult your doctor before taking DICLOTAL SP TABLET.

DICLOTAL SP TABLET is not recommended for use in patients with severe congestive heart failure, ischemic heart disease (heart attack), blockages of blood vessels to the heart and in the setting of coronary artery bypass graft surgery (CABG). Urticaria due to acetylsalicylic acid or other NSAIDs
Peripheral arterial disease (problems with blood circulation)
Inflammation of the intestines such as ulcerative colitis or Crohn’s disease
Cerebrovascular disease (stroke) such as stroke, mini-stroke (TIA) or blockages of blood vessels to the brain
Dehydration problems

Mixed connective tissue disorders
Have aseptic meningitis
Blood clotting disorders or haematological abnormalities
Allergic to other substances such as skin reactions, pruritus or urticaria
Hyperlipidaemia
Diabetes mellitus
Smoking habit

DICLOTAL SP TABLET is not recommended for use in children. Consult your child’s doctor for advice.

DICLOTAL SP TABLET should be used with caution in elderly patients (aged 65 years or above). Consult your doctor before taking DICLOTAL SP TABLET.

Interactions

A. Drug-Drug interactions:

Before taking DICLOTAL SP TABLET, inform your doctor if you are taking any of the following medicines:

Aspirin or ibuprofen (medicines used to manage pain)
Corticosteroids such as (used to manage inflammation)
Methotrexate, imatinib (used to manage cancer)
Cyclosporine, tacrolimus (medicines used to manage rejection of transplanted organ)
Lithium (medicines used to manage mania)
Enalapril, furosemide, propranolol (medicines used for high blood pressure and heart diseases)
Mifepristone (medicines used for abortion)
Ciprofloxacin, trimethoprim, chloramphenicol (medicines used for bacterial infections)
Metoclopramide and domperidone (medicines used for nausea and vomiting)
Colestipol and cholestyramine (medicines used to decrease high cholesterol levels)
Zidovudine (medicines used for HIV infection)
Anti-platelet agents Ex. aspirin (medicines used to manage platelet aggregation)
Selective serotonin reuptake inhibitors (SSRIs) Ex.  fluoxetine, sertraline (medicines used to manage depression)
Antidiabetics such as (medicines used to manage diabetes mellitus)
Ketoconazole, fluconazole, miconazole and voriconazole (medicines used to manage fungal infections)
Digoxin (medicines used for heart failure)
Phenytoin (medicines used to manage fits)
Potassium-sparing drugs Ex. spironolactone (medicines used to manage high blood pressure)
Magnesium-containing antacids (medicines used to manage heartburn)
Sulfinpyrazone (used to manage gout)
Amiodarone (medicines used to manage heart rhythm disorders)
Warfarin (medicines used to manage or to manage blood clots)

Overdosage:

If you or anyone else accidentally take too much of DICLOTAL SP TABLET, consult your doctor immediately or visit the nearby hospital. Overdosage symptoms of DICLOTAL SP TABLET includes headache, nausea, vomiting, diarrhoea, epigastric pain, gastrointestinal bleeding, dizziness, disorientation, excitation, coma, drowsiness, tinnitus, fainting, occasionally convulsions, acute kidney failure and liver damage.

ENZOFLAM TABLET is not recommended for use in patients with severe liver disease. It should be used with caution in patients with impaired liver function. Consult your doctor before taking ENZOFLAM TABLET.
Do not take ENZOFLAM TABLET if you are either allergic to diclofenac, paracetamol, serratiopeptidase, acetylsalicylic acid, misoprostol or other NSAIDs such as ibuprofen, naproxen.

Consult your doctor before taking ENZOFLAM TABLET.

ENZOFLAM TABLET should be used with caution in elderly patients (aged 65 years or above). Consult your doctor before taking ENZOFLAM TABLET.

Active peptic ulcer, bleeding (blood in stools, vomiting blood) or perforation or active bleeding such as gastro-intestinal bleeding or cerebrovascular bleeding
Urticaria due to acetylsalicylic acid or other NSAIDs
Peripheral arterial disease (problems with blood circulation)
Inflammation of the intestines such as ulcerative colitis or Crohn’s disease
Cerebrovascular disease (stroke) such as stroke, mini-stroke (TIA) or blockages of blood vessels to the brain
Dehydration problems

Low body weight
Systemic lupus erythematosus (SLE)
Mixed connective tissue disorders
Have aseptic meningitis
Blood clotting disorders or haematological abnormalities
Allergic to other substances such as skin reactions, pruritus or urticaria
Hyperlipidaemia
Diabetes mellitus
Smoking habit

introduction:
Introduction About SARIDON NEW TABLET

New Saridon Tablet is used to manage mild to moderate headache. It contains paracetamol and caffeine as active ingredients that helps to provide relief from headache.

Paracetamol blocks the release of certain chemical substances in the brain called prostaglandins which are responsible for pain whereas caffeine blocks adenosine receptors that influences pain signalling.

Always take New Saridon Tablet exactly as advised by your doctor. Swallow the medicine as a whole with a glass of water and do not crush or chew the medicine. Recommended dosage is one tablet every 4-6 hours, with a minimum gap of 4 hours. Do not exceed the recommended daily dosage. Do not take this medicine if you are allergic to any of its components.

Introduction About VASFREE 100MG CAPSULE

VASFREE 100MG CAPSULE contains Flupirtine which belongs to a group of medicines called Nonopioid, Non-NSAID analgesics. It is used in the management of acute and chronic pain (such as primary headache, tumor pain, menstrual cramps, pain after traumatologic/orthopaedic operations and injuries and painful increased muscle tone of the posture and motor muscles).  

VASFREE 100MG CAPSULE is not recommended for use in patients with liver problems. Before taking VASFREE 100MG CAPSULE, inform your doctor if you have kidney disease, myasthenia gravis, had or have a history of tinnitus (ringing in the ears) or if you are allergic to Flupirtine. VASFREE 100MG CAPSULE is not recommended for use in pregnant and breast-feeding women unless clearly advised by the doctor.

VASFREE 100MG CAPSULE is not recommended for use in children and adolescents (below 18 years of age) unless deemed necessary and it should be used with caution in elderly patients, especially in patients with kidney problems. The most common side effects of taking VASFREE 100MG CAPSULE are fatigue, dizziness, heartburn, nausea, vomiting, dry mouth, constipation and diarrhea. Consult your doctor if any of the side effects worsen.

name: ARISTOMOL 500 Tablet 15's
introduction:
Introduction About ARISTOMOL 500 TABLET

Aristomol Tablet belongs to antipyretic and analgesic (pain killers) medicine which is used to relieve mild to moderate pain (such as headache, toothache, back and menstrual pain) and reduces fever. It contains paracetamol as an active ingredient which is used to manage a wide range of painful conditions and fever.

Paracetamol acts as an antipyretic as well as painkiller. It works by inhibiting the production of a chemical called prostaglandins in the body, which are responsible for causing pain and swelling in the body. As a result, it reduces various pain. It also has a direct action on heat regulating centres in the brain, leading to peripheral vasodilation, sweating and loss of body temperature. Thus, it reduces fever.

Always take Aristomol Tablet as advised by the physician. Swallow the medicine as a whole with a glass of water and do not crush or chew the medicine. Do not exceed the recommended daily dosage.

faqs.question: Q: What is LUPIRTIN CAPSULE used for?
faqs.answer: A: LUPIRTIN CAPSULE is used in the management of acute and chronic pain (such as primary headache, tumor pain, menstrual cramps, pain after traumatologic/orthopaedic operations and injuries and painful increased muscle tone of the posture and motor muscles).

faqs.question: Q: What common side effects are seen with LUPIRTIN CAPSULE?
faqs.answer: A: The most common side effects of taking [GBNKEYWORD are fatigue, dizziness, heartburn, nausea, vomiting, dry mouth, diarrhoea, constipation, diarrhea, stomach upset, bloating and pain, loss of appetite, tremor, headache, increased sweating, sleep problems and restlessness. Consult your doctor if any of the side effects worsen.

faqs.question: Q: How does LUPIRTIN CAPSULE work?
faqs.answer: A: LUPIRTIN CAPSULE works by managing the transmission of pain signals by blocking neuronal excitability and reducing the calcium influx into the cells that is responsible for the sense of pain and inflammation produced at the site of injury and damage, and hence it is useful in providing relief from pain, including that is associated with muscle tension.

faqs.question: Q: Can LUPIRTIN CAPSULE be used in pregnant women?
faqs.answer: A: LUPIRTIN CAPSULE is not recommended for use in pregnant women unless clearly advised by the doctor. Consult your doctor before taking LUPIRTIN CAPSULE if you are pregnant or planning to get pregnant.

faqs.question: Q: Is LUPIRTIN CAPSULE safe to use in patients with kidney diseases?
faqs.answer: A: LUPIRTIN CAPSULE should be used with caution in patients with kidney diseases. Your doctor may regularly monitor your kidney function before and during management with LUPIRTIN CAPSULE to manage the risk of kidney damage. Consult your doctor for advice before taking LUPIRTIN CAPSULE.

Introduction About P 250 TABLET

P 250 TABLET contains Paracetamol which belongs to the group of medicines called Analgesics and Antipyretics. It is used to relieve mild to moderate pain (including headaches, backache, toothache, severe nerve pain, sore throat, period pain, low back and leg pain, muscle, connective tissue and joint pain, symptomatic relief of sprains, strain, joint swelling and stiffness). It is also used to lower fever (high body temperature) and relieve cold or flu symptoms.

Before taking P 250 TABLET, inform your doctor if you or your child have liver or kidney problems or any allergies. It should be used with caution in patients with liver problems due to alcohol to manage the risk of liver damage.

P 250 TABLET should be used with caution in pregnant women only if clearly advised by the doctor and can be used in breastfeeding women. P 250 TABLET is not recommended for use in children less than 10 years of age and should be used with caution in elderly patients.

Consult your doctor if you experience any side effects or unusual effects during management with P 250 TABLET.

mechanismOfAction:
How P 250 TABLET Works

P 250 TABLET relieves pain by increasing the pain threshold by inhibiting certain enzymes (COX-1 and COX-2) involved in the synthesis of chemicals responsible for inducing pain (prostaglandins). It reduces fever by directly acting on heat-regulating centers in the brain, resulting in vessel relaxation, sweating and loss of body heat.
usageDetails:
How to use P 250 TABLET

Take P 250 TABLET as advised by your physician. It can be taken with or without food.

For Tablet, Capsule: Swallow P 250 TABLET with a glass of water. Do not crush or chew the medicine.

For Dispersible Tablet: Disperse the medicine in the specified quantity of water as mentioned on the label. Consume the medicine immediately after reconstitution.

Your doctor will decide the correct dose and duration of therapy for you depending upon your age, body weight and severity of the condition.

introduction:
Introduction About LUPIRTIN P TABLET

LUPIRTIN P TABLET is a combination of Flupirtine and Paracetamol which belongs to the group of medicines called Non opioid analgesic and Analgesic & Antipyretic agents respectively. It is indicated in post-surgical pain, dental pain, pain associated with muscle spasm, cancer pain, neuropathic pain, low back pain and migraine.

Avoid consumption of alcohol while taking LUPIRTIN P TABLET as it increases the risk of liver damage.

LUPIRTIN P TABLET is not recommended for use in patients with liver or kidney diseases. Contact your doctor before taking.

LUPIRTIN P TABLET is not recommended for use in pregnancy as safety is not established unless clearly necessary. Contact your doctor before taking.

LUPIRTIN P TABLET is not recommended for use in breastfeeding women as it may pass through the breast milk. Contact your doctor before taking.

LUPIRTIN P TABLET is not recommended for use in children and adolescents under 18 years of age. Contact your doctor before taking.

LUPIRTIN P TABLET is not recommended for use in elderly patients aged 65 years or above. Contact your doctor before taking.

The most common side effects of this medicine are nausea, vomiting, abdominal discomfort, diarrhoea, constipation, heartburn, flatulence, dry mouth, headache, drowsiness, dizziness, fatigue, disorientation or shaking (tremors), hallucinations. Contact your physician if any of the above side effects worsen.

Introduction About LEEMOL 500 TABLET

LEEMOL 500 TABLET contains Paracetamol which belongs to the group of medicines called Analgesics and Antipyretics. It is used to relieve mild to moderate pain (including headaches, backache, toothache, severe nerve pain, sore throat, period pain, low back and leg pain, muscle, connective tissue and joint pain, symptomatic relief of sprains, strain, joint swelling and stiffness). It is also used to lower fever (high body temperature) and relieve cold or flu symptoms.

Before taking LEEMOL 500 TABLET, inform your doctor if you or your child have liver or kidney problems or any allergies. It should be used with caution in patients with liver problems due to alcohol to manage the risk of liver damage.

LEEMOL 500 TABLET should be used with caution in pregnant women only if clearly advised by the doctor and can be used in breastfeeding women. LEEMOL 500 TABLET is not recommended for use in children less than 10 years of age and should be used with caution in elderly patients.

Consult your doctor if you experience any side effects or unusual effects during management with LEEMOL 500 TABLET.

mechanismOfAction:
How LEEMOL 500 TABLET Works

LEEMOL 500 TABLET relieves pain by increasing the pain threshold by inhibiting certain enzymes (COX-1 and COX-2) involved in the synthesis of chemicals responsible for inducing pain (prostaglandins). It reduces fever by directly acting on heat-regulating centers in the brain, resulting in vessel relaxation, sweating and loss of body heat.

How to use LEEMOL 500 TABLET

Take LEEMOL 500 TABLET as advised by your physician. It can be taken with or without food.

For Tablet, Capsule: Swallow LEEMOL 500 TABLET with a glass of water. Do not crush or chew the medicine.

For Dispersible Tablet: Disperse the medicine in the specified quantity of water as mentioned on the label. Consume the medicine immediately after reconstitution.

Your doctor will decide the correct dose and duration of therapy for you depending upon your age, body weight and severity of the condition.

name: Pacimol Drops 15ml
introduction:
Introduction About PACIMOL DROPS

Pacimol Drops is an analgesic and antipyretic medicine which is used in the management of mild to moderate pain and management of fever. It contains paracetamol as active ingredient.

Paracetamol help relieves pain by reducing the production of prostaglandins (chemicals which are responsible for pain and inflammation) in brain. It reduces fever by acting on a specific area of the brain called hypothalamus, that regulates the body temperature.

Administer Pacimol Drops as advised by your doctor. Shake the bottle well before using it. Administer every 4 to 6 hours or as directed by the physician. Do not give more than 5 doses in 24 hours or do not repeat doses more frequently than 4 hourly as it may cause liver damage or allergic reactions.

introduction:
Introduction About LUPIRTIN SR TABLET

LUPIRTIN SR TABLET contains Flupirtine which belongs to a group of medicines called Nonopioid, Non-NSAID analgesics. It is used in the management of acute and chronic pain (such as primary headache, tumor pain, menstrual cramps, pain after traumatologic/orthopaedic operations and injuries and painful increased muscle tone of the posture and motor muscles).  

LUPIRTIN SR TABLET is not recommended for use in patients with liver problems. Before taking LUPIRTIN SR TABLET, inform your doctor if you have kidney disease, myasthenia gravis, had or have a history of tinnitus (ringing in the ears) or if you are allergic to Flupirtine. LUPIRTIN SR TABLET is not recommended for use in pregnant and breast-feeding women unless clearly advised by the doctor.

LUPIRTIN SR TABLET is not recommended for use in children and adolescents (below 18 years of age) unless deemed necessary and it should be used with caution in elderly patients, especially in patients with kidney problems. The most common side effects of taking LUPIRTIN SR TABLET are fatigue, dizziness, heartburn, nausea, vomiting, dry mouth, constipation and diarrhea. Consult your doctor if any of the side effects worsen.

Introduction About PARACIP

Paracip Syrup is an Anti-pyretic and Analgesic syrup that is used to relieve pain, fever, and other symptoms. It is used to manage mild to moderate pain due to the common cold, influenza, backache, headache, earache, muscle pain, sore throat, teething, and toothache.

It is also used to reduce fever, including post-vaccination fever. Paracip Syrup contains Paracetamol as an active ingredient which reduces pain by elevation of the pain threshold.

Always give Paracip Syrup exactly as advised by your doctor. It is for paediatric use only. Shake well before use. Do not take more than four doses in a 24-hour period. Do not repeat doses more frequently than 4 hourly. Do not give Paracip Syrup more than 3 days without consulting a doctor.

It is not recommended to use Paracip Syrup in patients with severe or active hepatic impairment. Do not exceed the recommended daily dosage of Paracip Syrup. It should not be given with any other paracetamol-containing products.

introduction:
Introduction About DOLONEX DT 20MG TABLET

DOLONEX DT 20MG TABLET contains Piroxicam, which belongs to the group of medicines called Non-Steroidal Anti-Inflammatory Drugs. It helps to reduce pain and swelling affecting the joints. It is also used to relieve the symptoms caused by osteoarthritis (a joint disease that occurs when the protective tissues at the end of the bones wear out and is characterised by joint pain in the hands, neck, and hip), rheumatoid arthritis (autoimmune disease-causing painful swelling of joints and stiffness), and ankylosing spondylitis (rheumatism of the spine resulting in a hunched forward posture).

DOLONEX DT 20MG TABLET is not recommended for use in patients with heart problems, and it should be used with caution in patients with asthma, liver, and kidney problems. DOLONEX DT 20MG TABLET is not recommended for use in pregnant women, especially during the last three months of pregnancy, and it should be used with caution during breastfeeding.

The safety and effectiveness of DOLONEX DT 20MG TABLET in children and adolescents have not been established. DOLONEX DT 20MG TABLET is not recommended for use in elderly patients of 80 years and above. The most common side effects of this medicine are nausea (feeling sick), vomiting, indigestion, stomach pain, skin rash, headache, and drowsiness. Consult your physician if any of the symptoms worsen.

How DOLONEX DT 20MG TABLET Works

DOLONEX DT 20MG TABLET exerts its anti-inflammatory actions by inhibiting the enzyme cyclooxygenase-1 thereby, blocking the release of prostaglandins (a substance produced during injury and inflammation causing pain and swelling) and other chemical mediators that cause pain and swelling.

introduction:
Introduction About VOLITRA APS SOLUTION

Volitra Aps Solution 30 ml is a pain-relieving medicine used to provide relief from joint pain, back pain, neck pain, shoulder pain, muscle pain, joint injuries, sports injuries and sprains and strains (such as sprain of ankle, strain of shoulder or back muscles).

Take a few drops of Volitra Aps Solution and apply gently on the painful areas. Do not apply on open wounds, injuries or cuts and cover the treated areas. For optimal relief, apply Volitra APs 2 to 3 times a day or as directed by a doctor. Overuse can lead to skin irritation, so it’s essential to follow the recommended application schedule.

Before using Volitra Aps Solution inform your doctor if you are pregnant or breastfeeding or have any stomach ulcer problems. Volitra Aps Solution is well tolerated in most individuals. However, it may cause mild burning sensation or skin irritation immediately after application which is due to its counter irritant action. Consult your doctor if skin irritation persists.

Muscle pain

It is used for localised pain management associated with musculoskeletal pain conditions such as:

Muscle pain
mechanismOfAction:
How VOLITRA APS SOLUTION Works

Volitra APs Solution is a fast pain relief solution that works by targeting inflammation, swelling, and pain directly at the affected site. It contains Diclofenac, a powerful anti-inflammatory topical solution, which blocks the production of prostaglandins—chemicals responsible for pain and swelling.

When applied, it penetrates deep into muscles and joints, providing non-greasy pain relief with quick absorption. This topical solution for swelling effectively reduces stiffness, making movement easier. Safe for the elderly, Volitra APs is ideal for relieving muscle pain, joint pain, arthritis, sprains, and back pain without the side effects of oral painkillers.

usageDetails:
How to use VOLITRA APS SOLUTION

Use Volitra Aps Topical Solution as advised by your physician. Do not exceed the stated recommended daily dosage.

How To Use Volitra APs Topical Solution:
Clean and dry the affected area before applying Volitra APs Solution.
Take a few drops and gently massage it into the skin until absorbed.
Avoid contact with open wounds, cuts, or eyes.
Wash your hands after application unless treating hand pain.
Volitra APs Application Frequency:

For optimal relief, apply Volitra APs 2 to 3 times a day or as directed by a doctor. Overuse can lead to skin irritation, so it’s essential to follow the recommended application schedule.

Volitra APs Recommended Dosage:

Apply a few drops of Volitra APs over the affected area without excessive rubbing. The amount used depends on the size of the pain-affected region. Do not exceed the prescribed dosage for safe and effective relief.

Volitra APs Daily Usage Limit:

The maximum recommended usage is three times per day. Avoid exceeding this limit to prevent side effects like skin irritation or sensitivity.

Volitra APs for Long-Term Use:

Volitra APs can be used for short-term pain management, but prolonged use should be under medical supervision. For arthritis or joint pain, consult a doctor regarding extended usage to prevent potential side effects.

Volitra APs Dosage for Elderly Patients:

Elderly individuals should use the lowest effective dose to minimize skin sensitivity. If any irritation or discomfort occurs, consult a doctor.

introduction:
Introduction About THIOROK AP TABLET

THIOROK AP TABLET contains Aceclofenac, Paracetamol (Acetaminophen), and Thiocolchicoside which belongs to the group of medicines called Non-steroidal Anti-inflammatory drugs and Muscle relaxants. THIOROK AP TABLET is used in adults for the management of acute inflammatory and painful conditions associated with muscle spasms, such as lower back pain, muscle spasm due to any injury, neck and shoulder pain, sciatica (type of nerve pain), degenerative vertebral disorders, ankylosing spondylitis (chronic back pain due to fusion of some bones of the spine), osteoarthritis, and rheumatoid arthritis.

Avoid drinking alcohol while taking THIOROK AP TABLET. introduction:
Introduction About AKILOS P TABLET

AKILOS P TABLET is used for pain management associated with osteoarthritis, rheumatoid arthritis and ankylosing spondylitis. It can also be used to reduce pain caused due to sprains, strains, sports injuries, tendon pain, bone fracture pain and minor surgical and other pains. It is a combination of Aceclofenac + Paracetamol which are pain relieving agents.

Take AKILOS P TABLET after food to avoid gastric irritation. Do not take this medicine more than the duration recommended by your doctor. Before taking this medicine inform your doctor if you are having any liver, kidney or heart problems. You must also inform your doctor if you have stomach ulcers, gut inflammation, inflammatory bowel diseases or chronic alcoholism, or if you are pregnant or breastfeeding as a precaution.

The most common side effects of taking AKILOS P TABLET are indigestion, stomach pain, bloating and headache which can be managed by taking this medicine with meals and by following simple diet with less spicy food and limiting alcohol consumption.

mechanismOfAction:
How AKILOS P TABLET Works

AKILOS P TABLET contains aceclofenac and paracetamol which works together to relieve pain and inflammation. Aceclofenac is a non-steroidal anti-inflammatory drug (NSAID) that blocks enzymes called cyclooxygenase (COX) enzymes, reducing the production of chemicals called prostaglandins, which are responsible for causing pain and inflammation.

Paracetamol, on the other hand, works by reducing the perception of pain in the brain and also helps lower fever by acting on the heat-regulating centers in the brain. Together, they provide stronger pain relief and reduce inflammation.

name: SUMOL STRAWBERRY FLAVOUR Suspension 15ml
introduction:
Introduction About SUMOL STRAWBERRY FLAVOUR SUSPENSION

Sumol Strawberry Flavour Suspension is a painkiller and anti-pyretic medicine. It is used to manage pyrexia (including recurrent fever), body ache and traumatic injury in children. It contains paracetamol as an active ingredient that reduces fever and pain.

Paracetamol relieves pain by increasing the pain threshold by inhibiting certain enzymes (COX-1 and COX-2) involved in synthesis of chemicals responsible for inducing pain (prostaglandins). It reduces fever by directly acting on heat-regulating centers in the brain, resulting in vessel relaxation, sweating and loss of body heat.

Always give Sumol Strawberry Flavour Suspension to your child as advised by the doctor. Shake well before use. Do not exceed the recommended daily dosage. Use a measuring cup to properly measure the dose. Do not give Sumol Strawberry Flavour Suspension to your child if your child is allergic to any of its components.

introduction:
Introduction About PARALYF 650 TABLET

PARALYF 650 TABLET is a fever and pain reducing medicine. It contains a medicine called paracetamol which alleviate pain and reduce fever by inhibiting the release of certain chemicals within the body that causes pain and fever. It is commonly used to provide relief from headaches, migraines, tooth pain, sore throats, periods pain, joint pain, muscle aches, and symptoms of the common cold.

It is recommended to take PARALYF 650 TABLET as directed by your doctor. Taking it preferably with meals may reduce stomach upset. Do not take more than the recommended dosages as it could affect your liver. PARALYF 650 TABLET starts working within 30 minutes of its intake. Leave a time gap of 4 hours between each dose of PARALYF 650 TABLET.

In most cases, PARALYF 650 TABLET is well-tolerated, with side effects being rare. However, some individuals may experience temporary stomach discomfort, nausea, or vomiting. If any of these side effects persist or become troublesome, consult your doctor. Do not take this medicine, without consulting your doctor if you have severe liver problems. Consult your doctor before taking PARALYF 650 TABLET , if you are pregnant or breastfeeding.

Before using this medication, inform your doctor if you have any liver or kidney issues, are allergic to paracetamol, or are taking other medications as a precaution.

The recommended maximum dosage for adults is 4 tablets (2600 mg) in a 24-hour period. This means you can take 1 tablet (650 mg) every 4-6 hours as needed but ensure that you do not exceed 4 tablets in 24 hours.
Children's dosage should be prescribed by a healthcare provider based on age and weight.
Is it safe to take PARALYF 650 TABLET with food or on an empty stomach?
PARALYF 650 TABLET can be taken with or without food. It is generally well-tolerated whether you take it on an empty stomach or after eating. However, if you have a sensitive stomach or experience discomfort, it may be helpful to take it with food to minimize any potential stomach irritation.

For Dispersible Tablet: Disperse the medicine in the specified quantity of water as mentioned on the label. Consume the medicine immediately after reconstitution.

Your doctor will decide the correct dose and duration of therapy for you depending upon your age, body weight and severity of the condition.

introduction:
Introduction About P 120 SUSPENSION

P 120 Suspension is an analgesic and antipyretic medicine that is used in infants and children to manage pain such as headache, migraine, nerve pain, toothache and teething pains, sore throat, rheumatic aches and pains, and influenza.

It also helps in managing fever. It contains paracetamol as an active ingredient which blocks the pain and fever causing mechanism in the body.

Paracetamol works by inhibiting the production of a chemical called prostaglandins in the body which is responsible for causing pain and swelling. It reduces fever by affecting an area of the brain that is responsible for regulating our body temperature called hypothalamic heat-regulating centre.

Always give P 120 Suspension to your child exactly as advised by your child’s doctor. Shake well before use. Do not exceed the daily recommended dosages. It is not recommended for use P 120 Suspension in children who weigh less than 4kg, were born before 37 weeks of gestation, or have allergy to paracetamol. Before giving P 120 Suspension to your child, inform the doctor if he/she has liver, kidney diseases or sugar intolerance.

name: MEFNIWEL P DS Suspension 60ml
introduction:
Introduction About MEFNIWEL P DS SUSPENSION

MEFNIWEL P DS SUSPENSION is a combination of Mefenamic acid and Paracetamol, which belongs to a group of medicines called Non-steroidal Anti-inflammatory Drugs (NSAIDs) and Analgesics and Antipyretics. It is indicated for the management of fever in children. It is also used for the management of mild to moderate pain such as headache, toothache, joint or muscle pain, and period pain.

MEFNIWEL P DS SUSPENSION is not recommended for use in patients with asthma or aspirin-sensitive asthma, severe liver, kidney, or heart disease. Contact your doctor before taking.

MEFNIWEL P DS SUSPENSION is generally not recommended for use in pregnant women. Contact your doctor before taking.

MEFNIWEL P DS SUSPENSION is generally not recommended for use in breastfeeding women as it may pass through the breast milk. Contact your doctor before taking it.

MEFNIWEL P DS SUSPENSION is not recommended for use in children under 6 months of age. Contact your doctor before taking.

MEFNIWEL P DS SUSPENSION should be used with caution in elderly patients (aged 65 years or above). Contact your doctor before taking.

The most common side effects of this medicine are skin rash, nausea, vomiting, diarrhea, abdominal pain, constipation, indigestion, flatulence, anorexia, dry mouth, heartburn, peptic ulcers, perforation or GI bleeding, and ulcerative stomatitis. Contact your doctor if any of the side effects worsen.

mechanismOfAction:
How MEFNIWEL P DS SUSPENSION Works

MEFNIWEL P DS SUSPENSION helps to relieve fever and pain, where paracetamol acts on the hypothalamus (heat regulating center) of the brain, resulting in peripheral vasodilation, sweating, and loss of body heat, and it also increases the pain threshold by inhibiting COX-1 and COX-2 enzymes, and mefenamic acid works by inhibiting COX-1 and COX-2 enzymes, which are involved in prostaglandin synthesis (responsible for pain and inflammation).

Take this medicine as advised by your doctor. Shake well before use. Your doctor will decide the correct dose and duration of therapy for you depending upon your age, body weight, and disease condition.

Introduction About DOLO IVG INFUSION

DOLO IVG INFUSION contains Paracetamol which belongs to the group of medicines called Analgesics and Antipyretics. It is used for short-term management of moderate pain (especially after surgery) and fever when administered by the intravenous route is clinically justified.

Before receiving DOLO IVG INFUSION, inform your doctor if you have heart, lung, liver or kidney problems or if you suffer from alcoholism or alcohol abuse, malnourishment and severely low blood volume due to dehydration or blood loss.

DOLO IVG INFUSION should be used with caution in pregnant and breastfeeding women only if clearly advised by the doctor. DOLO IVG INFUSION should be used with caution in children and elderly patients.

The most common side effects of receiving DOLO IVG INFUSION are nausea, vomiting, headache, sleep problems and itching. Inform your doctor if any of these side effect worsens.

Introduction About DOLOPAR 250 SUSPENSION

Dolopar 250 suspension is an analgesic and antipyretic medicine used to manage fever and reduce mild to moderate pain in children. It contains paracetamol as an active ingredient which helps to reduce fever and pain in affected children.

Paracetamol inhibits prostaglandins synthesis (chemicals responsible for inflammation, pain, and fever) thus reducing fever and providing relief from pain.

Administer Dolopar 250 Suspension in child as advised by your physician. Shake well before use. Administer 2 to 5ml in 4 doses (24hr period) in children (aged 6 to 12 years) weighing 20-50 kgs or as directed by your doctor. Avoid administering more than 4 doses (in 24hr period). Do not exceed the recommended dosage. Avoid administering the medicine to the child aged less than 6 years.

name: ACENAC P Tablet 15's
introduction:
Introduction About ACENAC P TABLET

ACENAC P TABLET is used for pain management associated with osteoarthritis, rheumatoid arthritis and ankylosing spondylitis. It can also be used to reduce pain caused due to sprains, strains, sports injuries, tendon pain, bone fracture pain and minor surgical and other pains. It is a combination of Aceclofenac + Paracetamol which are pain relieving agents.

Take ACENAC P TABLET after food to avoid gastric irritation. Do not take this medicine more than the duration recommended by your doctor. Before taking this medicine inform your doctor if you are having any liver, kidney or heart problems. You must also inform your doctor if you have stomach ulcers, gut inflammation, inflammatory bowel diseases or chronic alcoholism, or if you are pregnant or breastfeeding as a precaution.

The most common side effects of taking ACENAC P TABLET are indigestion, stomach pain, bloating and headache which can be managed by taking this medicine with meals and by following simple diet with less spicy food and limiting alcohol consumption.

mechanismOfAction:
How ACENAC P TABLET Works

ACENAC P TABLET contains aceclofenac and paracetamol which works together to relieve pain and inflammation. Aceclofenac is a non-steroidal anti-inflammatory drug (NSAID) that blocks enzymes called cyclooxygenase (COX) enzymes, reducing the production of chemicals called prostaglandins, which are responsible for causing pain and inflammation.

Paracetamol, on the other hand, works by reducing the perception of pain in the brain and also helps lower fever by acting on the heat-regulating centers in the brain. Together, they provide stronger pain relief and reduce inflammation.

introduction:
Introduction About SUPPOL 250MG SUPPOSITORY

SUPPOL 250MG SUPPOSITORY contains Paracetamol which belongs to the group of medicines called Analgesics and Antipyretics. It is used to manage pain and fever (high temperature) in children (from 3 months to 12 years of age) who find it difficult to take the medicine orally.                  

Before administering SUPPOL 250MG SUPPOSITORY to your child, inform the child’s doctor if your child has liver or kidney problems or any allergies. Do not give your child medicines containing alcohol. Consult your child’s doctor for advice.

SUPPOL 250MG SUPPOSITORY is not recommended for use in elderly patients, pregnant and breastfeeding women as it is used only in children.

The most common side effect of using SUPPOL 250MG SUPPOSITORY is redness or soreness in and around the back passage. Consult your child’s doctor if any of the side effects get worse.
uses: Manage pain and fever in children (from 3 months to 12 years of age), who finds it difficult to take the medicine orally
usesDetails:
Uses Of SUPPOL 250MG SUPPOSITORY
Manage pain and fever in children (from 3 months to 12 years of age), who finds it difficult to take the medicine orally
mechanismOfAction:
How SUPPOL 250MG SUPPOSITORY Works

SUPPOL 250MG SUPPOSITORY relieves pain by increasing the pain threshold by inhibiting certain enzymes (COX-1 and COX-2) involved in the synthesis of chemicals responsible for inducing pain (prostaglandins). It reduces fever by directly acting on heat-regulating centers in the brain, resulting in vessel relaxation, sweating and loss of body heat.
usageDetails:
How to use SUPPOL 250MG SUPPOSITORY

Administer SUPPOL 250MG SUPPOSITORY to your child as advised by the physician. It is for rectal use only. Your child’s bowel needs to be empty when you administer it. Wash your hands and peel the wrapping apart. Do not break the medicine before use. Smoothly push into the back passage of the child with the pointed end first. Slightly warm it between your hands beforehand to make it easier. Tell your child to keep still for a minute or two and then clean your hands.

Your child’s doctor will decide the correct dose and duration for your child based on the child’s age, body weight and disease condition.

name: Medomol 300mg Distab 15'S
introduction:
Introduction About MEDOMOL 300MG DISTAB

Medomol-300 Distab is an analgesic and antipyretic medicine which is used to relieve pain and fever in children. It contains paracetamol as an active ingredient that reduces fever and pain.

Paracetamol works by inhibiting the production of a chemical called prostaglandins in the body which is responsible for causing pain and swelling in the body. It reduces fever by affecting an area of the brain that is responsible for regulating our body temperature called hypothalamic heat-regulating centre.

Always take Medomol-300 Distab as directed by your doctor. For administration, disperse the tablet in a tablespoon (15ml) of boiled and cooled water. Consume the mixture immediately after reconstitution. Do not exceed the stated recommended daily dosage.

name: BIOCETAMOL 100mg Oral Drops 15ml
introduction:
Introduction About BIOCETAMOL 100MG ORAL DROPS

BIOCETAMOL Oral Drops is an analgesic and antipyretic used to manage fever and mild to moderate pain in children. It contains paracetamol as active ingredients.

Paracetamol helps in relieving pain by inhibiting the production of prostaglandins (chemicals that are responsible for pain and inflammation) in the brain. It also decreases fever by acting on the hypothalamus (heat regulation centre) in the brain.

Administer BIOCETAMOL Oral Drops as advised by the doctor. Shake well before use. Give 0.5 to 1ml for 3 months to 1 year, 1 to 2ml for 1 to 4 years, and 2 to 5ml for 6 to 12 years 3 to 4 times per day, or as directed by the doctor. Not to exceed the recommended daily dosage.

name: ARISTOMOL 650 Tablet 15's
introduction:
Introduction About ARISTOMOL 650 TABLET

Aristomol Tablet belongs to antipyretic and analgesic (pain killers) medicine which is used to relieve mild to moderate pain (such as headache, toothache, back and menstrual pain) and reduces fever. It contains paracetamol as an active ingredient which is used to manage a wide range of painful conditions and fever.

Paracetamol acts as an antipyretic as well as painkiller. It works by inhibiting the production of a chemical called prostaglandins in the body, which are responsible for causing pain and swelling in the body. As a result, it reduces various pain. It also has a direct action on heat regulating centres in the brain, leading to peripheral vasodilation, sweating and loss of body temperature. Thus, it reduces fever.

Always take Aristomol Tablet as advised by the physician. Swallow the medicine as a whole with a glass of water and do not crush or chew the medicine. Do not exceed the recommended daily dosage.

name: DOMSTAL NP 500 Tablet 10's
introduction:
Introduction About DOMSTAL NP 500 TABLET

DOMSTAL NP 500 TABLET is a combination of Domperidone and Naproxen, which belong to the groups of medicines called antiemetics and NSAIDs (non-steroidal anti-inflammatory drugs), respectively. It is used to manage the symptoms of migraine, menstrual migraine, and chronic daily headaches associated with nausea and vomiting.

A migraine is a recurring headache that often involves one side of the head and causes severe pain that is pulsating or throbbing and is accompanied by nausea, weakness, and sensitivity to sound and light.

DOMSTAL NP 500 TABLET is not recommended in patients with severe liver, kidney, or heart problems, stomach ulcers, bleeding in the stomach or intestine, intestinal tears, or pituitary gland tumours. DOMSTAL NP 500 TABLET should be taken with caution in patients with lung disease, diabetes, high cholesterol, systemic lupus erythematosus, a blood clotting disorder, a history of gastrointestinal diseases, and a habit of drinking or smoking.

DOMSTAL NP 500 TABLET is not recommended for use during pregnancy, while breastfeeding, or in children less than 5 years old. It should be used with caution in elderly patients (those over the age of 60). The common side effect of taking DOMSTAL NP 500 TABLET may include dry mouth. Consult your doctor immediately if your symptoms get worse or persist.

mechanismOfAction:
How DOMSTAL NP 500 TABLET Works

DOMSTAL NP 500 TABLET effectively manages migraine, which is commonly associated with nausea and vomiting, by blocking the centres in the brain and stomach that regulate nausea and vomiting. It also increases the contractions and movements in the stomach. DOMSTAL NP 500 TABLET stops the pain pathways and reduces the release of substances (prostaglandins) that cause inflammation, thus decreasing pain and inflammation.

Take DOMSTAL NP 500 TABLET as advised by your physician. Swallow the medicine with a glass of water. Do not crush or chew the medicine. Your doctor will decide the correct dose and duration of DOMSTAL NP 500 TABLET for you depending on your age, body weight and disease condition.

DOMSTAL NP 500 TABLET is not recommended in patients with severe kidney disease. Consult your doctor before taking DOMSTAL NP 500 TABLET.
DOMSTAL NP 500 TABLET is not recommended in patients with severe liver disease. Consult your doctor before taking it.
Do not take DOMSTAL NP 500 TABLET if you are allergic to Domperidone or Naproxen.
DOMSTAL NP 500 TABLET should be used with caution in patients with lung diseases such as asthma, other breathing problems or nasal polyps. Consult your doctor before taking it.

DOMSTAL NP 500 TABLET not recommended in patients with severe heart disease such as heart failure, prolonged QT corrected interval. It should be used with caution in patients having a stroke or high blood pressure. Consult your doctor before taking DOMSTAL NP 500 TABLET.

Others

DOMSTAL NP 500 TABLET is not recommended for use if you:

Have stomach or duodenal ulcers
Have bleeding in the stomach or intestines
Have a blockage or tear in the intestine
Have a tumour of the pituitary gland

Before taking DOMSTAL NP 500 TABLET tell your doctor if you:

Have a history of disorders of the stomach or bowel (ulcerative colitis, Crohn’s disease)
Have diabetes
Have a habit of smoking
Have systemic lupus erythematosus or other connective tissue disorder
Have a blood clotting disorder

Use in paediatrics:

DOMSTAL NP 500 TABLET is not recommended for use in children under 5 years of age. Consult your doctor before taking DOMSTAL NP 500 TABLET.

DOMSTAL NP 500 TABLET should be used with caution in elderly patients (above 60 years of age). Consult your doctor for advice.

introduction:
Introduction About KETOFLAM P TABLET

KETOFLAM P TABLET is a combination of Flupirtine and Paracetamol which belongs to the group of medicines called Non opioid analgesic and Analgesic & Antipyretic agents respectively. It is indicated in post-surgical pain, dental pain, pain associated with muscle spasm, cancer pain, neuropathic pain, low back pain and migraine.

Avoid consumption of alcohol while taking KETOFLAM P TABLET as it increases the risk of liver damage.

KETOFLAM P TABLET is not recommended for use in patients with liver or kidney diseases. Contact your doctor before taking.

KETOFLAM P TABLET is not recommended for use in pregnancy as safety is not established unless clearly necessary. Contact your doctor before taking.

KETOFLAM P TABLET is not recommended for use in breastfeeding women as it may pass through the breast milk. Contact your doctor before taking.

KETOFLAM P TABLET is not recommended for use in children and adolescents under 18 years of age. Contact your doctor before taking.

KETOFLAM P TABLET is not recommended for use in elderly patients aged 65 years or above. Contact your doctor before taking.

The most common side effects of this medicine are nausea, vomiting, abdominal discomfort, diarrhoea, constipation, heartburn, flatulence, dry mouth, headache, drowsiness, dizziness, fatigue, disorientation or shaking (tremors), hallucinations. Contact your physician if any of the above side effects worsen.

KETOFLAM P TABLET is a combination of two medicines Flupirtine and Paracetamol, which relieves pain. Flupirtine works by blocking transmission of pain signals to the brain to lower pain perception. Paracetamol works by blocking the release of certain chemical messengers that cause fever and pain.
usageDetails:
How to use KETOFLAM P TABLET

Take this medicine as advised by your physician. Swallow this medicine as whole with a glass of water and do not crush or chew the medicine. Your doctor will decide the right depends on the age, body weight and disease condition.

interactions:
Interactions

A. Drug - Drug interactions:

Inform your physician if you are taking any of the following medicine:

Medicines used to manage epilepsy (Ex. carbamazepine, lamotrigine, phenytoin)
Warfarin (medicines used to manage blood clots)
Diazepam (medicines used for anxiety, seizures)
Sedatives like butabarbital
Muscle relaxants (Ex. chlorzoxazone, baclofen)
Medicines that delay emptying of stomach (Ex. dicyclomine)
Chloramphenicol (medicines used to manage infections)
Medicines used for nausea and vomiting (Ex. Metoclopramide, domperidone)
Cholestyramine (medicines used to lower high cholesterol levels)
Probenecid (medicines used to manage gout)
Salicylamide (medicines used to manage fever and pain)
Barbiturates (medicines used to manage mental disorders)
Rifampicin, isoniazid (medicines used to manage bacterial infections like tuberculosis)
St John’s wort (medicine used for depression)
Imatinib (medicine used to manage leukaemia and some stomach tumours)

Overdosage:

If you or anyone else accidentally took too much of this medicine, consult your doctor immediately. Symptoms of overdose are nausea, vomiting, stomach pain, loss of appetite, paleness, liver damage, abnormal fatigue, fast heartbeat, compulsion to cry, light-headedness, dry mouth.

name: Crocin Peppermint Flavour Drops 15ml
introduction:
Introduction About CROCIN DROPS

Crocin Peppermint Flavour Drops is an analgesic and antipyretic used in children for teething pain, immunisation pain, headache, and earache. It contains paracetamol as an active ingredient.

Paracetamol reduces pain by blocking the production of certain chemicals in the brain called prostaglandins, which are responsible for pain and inflammation.

Always give Crocin Peppermint Flavour Drops to your child exactly as advised by your paediatrician. Shake well before use. Administer drops onto your child’s tongue with the help of a dropper. Not recommended for babies less than 1 month. Do not exceed the stated daily dose as it may lead to liver damage in your child. Do not use more than 3 days without asking a doctor.

name: Biopyrin 650mg Tablet 15'S
introduction:
Introduction About BIOPYRIN 650MG TABLET

BIOPYRIN 650MG TABLET contains Paracetamol which belongs to the group of medicines called Analgesics and Antipyretics. It is used to relieve mild to moderate pain (including headaches, backache, toothache, severe nerve pain, sore throat, period pain, low back and leg pain, muscle, connective tissue and joint pain, symptomatic relief of sprains, strain, joint swelling and stiffness). It is also used to lower fever (high body temperature) and relieves the symptoms of cold or flu.   

Before taking BIOPYRIN 650MG TABLET, inform your doctor if you or your child have liver or kidney problems or any allergies. It should be used with caution in patients with liver problems due to alcohol to manage the risk of liver damage.

BIOPYRIN 650MG TABLET should be used with caution in pregnant women only if clearly advised by the doctor and can be used in breastfeeding women. BIOPYRIN 650MG TABLET is not recommended for use in children less than 10 years of age and should be used with caution in elderly patients.

Consult your doctor if you experience any side effects or unusual effects during management with BIOPYRIN 650MG TABLET.

usesDetails:

Relieves mild to moderate pain (such as headache, toothache, joint pain)

mechanismOfAction:
How BIOPYRIN 650MG TABLET Works

BIOPYRIN 650MG TABLET relieves pain by increasing the pain threshold by inhibiting certain enzymes (COX-1 and COX-2) involved in the synthesis of chemicals responsible for inducing pain (prostaglandins). It reduces fever by directly acting on heat-regulating centers in the brain, resulting in vessel relaxation, sweating and loss of body heat.
usageDetails:
How to use BIOPYRIN 650MG TABLET

Take BIOPYRIN 650MG TABLET as advised by your physician. It can be taken with or without food.

For Tablet, Capsule: Swallow BIOPYRIN 650MG TABLET with a glass of water. Do not crush or chew the medicine.

For Dispersible Tablet: Disperse the medicine in the specified quantity of water as mentioned in the label. Consume the medicine immediately after reconstitution.

Your doctor will decide the correct dose and duration of therapy for you depending upon your age, body weight and severity of the condition.

warnings.details: BIOPYRIN 650MG TABLET should be used with caution in pregnant women only if considered clearly necessary. Your doctor may use the lowest possible dose to reduce the pain and fever only for a shorter duration in pregnant women. Consult your doctor before taking BIOPYRIN 650MG TABLET.
BIOPYRIN 650MG TABLET should be used with caution in breastfeeding women. Consult your doctor before taking it.
BIOPYRIN 650MG TABLET has no influence on the ability to drive and operate machinery.
BIOPYRIN 650MG TABLET should be used with caution in patients with chronic alcoholism. Consult your doctor before taking it.
BIOPYRIN 650MG TABLET should be used with caution in patients with severe kidney problems. Consult your doctor before taking it.
BIOPYRIN 650MG TABLET should be used with caution in patients with severe liver problems or liver problems due to alcohol. Consult your doctor before taking it.
Do not take BIOPYRIN 650MG TABLET if you are allergic to Paracetamol or any other ingredients of this medicine.

Others

Before taking BIOPYRIN 650MG TABLET, inform your doctor if you:

Have sepsis (circulation of bacteria and their toxins in the blood leading to organ damage)
Are malnourished

Use in pediatrics:

BIOPYRIN 650MG TABLET is not recommended for use in children less than 10 years of age. It can be used in children and adolescents aged above 10 and your child’s doctor may adjust the dose based on the child’s age and body weight. Consult your child’s doctor for advice.

Use in geriatrics:

BIOPYRIN 650MG TABLET should be used with caution in elderly patients. Consult your doctor before taking it.

introduction:
Introduction About FEPANIL 125MG SUSPENSION

Fepanil Suspension is an analgesic and antipyretic used to manage mild to moderate pain such as headache, nerve pain, toothache, sore throat, and general pains. It helps to reduce a fever and also relieves the symptoms of cold and flu. It contains Paracetamol as active ingredient.

Paracetamol helps to decrease pain by inhibiting the production of prostaglandins (chemicals which are responsible for pain and inflammation) in brain. It reduces fever by acting on a specific area of the brain called hypothalamus, that regulates the body temperature.

Always give Fepanil Suspension to your child as advised by the doctor. It is for oral use only. Shake well before use. Use 3-4 times a day or as directed by the doctor. Do not administer for more than 48 hours without consulting your doctor.

Introduction About SUMO L DS STRAWBERRY FLAVOUR ORAL SUSPENSION

SUMO L DS STRAWBERRY FLAVOUR ORAL SUSPENSION contains Paracetamol which belongs to the group of medicines called Analgesics and Antipyretics. It is used to relieve mild to moderate pain like headache, migraine, nerve pain, toothache, sore throat, period pains, teething, immunisation, earache, and general aches and pains. It can also be used to manage fever (high temperature), and symptoms of cold or flu.

Before taking SUMO L DS STRAWBERRY FLAVOUR ORAL SUSPENSION, inform your doctor if you have liver or kidney problems, fructose intolerance, Gilberts syndrome, glucose-6-phosphate dehydrogenase deficiency, hemolytic anaemia, reduced glutathione levels, malnourishment, dehydration or if you weigh less than 50 kg.

SUMO L DS STRAWBERRY FLAVOUR ORAL SUSPENSION should be used in pregnant women only if considered necessary. Avoid consumption of alcohol during management with SUMO L DS STRAWBERRY FLAVOUR ORAL SUSPENSION, as it might make you more prone to side effects.

SUMO L DS STRAWBERRY FLAVOUR ORAL SUSPENSION is not recommended for use in children (2-3 months old, weighing less than 4 kg or born before 37 weeks). Contact your doctor if you get any side effects of any of the symptoms get worse.

introduction:
Introduction About ADDFEN P TABLET

ADDFEN P TABLET is used for pain management associated with osteoarthritis, rheumatoid arthritis and ankylosing spondylitis. It can also be used to reduce pain caused due to sprains, strains, sports injuries, tendon pain, bone fracture pain and minor surgical and other pains. It is a combination of Aceclofenac + Paracetamol which are pain relieving agents.

Take ADDFEN P TABLET after food to avoid gastric irritation. Do not take this medicine more than the duration recommended by your doctor. Before taking this medicine inform your doctor if you are having any liver, kidney or heart problems. You must also inform your doctor if you have stomach ulcers, gut inflammation, inflammatory bowel diseases or chronic alcoholism, or if you are pregnant or breastfeeding as a precaution.

The most common side effects of taking ADDFEN P TABLET are indigestion, stomach pain, bloating and headache which can be managed by taking this medicine with meals and by following simple diet with less spicy food and limiting alcohol consumption.
