mechanismOfAction:
How ADDFEN P TABLET Works

ADDFEN P TABLET contains aceclofenac and paracetamol which works together to relieve pain and inflammation. Aceclofenac is a non-steroidal anti-inflammatory drug (NSAID) that blocks enzymes called cyclooxygenase (COX) enzymes, reducing the production of chemicals called prostaglandins, which are responsible for causing pain and inflammation.

Paracetamol, on the other hand, works by reducing the perception of pain in the brain and also helps lower fever by acting on the heat-regulating centers in the brain. Together, they provide stronger pain relief and reduce inflammation.

name: Flozen AA Tablet 10'S
introduction:
Introduction About FLOZEN AA TABLET

FLOZEN AA TABLET is used to relieve inflammation and pain due to bone and soft tissue injuries in affected individuals. It is also used to reduce high temperatures and provide relief from cold (while sneezing) in affected individuals. This medicine is also indicated for use to resolve post-operative inflammation, oedema, and pain. It is also used to provide relief from illnesses such as headaches, moderate migraines, and musculoskeletal pain.

FLOZEN AA TABLET is a combination of Aceclofenac, Paracetamol, and Serratiopeptidase, which belong to the group of medicines called Nonsteroidal anti-inflammatory agents, Analgesics and Antipyretics, and Proteolytic enzymes, respectively. It helps to reduce pain and inflammation by blocking certain chemical messengers in the brain, and it also promotes healing by breaking down abnormal proteins at the site of inflammation, thereby healing the infected site.

FLOZEN AA TABLET is not recommended for use in patients allergic to Aceclofenac, Paracetamol, or Serratiopeptidase. It is also not recommended for use in patients with active or recurrent peptic ulcers or haemorrhages (bleeding), severe heart, liver, or kidney diseases. Before taking FLOZEN AA TABLET, inform your doctor if you suffer from uncontrolled high blood pressure, diabetes, hyperlipidaemia (high-fat level in the blood), gastrointestinal diseases such as ulcerative colitis (inflammatory bowel disease), and/or aseptic meningitis (inflammation of the brain).

FLOZEN AA TABLET is not recommended for use by pregnant and breastfeeding women. It is also not recommended for use in children and adolescents (below 18 years old). Consult your doctor before taking the medicine. The most common side effects of taking FLOZEN AA TABLET are abdominal pain, nausea, vomiting, diarrhea, flatulence, constipation, indigestion, and/or dizziness. Consult and inform your doctor if any of these side effects get worse.

introduction:
Introduction About THIOROK TABLET

THIOROK TABLET is used in adults to manage painful inflammatory conditions associated with muscle spasms. It can also be used to manage pain associated with musculoskeletal (bone) disorders such as osteoarthritis, rheumatoid arthritis (inflammation of joints), or ankylosing spondylitis (back pain caused by inflammation of bones in the spine).

THIOROK TABLET is a combination of aceclofenac and thiocolchicoside, which belong to the group of medicines called Non-Steroidal Anti-inflammatory Drugs and Muscle relaxants, respectively. It works by blocking the production of certain chemicals that cause pain and inflammation in the body. It also relaxes the muscles by blocking the action of certain chemical messengers (GABA) in the brain that cause muscle spasm. As a result, THIOROK TABLET relieves painful muscle spasms associated with inflammatory disease conditions.

Before taking THIOROK TABLET, inform your doctor if you have any problems in your liver, liver, kidney, heart, or stomach. You should also inform your doctor if you have diabetes, high blood cholesterol, or fits.

Do not take THIOROK TABLET if you have asthma or varicella infection. Consult your doctor before taking THIOROK TABLET if you are pregnant, think you may be pregnant, or are breastfeeding.

Take THIOROK TABLET only as advised by your doctor. Do not take THIOROK TABLET longer than recommended by your doctor, as it may cause serious side effects. Avoid smoking and consumption of alcohol while undergoing therapy with THIOROK TABLET to achieve better results.

The most common side effects of taking THIOROK TABLET are dizziness, drowsiness, nausea, and stomach pain. Consult your doctor if any of these side effects worsen.

name: PYRIGESIC 500mg Tablet 15's
introduction:
Introduction About PYRIGESIC 500MG TABLET

Pyrigesic Tablet is an analgesic and antipyretic formulation that is used to manage fever (that occurs due to bacterial/viral infections, post immunisation) and mild to moderate pain of any origin. It contains Paracetamol as an active ingredient which helps to reduce fever and pain in affected individuals.

Paracetamol inhibits prostaglandins synthesis (chemicals responsible for inflammation, pain, and fever) thus reducing fever and providing relief from pain.

Take Pyrigesic Tablet as advised by your physician.  Do not crush/chew the tablet and swallow it with a glass of water. Take one or two tablets thrice daily or as directed by your physician. Do not exceed the recommended dosage.

name: ZYPARA 650 Tablet 15's
introduction:
Introduction About ZYPARA 650 TABLET

ZYPARA 650 Tablet is an analgesic and antipyretic medicine used for mild to moderate pain and fever. It contains Paracetamol as an active ingredient.

Paracetamol exhibits the central analgesic action by inhibiting the release of pain causing chemicals (prostaglandins) at the affected site. It also exhibits the antipyretic action by directly acting on the heat-regulating centres present in the brain, thereby causing peripheral vasodilation causing sweating and loss of body heat.

Always take ZYPARA 650 Tablet as advised by your doctor. Do not repeat the dose of this medicine more frequently than every 4 hours or more than 5 doses in the period of any 24-hour period. Do not exceed the recommended daily dosage. Do not take if you are allergic to paracetamol.

introduction:
Introduction About NEOMOL 80 ANAL SUPPOSITORIES

NEOMOL 80 ANAL SUPPOSITORIES contains Paracetamol which belongs to the group of medicines called Analgesics and Antipyretics. It is used to manage pain and fever (high temperature) in children (from 3 months to 12 years of age) who find it difficult to take the medicine orally.                  

Before administering NEOMOL 80 ANAL SUPPOSITORIES to your child, inform the child’s doctor if your child has liver or kidney problems or any allergies. Do not give your child medicines containing alcohol. Consult your child’s doctor for advice.

NEOMOL 80 ANAL SUPPOSITORIES is not recommended for use in elderly patients, pregnant and breastfeeding women as it is used only in children.

The most common side effect of using NEOMOL 80 ANAL SUPPOSITORIES is redness or soreness in and around the back passage. Consult your child’s doctor if any of the side effects get worse.
uses: Manage pain and fever in children (from 3 months to 12 years of age), who finds it difficult to take the medicine orally
usesDetails:
Uses Of NEOMOL 80 ANAL SUPPOSITORIES

mechanismOfAction:
How NEOMOL 80 ANAL SUPPOSITORIES Works

NEOMOL 80 ANAL SUPPOSITORIES relieves pain by increasing the pain threshold by inhibiting certain enzymes (COX-1 and COX-2) involved in the synthesis of chemicals responsible for inducing pain (prostaglandins). It reduces fever by directly acting on heat-regulating centers in the brain, resulting in vessel relaxation, sweating and loss of body heat.
usageDetails:
How to use NEOMOL 80 ANAL SUPPOSITORIES

Administer NEOMOL 80 ANAL SUPPOSITORIES to your child as advised by the physician. It is for rectal use only. Your child’s bowel needs to be empty when you administer it. Wash your hands and peel the wrapping apart. Do not break the medicine before use. Smoothly push into the back passage of the child with the pointed end first. Slightly warm it between your hands beforehand to make it easier. Tell your child to keep still for a minute or two and then clean your hands.

Your child’s doctor will decide the correct dose and duration for your child based on the child’s age, body weight and disease condition.

name: P 100 Drops 15ml
introduction:
Introduction About P 100 DROPS

P-100 Drops is an analgesic and antipyretic medicine that is used in infants and children to manage pain such as headache, migraine, nerve pain, toothache and teething pains, sore throat, rheumatic aches and pains, and influenza.

It also helps in managing fever. It contains paracetamol as an active ingredient which blocks the pain and fever causing mechanism in the body.

Paracetamol works by inhibiting the production of a chemical called prostaglandins in the body which is responsible for causing pain and swelling. It reduces fever by affecting an area of the brain that is responsible for regulating our body temperature called hypothalamic heat-regulating centre.

Always give P-100 Drops to your child exactly as advised by your child’s doctor. Shake well before use. Do not exceed the daily recommended dosages. It is not recommended for use P-100 Drops in children who weigh less than 4kg, were born before 37 weeks of gestation, or have allergy to paracetamol. Before giving P-100 Drops to your child, inform the doctor if he/she has liver, kidney diseases or sugar intolerance.

Consult a doctor if your child experience any unusual symptoms such as such as allergic reaction, swelling in legs, arms, face, throat or tongue, difficulty in breathing, swallowing, rashes, etc while taking this medicine.

introduction:
Introduction About PRUF P TABLET

PRUF P TABLET is a combination of Flupirtine and Paracetamol which belongs to the group of medicines called Non opioid analgesic and Analgesic & Antipyretic agents respectively. It is indicated in post-surgical pain, dental pain, pain associated with muscle spasm, cancer pain, neuropathic pain, low back pain and migraine.

Avoid consumption of alcohol while taking PRUF P TABLET as it increases the risk of liver damage.

PRUF P TABLET is not recommended for use in patients with liver or kidney diseases. Contact your doctor before taking.

PRUF P TABLET is not recommended for use in pregnancy as safety is not established unless clearly necessary. Contact your doctor before taking.

PRUF P TABLET is not recommended for use in breastfeeding women as it may pass through the breast milk. Contact your doctor before taking.

PRUF P TABLET is not recommended for use in children and adolescents under 18 years of age. Contact your doctor before taking.

PRUF P TABLET is not recommended for use in elderly patients aged 65 years or above. Contact your doctor before taking.

The most common side effects of this medicine are nausea, vomiting, abdominal discomfort, diarrhoea, constipation, heartburn, flatulence, dry mouth, headache, drowsiness, dizziness, fatigue, disorientation or shaking (tremors), hallucinations. Contact your physician if any of the above side effects worsen.

It is used to relieve mild to moderate pain (including headaches, backache, toothache, severe nerve pain, sore throat, period pain, low back and leg pain, muscle, connective tissue and joint pain, symptomatic relief of sprains, strain, joint swelling and stiffness). It is also used to lower fever (high body temperature) and relieves the symptoms of cold or flu.   

Before taking P 650 TABLET, inform your doctor if you or your child have liver or kidney problems or any allergies. It should be used with caution in patients with liver problems due to alcohol to manage the risk of liver damage.

P 650 TABLET should be used with caution in pregnant women only if clearly advised by the doctor and can be used in breastfeeding women. P 650 TABLET is not recommended for use in children less than 10 years of age and should be used with caution in elderly patients.

Consult your doctor if you experience any side effects or unusual effects during management with P 650 TABLET.

mechanismOfAction:
How P 650 TABLET Works

P 650 TABLET relieves pain by increasing the pain threshold by inhibiting certain enzymes (COX-1 and COX-2) involved in the synthesis of chemicals responsible for inducing pain (prostaglandins). It reduces fever by directly acting on heat-regulating centers in the brain, resulting in vessel relaxation, sweating and loss of body heat.
usageDetails:
How to use P 650 TABLET

Take P 650 TABLET as advised by your physician. It can be taken with or without food.

For Tablet, Capsule: Swallow P 650 TABLET with a glass of water. Do not crush or chew the medicine.

For Dispersible Tablet: Disperse the medicine in the specified quantity of water as mentioned in the label. Consume the medicine immediately after reconstitution.

Your doctor will decide the correct dose and duration of therapy for you depending upon your age, body weight and severity of the condition.

introduction:
Introduction About DOLOWIN SPAS TABLET

DOLOWIN SPAS TABLET is a combination of Aceclofenac and Drotaverine which belongs to the group of medicines called Antispasmodics. It is used to manage dysmenorrhea (menstrual pain), abdominal pain and cramps.

Do not use DOLOWIN SPAS TABLET if you are allergic to other NSAIDs like ibuprofen or aspirin. Before taking DOLOWIN SPAS TABLET, inform your doctor if you have a history of stomach ulcer, have vomited blood, passed blood in faeces, have any kidney, heart, liver, bowel or blood clotting problems, porphyria, diabetes, chicken pox or if you have undergone any bypass surgery.

DOLOWIN SPAS TABLET is not recommended for use in pregnant and breastfeeding women unless considered necessary by your doctor. DOLOWIN SPAS TABLET is not recommended for use in children and adolescents (under 18 years of age) so, consult your child’s doctor for advice.

Avoid smoking while taking DOLOWIN SPAS TABLET. The most common side effects of taking DOLOWIN SPAS TABLET are dizziness, dry mouth, nausea, sleepiness, blurred vision and weakness. Contact your doctor if any of the symptoms worsen over time.

introduction:
Introduction About PYRODIP 650 TABLET

PYRODIP 650 TABLET is a fever and pain reducing medicine. It contains a medicine called paracetamol which alleviate pain and reduce fever by inhibiting the release of certain chemicals within the body that causes pain and fever. It is commonly used to provide relief from headaches, migraines, tooth pain, sore throats, periods pain, joint pain, muscle aches, and symptoms of the common cold.

It is recommended to take PYRODIP 650 TABLET as directed by your doctor. Taking it preferably with meals may reduce stomach upset. Do not take more than the recommended dosages as it could affect your liver. PYRODIP 650 TABLET starts working within 30 minutes of its intake. Leave a time gap of 4 hours between each dose of PYRODIP 650 TABLET.

In most cases, PYRODIP 650 TABLET is well-tolerated, with side effects being rare. However, some individuals may experience temporary stomach discomfort, nausea, or vomiting. If any of these side effects persist or become troublesome, consult your doctor. Do not take this medicine, without consulting your doctor if you have severe liver problems. Consult your doctor before taking PYRODIP 650 TABLET , if you are pregnant or breastfeeding.

Before using this medication, inform your doctor if you have any liver or kidney issues, are allergic to paracetamol, or are taking other medications as a precaution.

It helps lower body temperature by acting on the brain's temperature control center, making it an ideal choice for fever management. For headaches and body pains, paracetamol blocks the production of pain-causing chemicals in the body, providing quick relief from conditions like headaches, muscle pain, and joint discomfort. PYRODIP 650 TABLET is known for its fast-acting and gentle effects, making it a trusted solution for mild to moderate pain and fever.

sideEffectsDetails:
Side Effects Of PYRODIP 650 TABLET

PYRODIP 650 TABLET is safe and well-tolerated. In some individuals it may cause mild nausea.

When To Consult your doctor?

Signs of liver damage (such as nausea, vomiting, yellowing of whites of eyes and skin, skin itchiness, yellowing of urine, severe stomach pain)

warnings.details: Paracetamol is classified as Category C by the U.S. FDA, which means that animal reproduction studies have shown some adverse effects on the fetus, but there are no adequate or well-controlled studies in humans. Therefore, PYRODIP 650 TABLET should be used in pregnant women only if considered necessary by the physician. Caution is advised when taking PYRODIP 650 TABLET during pregnancy, especially during the first trimester.

Paracetamol is considered safe for use during breastfeeding in recommended doses. It passes into breast milk in very small amounts, and no harmful effects on the infant are typically seen. However, it’s always best to consult a doctor before taking any medication while breastfeeding.
PYRODIP 650 TABLET has no influence on the ability to drive and operate machinery.
Avoid consumption of alcohol while taking this medicine as it could increase the risk of liver damage

People with pre-existing kidney issues should use PYRODIP 650 TABLET with caution. If you have kidney disease or reduced kidney function, you may need a lower dose or special monitoring. Always consult your healthcare provider before using PYRODIP 650 TABLET if you have kidney problems.

Caution is especially important for those with liver disease or liver impairment, as paracetamol is metabolized in the liver. Overuse or high doses can lead to severe liver damage. If you have liver problems, avoid taking PYRODIP 650 TABLET or use it only under strict medical supervision. The maximum dose should not exceed the prescribed limit.
Do not take PYRODIP 650 TABLET if you are allergic to Paracetamol.

PYRODIP 650 TABLET is typically formulated for adults (650 mg per tablet) and children aged 12 years or older. It is not suitable for young children due to the high dosage. Children under 12 years of age should not use this formulation unless specifically prescribed by a healthcare provider.
PYRODIP 650 TABLET should be used with caution in elderly patients with liver problems. Therefore, consult your doctor before taking it.

Paracetamol is considered safe for use during breastfeeding in recommended doses. It passes into breast milk in very small amounts, and no harmful effects on the infant are typically seen. However, it’s always best to consult a doctor before taking any medication while breastfeeding.

Driving and Using Machines
USE WITH CAUTION

PYRODIP 650 TABLET has no influence on the ability to drive and operate machinery.

Alcohol
CONSULT YOUR DOCTOR

Avoid consumption of alcohol while taking this medicine as it could increase the risk of liver damage

Kidney
USE WITH CAUTION

People with pre-existing kidney issues should use PYRODIP 650 TABLET with caution. If you have kidney disease or reduced kidney function, you may need a lower dose or special monitoring. Always consult your healthcare provider before using PYRODIP 650 TABLET if you have kidney problems.

Liver
USE WITH CAUTION

Caution is especially important for those with liver disease or liver impairment, as paracetamol is metabolized in the liver. Overuse or high doses can lead to severe liver damage. If you have liver problems, avoid taking PYRODIP 650 TABLET or use it only under strict medical supervision. The maximum dose should not exceed the prescribed limit.

Allergy
CONTRAINDICATED

Do not take PYRODIP 650 TABLET if you are allergic to Paracetamol.

Use In Pediatrics
CONSULT YOUR DOCTOR

PYRODIP 650 TABLET is typically formulated for adults (650 mg per tablet) and children aged 12 years or older. It is not suitable for young children due to the high dosage. Children under 12 years of age should not use this formulation unless specifically prescribed by a healthcare provider.

For pediatric use, lower doses of paracetamol (in syrup or suspension form) are typically recommended.
The recommended dose of paracetamol for children generally depends on the child's weight and age. A typical pediatric dose is about 10-15 mg/kg body weight every 4-6 hours, without exceeding the maximum daily dose, which is usually 60 mg/kg per day.
Use In Geriatrics
USE WITH CAUTION

PYRODIP 650 TABLET  should be used with caution in elderly patients with liver problems. Therefore, consult your doctor before taking it.

DOLOWIN PLUS TABLET is used for pain management associated with osteoarthritis, rheumatoid arthritis and ankylosing spondylitis. It can also be used to reduce pain caused due to sprains, strains, sports injuries, tendon pain, bone fracture pain and minor surgical and other pains. It is a combination of Aceclofenac + Paracetamol which are pain relieving agents.

Take DOLOWIN PLUS TABLET after food to avoid gastric irritation. Do not take this medicine more than the duration recommended by your doctor. Before taking this medicine inform your doctor if you are having any liver, kidney or heart problems. You must also inform your doctor if you have stomach ulcers, gut inflammation, inflammatory bowel diseases or chronic alcoholism, or if you are pregnant or breastfeeding as a precaution.

The most common side effects of taking DOLOWIN PLUS TABLET are indigestion, stomach pain, bloating and headache which can be managed by taking this medicine with meals and by following simple diet with less spicy food and limiting alcohol consumption.

mechanismOfAction:
How DOLOWIN PLUS TABLET Works

DOLOWIN PLUS TABLET contains aceclofenac and paracetamol which works together to relieve pain and inflammation. Aceclofenac is a non-steroidal anti-inflammatory drug (NSAID) that blocks enzymes called cyclooxygenase (COX) enzymes, reducing the production of chemicals called prostaglandins, which are responsible for causing pain and inflammation.

Paracetamol, on the other hand, works by reducing the perception of pain in the brain and also helps lower fever by acting on the heat-regulating centers in the brain. Together, they provide stronger pain relief and reduce inflammation.

name: Calpol Peppermint Flavour Paediatric Drops 15ml
introduction:
Introduction About CALPOL PAEDIATRIC DROPS

Calpol Paediatric Drops Peppermint Flavour is an analgesic and antipyretic medicine used to reduce fever and provide relief from mild to moderate pain in children. It contains Paracetamol as an active ingredient to effectively reduce fever and relieve pain.

Paracetamol acts as an antipyretic which works by inhibiting the production of a chemical called prostaglandins in the body, which are responsible for causing pain and swelling in the body. As a result, it reduces various pains. It also has a direct action on heat-regulating centres in the brain, leading to peripheral vasodilation, sweating, and loss of body temperature. Thus, it reduces fever.

Always give Calpol Paediatric Drops Peppermint Flavour as advised by your physician. Shake well before each use. Use the dropper provided with the package for correct dosing. The maximum daily dosage is 60 mg/kg, to be administered in divided doses of 10–15 mg/kg throughout the 24-hour period. Administering more than the daily dosage may cause serious liver damage or allergic reactions (such as swelling of the face, mouth, and throat, difficulty breathing, itching, or rash).

introduction:
Introduction About ARFLUR 3D TABLET

ARFLUR 3D TABLET is used to relieve inflammation and pain due to bone and soft tissue injuries in affected individuals. It is also used to reduce high temperatures and provide relief from cold (while sneezing) in affected individuals. This medicine is also indicated for use to resolve post-operative inflammation, oedema, and pain. It is also used to provide relief from illnesses such as headaches, moderate migraines, and musculoskeletal pain.

ARFLUR 3D TABLET is a combination of Aceclofenac, Paracetamol, and Serratiopeptidase, which belong to the group of medicines called Nonsteroidal anti-inflammatory agents, Analgesics and Antipyretics, and Proteolytic enzymes, respectively. It helps to reduce pain and inflammation by blocking certain chemical messengers in the brain, and it also promotes healing by breaking down abnormal proteins at the site of inflammation, thereby healing the infected site.

ARFLUR 3D TABLET is not recommended for use in patients allergic to Aceclofenac, Paracetamol, or Serratiopeptidase. It is also not recommended for use in patients with active or recurrent peptic ulcers or haemorrhages (bleeding), severe heart, liver, or kidney diseases. Before taking ARFLUR 3D TABLET, inform your doctor if you suffer from uncontrolled high blood pressure, diabetes, hyperlipidaemia (high-fat level in the blood), gastrointestinal diseases such as ulcerative colitis (inflammatory bowel disease), and/or aseptic meningitis (inflammation of the brain).

ARFLUR 3D TABLET is not recommended for use by pregnant and breastfeeding women. It is also not recommended for use in children and adolescents (below 18 years old). Consult your doctor before taking the medicine. The most common side effects of taking ARFLUR 3D TABLET are abdominal pain, nausea, vomiting, diarrhea, flatulence, constipation, indigestion, and/or dizziness. Consult and inform your doctor if any of these side effects get worse.

introduction:
Introduction About IBUFYL PLUS SUSPENSION

IBUFYL PLUS SUSPENSION is a combination of Ibuprofen and Paracetamol, which belongs to the group of medicines called Non-steroidal anti-inflammatory (NSAIDs) and Analgesics respectively. It is indicated in the management of minor aches and pains and for reduction of fever.

Before taking this medicine, inform your doctor if you are allergic (hypersensitive) to ibuprofen, paracetamol, or any other NSAIDs such as aspirin.

Also tell the doctor if you have, liver, kidney, or heart problems. Pregnant and breastfeeding women should consult their doctors before taking the medicine.

The most common side effects are diarrhoea, nausea, vomiting, stomach pain, dizziness, and headache. Consult your doctor for advice if any of the above side effects worsen or persist for a longer duration.

IBUFYL PLUS SUSPENSION collectively works as non-steroidal anti-inflammatory (NSAIDs) and analgesic agent which works by inhibiting the effect of a chemical messenger called prostaglandins that are responsible for producing pain and inflammation. This blocks the Cox-enzyme (a natural substance produced in our body) thereby, restricting its action, which reduces the inflammation and pain at the site.

introduction:
Introduction About CALPOL 120MG SUSPENSION

Calpol 120 Strawberry Flavour Suspension is a Non-Steroidal Anti-Inflammatory agent which helps to reduce the high temperature (fever) and provide relief from mild to moderate pain in children. It contains the active ingredient Paracetamol.

Paracetamol provides analgesic (reduce pain) and antipyretic (reduce fever) effect by blocking the effects of prostaglandin (substance produced during injury and inflammation causing pain and increases the body temperature) and blocks the pain signals between the nerve endings and brain.

Always give Calpol 120 Strawberry Flavour Suspension as advised by your physician. The usual dose depends on the child’s age, body weight and health condition. Shake well before each use. Use a measuring cup given with the package for correct dosing. Do not exceed the recommended dosage. Do not give Calpol 120 Strawberry Flavour Suspension if your child is allergic to paracetamol. Consult your doctor for advice.

name: Crocin Pain Relief Tablet 15'S
introduction:
Introduction About CROCIN PAIN RELIEF TABLET

Crocin Pain Relief Tablet is a painkiller used to relieve mild to moderate pain like in headache, migraine, toothache and musculoskeletal pain. It contains paracetamol and caffeine as active ingredients that work together to exert a pain-relieving action.

Paracetamol inhibits the production of prostaglandin (chemical responsible for causing pain), primarily within the central nervous system. Caffeine have been proposed to result from several mechanisms like activation of pathways that constitute a pain suppressing system, and CNS stimulation with a consequent modification of a pain component.

Before taking Crocin Pain Relief Tablet, inform your doctor if you have any liver or kidney problems. It is not recommended for use in pregnant women, breastfeeding women and children (aged less than 12 years).

Avoid drinking too many caffeine containing drinks like tea or coffee with Crocin Pain Relief Tablet as high caffeine intake can result in sleeping problems, shaking and chest discomfort caused by fluttering heartbeat. Take it as advised by your doctor and do not take more than 4 tablets in a day.
sideEffectsDetails:
Side Effects Of CROCIN PAIN RELIEF TABLET

Crocin Pain Relief Tablet may cause skin peeling, mouth ulcers, or unexplained bruising or bleeding in some individuals. Consult your doctor if you notice any such side effects while taking it.

name: ARISTOMOL 120 Oral Suspension 60ml
introduction:
Introduction About ARISTOMOL 120 ORAL SUSPENSION

Aristomol Suspension is a painkiller and anti-pyretic medicine. It is used in children to temporarily relieve mild to moderate pain such as headache, toothache, migraine, nerve pain, sore throat, period pains and general aches and helps to reduce fever (high body temperature). Also, it relieves symptoms of cold and flu. It contains paracetamol as an active ingredient that reduces fever and pain.       

Paracetamol relieves pain by increasing the pain threshold by inhibiting certain enzymes (COX-1 and COX-2) involved in synthesis of chemicals responsible for inducing pain (prostaglandins). It reduces fever by directly acting on heat-regulating centers in the brain, resulting in vessel relaxation, sweating and loss of body heat.  

Always give Aristomol Suspension to your child as advised by the doctor. Shake well before use. Do not exceed the recommended daily dosage. Use a measuring cup to properly measure the dose. Do not give Aristomol Suspension to your child if your child is allergic to its active component.

name: Dolo Drops 15ml
introduction:
Introduction About DOLO DROPS

Dolo Drops are antipyretic and analgesic drops that are used in children to manage mild to moderate pain associated with the common cold, influenza, backache, headache, earache, muscle pain, sore throat, teething, toothache, and it is also used to reduce fever, including post-vaccination fever. It contains paracetamol as an active ingredient which blocks the pain and fever-causing mechanism in the body.

Paracetamol works by inhibiting the production of a chemical called prostaglandins in the body which is responsible for causing pain and swelling in the body. It reduces fever by affecting an area of the brain that is responsible for regulating our body temperature called the hypothalamic heat-regulating centre.

Give Dolo Drops to your child as directed by your doctor. It is for oral use only. Slowly dispense the prescribed dosage into your child’s mouth, towards the inner cheeks using the provided dropper.  Dolo Drops are not recommended for use in children who are suffering from severe liver impairment. It should be used with caution in children who having impaired kidney and liver function. It is not recommended for use in children less than 1 month of age.

introduction:
Introduction About LEEMOL ACTIV TABLET

LEEMOL ACTIV TABLET is a combination of Caffeine and Paracetamol, which belongs to the group of medicines called CNS stimulants, Analgesics, and Antipyretics respectively. It is effective in providing pain relief and in reducing fever.

It is used to manage headache, muscle pain, back pain, joint pain, nerve pain, period pain, tooth pain, and any other conditions that involve minor aches and pains for a temporary period. It can also be used to manage the symptoms of the common cold, fever, and sore throat.

LEEMOL ACTIV TABLET is suitable for use both in adults and in children (aged 12 years or above). Before taking LEEMOL ACTIV TABLET, inform your doctor if you have any liver, kidney, or heart problems. You must also inform your doctor if you have asthma, high blood pressure, anxiety, gout, or alcoholism as a precaution.

Do not take LEEMOL ACTIV TABLET without consulting your doctor if you have ulcers in the stomach or intestines, or if you are pregnant or breastfeeding. LEEMOL ACTIV TABLET is generally safe and well tolerated. However, it may cause gastric irritation in some patients when used continuously for a certain period. Consult your doctor if it troubles you.

mechanismOfAction:
How LEEMOL ACTIV TABLET Works

LEEMOL ACTIV TABLET contains two medicines, namely paracetamol and caffeine. Paracetamol is a pain-relieving medicine with fever-reducing properties. It reduces fever and pain sensations by blocking the release of certain chemicals within the body (such as prostaglandins) that cause fever, pain, inflammation, and swelling.

Caffeine is a brain stimulant. It reduces pain sensation by interfering with the pain signals traveling between the damaged nerves and the brain. It also improves the pain-relieving actions of paracetamol and reduces tiredness and boredom among the affected patients.

Interactions

A. Drug-Drug Interactions

Before taking LEEMOL ACTIV TABLET, inform your doctor if you are taking any of the following medicines, such as:

Medicines used to manage high blood pressure (such as captopril, enalapril, olmesartan, telmisartan, amlodipine, atenolol, and propranolol)
Medicines used to manage depression (Ex. citalopram, escitalopram, fluoxetine, fluvoxamine, paroxetine, and sertraline)
Other brain stimulant medicines (such as theophylline)
Medicines used to reduce anxiety and induce sleep (such as lorazepam, clonazepam, alprazolam, and midazolam)
Disulfiram (a medicine used to quit alcoholism)
Medicines used to manage the common cold and cough (such as ephedrine and phenylephrine)
Thyroxine (a medicine used to manage thyroid deficiency)
Other medicines containing paracetamol in combination
Phenytoin (a medicine used to manage epilepsy)
Methoxsalen (a medicine used for psoriasis)
Pipemidic acid (a medicine used to manage infections)
Domperidone, metoclopramide (medicines used for nausea and vomiting)
Cholestyramine (a medicine used to control blood cholesterol levels)
Medicines used for blood thinning (such as heparin, warfarin)
Flucloxacillin (an antibiotic)

B. Drug-food interactions

Avoid drinking tea, coffee, chocolate, or any other fizzy drinks containing caffeine while taking this medicine, as it may lead to caffeine toxicity.

Overdosage:

If you or anyone else took more of LEEMOL ACTIV TABLET, consult your doctor or go to a nearby hospital immediately. Symptoms of an overdose might include liver injury, upper stomach pain, vomiting, increased urination, fast heart rate, lack of sleep, restlessness, excitement, shakiness, and fits.

introduction:
Introduction About EMANZEN D TABLET

EMANZEN D TABLET is a combination of Diclofenac and Serratiopeptidase which belongs to a group of medicines called Nonsteroidal anti-inflammatory drugs and Proteolytic enzymes.  EMANZEN D TABLET is used in the management of pain and inflammatory conditions in adult patients. EMANZEN D TABLET is not recommended for use in patients allergic to diclofenac, aspirin, ibuprofen, other NSAIDs, and/or serratiopeptidase. EMANZEN D TABLET is also not recommended for use in patients with active gastric or intestinal ulcer/bleeding/perforation, active/previous history of recurrent peptic ulcer/hemorrhage, peripheral arterial disease (blood circulation disorder), severe liver/kidney impairment, and/or heart diseases (such as congestive heart failure, severe heart failure, ischemic heart disease). EMANZEN D TABLET is also not indicated for use to manage pain in patients who had undergone coronary artery bypass graft (CABG) surgery.

Before taking EMANZEN D TABLET inform your doctor if you had previously suffered from gastrointestinal ulceration, and/or have ulcerative colitis (inflammation of colon), mixed connective tissue disorders (such as systemic lupus erythematosus), diabetes, high blood pressure, lung problems (such as bronchial asthma, chronic obstructive pulmonary diseases), kidney problems (such as mild to moderate renal impairment), and/or liver problems (such as mild to moderate liver impairment).

EMANZEN D TABLET is generally not recommended for use during third trimester of pregnancy which is also not recommended for use in women planning for pregnancy. EMANZEN D TABLET should be used with caution during first and second trimester of pregnancy only if it is clearly necessary. EMANZEN D TABLET is also not recommended for use in breastfeeding women since it may pass through breastmilk. Consult your doctor before taking the medicine.

EMANZEN D TABLET is not recommended for use in children and adolescents (aged below 18 years) at higher doses which should be used with caution in children and adolescents (aged above 14 years) at lower doses after consulting the doctor. EMANZEN D TABLET should also be used with caution in elderly patients (aged above 65 years) after consulting the doctor. The most common side effects of taking EMANZEN D TABLET are headache, dizziness, abdominal pain, indigestion, nausea, vomiting, and/or diarrhea.  Consult your doctor if any of these symptoms worsen.

introduction:
Introduction About CENTAMOL 125MG SUSPENSION

Centamol-125 Suspension is a painkiller and anti-pyretic medicine. It is used in children to temporarily relieve mild to moderate pain such as headache, toothache, migraine, nerve pain, sore throat, period pains and general aches and helps to reduce fever (high body temperature). Also, it relieves symptoms of cold and flu. It contains paracetamol as an active ingredient that reduces fever and pain.  

Paracetamol relieves pain by increasing the pain threshold by inhibiting certain enzymes (COX-1 and COX-2) involved in synthesis of chemicals responsible for inducing pain (prostaglandins). It reduces fever by directly acting on heat-regulating centers in the brain, resulting in vessel relaxation, sweating and loss of body heat.

Always give Centamol-125 Suspension to your child as advised by the doctor. Shake well before use. Do not exceed the recommended daily dosage. Use a measuring cup to properly measure the dose. Before giving Centamol-125 Suspension to your child, consult child’s doctor for advice if your child is suffering from kidney or liver impairment.

introduction:
Introduction About SUPPOL CHILD 170MG SUPPOSITORY

Suppol Child Suppository is a painkiller and anti-pyretic medicine. It is used in children (aged 2-4 years) to provide instant relief from fever and pain of all origins. It contains paracetamol as an active ingredient to manage fever and pain in children, it is ideal when oral administration is inconvenient or not possible to take. 

Suppol (Paracetamol Suppository) which ensures accurate dosage with no wastage. unlike suspension or syrup, Suppol suppsitory is the better alternative to injectable – no pricks, no pain. Suppol suppository can be administered easily even when the child is sleeping.

Paracetamol relieves pain by increasing the pain threshold by inhibiting certain enzymes (COX-1 and COX-2) involved in synthesis of chemicals responsible for inducing pain (prostaglandins). It reduces fever by directly acting on heat-regulating centers in the brain, resulting in vessel relaxation, sweating and loss of body heat.    

Always administer Suppol Child Suppository to your child as advised by the physician. It is for rectal use only. Recommended dosage is 15mg/kg body weight in 4-6 divided doses and do not exceed 1 gm per dose and 60 mg/kg body weight in a day. For administration, gently push the suppository well up in to the rectum of your child. For grown up children suppository can be inserted in standing or sitting position. If needed, suppository can be moistened with water for easy insertion. Do not administer more than the recommended dosage as it may cause injury to the liver.

introduction:
Introduction About KETOFLAM SR TABLET

KETOFLAM SR TABLET contains Flupirtine which belongs to a group of medicines called Nonopioid, Non-NSAID analgesics. It is used in the management of acute and chronic pain (such as primary headache, tumor pain, menstrual cramps, pain after traumatologic/orthopaedic operations and injuries and painful increased muscle tone of the posture and motor muscles).  

KETOFLAM SR TABLET is not recommended for use in patients with liver problems. Before taking KETOFLAM SR TABLET, inform your doctor if you have kidney disease, myasthenia gravis, had or have a history of tinnitus (ringing in the ears) or if you are allergic to Flupirtine. KETOFLAM SR TABLET is not recommended for use in pregnant and breast-feeding women unless clearly advised by the doctor.

KETOFLAM SR TABLET is not recommended for use in children and adolescents (below 18 years of age) unless deemed necessary and it should be used with caution in elderly patients, especially in patients with kidney problems. The most common side effects of taking KETOFLAM SR TABLET are fatigue, dizziness, heartburn, nausea, vomiting, dry mouth, constipation and diarrhea. Consult your doctor if any of the side effects worsen.

introduction:
Introduction About ZELDINAC P TABLET

ZELDINAC P TABLET is a combination of Diclofenac and Paracetamol which belongs to the group of medicines called Non-steroidal Anti-inflammatory drugs (NSAIDs). It is used to manage various conditions associated with pain and inflammation such as rheumatoid arthritis (chronic inflammatory condition of joints), ankylosing spondylitis (chronic inflammatory disease of the spine) and osteoarthritis (degenerative joint disorder which is categorized by swelling, stiffness, and painful joints). ZELDINAC P TABLET can also be used in the management of ear and throat pain, muscle pain, back pain, tooth ache, mensural pain, post-operative or post -traumatic pain and also athletic injuries.

Your doctor may perform complete blood test especially in patients undergoing long term management with this medicine to know your existing condition. Along with the management your doctor may also monitor for signs and symptoms for gastrointestinal bleeding. Before taking ZELDINAC P TABLET, inform your doctor if you have blood clotting disorders, diabetes (high blood sugar), habit of smoking, or raised levels of cholesterol. Avoid consumption of alcohol while taking ZELDINAC P TABLET because it might aggravate your existing symptoms.

ZELDINAC P TABLET is not recommended for use in patients having kidney, liver or heart diseases, stomach or intestinal ulcers, gastrointestinal bleeding, or inflammatory intestinal disorders such as Crohn’s disease or ulcerative colitis. Consult your doctor before taking it. ZELDINAC P TABLET is not recommended for use in pregnant women especially in third trimester and in breastfeeding women. Consult your doctor before taking it. ZELDINAC P TABLET is not recommended for use in children below 10 years of age and should be used with caution in elderly patients (aged above 65 years). Consult your doctor before taking. The most common side-effects of ZELDINAC P TABLET are nausea, stomach pain, diarrhoea and indigestion. Consult your doctor if any of these side effects worsens or doesn’t improve.

faqs.question: Q: How does ZELDINAC P TABLET works on my body?
faqs.answer: A: ZELDINAC P TABLET acts as an anti-inflammatory agent as well as a painkiller. It works by inhibiting the production of a chemical called prostaglandins in the body. Which are responsible for causing pain and swelling in the body. As a result, it reduces various pain and swelling in joints.

faqs.question: Q: Is ZELDINAC P TABLET advised to be taken in pregnancy?
faqs.answer: A: No. ZELDINAC P TABLET is not recommended for use in pregnant women especially in the third trimester of pregnancy because it may cross the placenta and cause malformations in the fetus. Women of childbearing potential should use a suitable non-hormonal contraceptive method to avoid getting pregnant while taking ZELDINAC P TABLET. Consult your doctor before taking ZELDINAC P TABLET.

faqs.question: Q: Does ZELDINAC P TABLET affects my ability to drive?
faqs.answer: A: Do not drive or operate any machines if you feel headache, blurred vision, dizziness or drowsiness after taking ZELDINAC P TABLET. You can continue doing your activities as soon as you feel normal again.

faqs.question: Q: Can ZELDINAC P TABLET cause diarrhoea?
faqs.answer: A: Diarrhoea is the most common problem while taking ZELDINAC P TABLET and is occasionally severe. You have less chance of getting diarrhoea if you take ZELDINAC P TABLET with food. If you take an antacid (used to reduce acid in the stomach) you should avoid antacids with magnesium in them as these may make diarrhoea worse. Discuss with your doctor.

faqs.question: Q: Do I need to undergo any tests while taking ZELDINAC P TABLET?
faqs.answer: A: ZELDINAC P TABLET may lead to an increase in blood pressure and so, your doctor may advise you to monitor your blood pressure on a regular basis. If you have heart, liver or kidney problems, your doctor will advise regular monitoring of the same.

faqs.question: Q: Can ZELDINAC P TABLET be used in elderly patients?
faqs.answer: A: ZELDINAC P TABLET should be used with caution in elderly patients (aged above 65 years) because of the increased risk of side effects such as gastrointestinal (GI) adverse events, including inflammation, bleeding, ulceration and perforation of the stomach or intestines. Consult your doctor before taking ZELDINAC P TABLET.

Introduction About LEEMOL 650 TABLET

LEEMOL 650 TABLET contains Paracetamol which belongs to the group of medicines called Analgesics and Antipyretics. It is used to relieve mild to moderate pain (including headaches, backache, toothache, severe nerve pain, sore throat, period pain, low back and leg pain, muscle, connective tissue and joint pain, symptomatic relief of sprains, strain, joint swelling and stiffness). It is also used to lower fever (high body temperature) and relieves the symptoms of cold or flu.   

Before taking LEEMOL 650 TABLET, inform your doctor if you or your child have liver or kidney problems or any allergies. It should be used with caution in patients with liver problems due to alcohol to manage the risk of liver damage.

LEEMOL 650 TABLET should be used with caution in pregnant women only if clearly advised by the doctor and can be used in breastfeeding women. LEEMOL 650 TABLET is not recommended for use in children less than 10 years of age and should be used with caution in elderly patients.

Consult your doctor if you experience any side effects or unusual effects during management with LEEMOL 650 TABLET.

How LEEMOL 650 TABLET Works

LEEMOL 650 TABLET relieves pain by increasing the pain threshold by inhibiting certain enzymes (COX-1 and COX-2) involved in the synthesis of chemicals responsible for inducing pain (prostaglandins). It reduces fever by directly acting on heat-regulating centers in the brain, resulting in vessel relaxation, sweating and loss of body heat.

Take LEEMOL 650 TABLET as advised by your physician. It can be taken with or without food.

For Tablet, Capsule: Swallow LEEMOL 650 TABLET with a glass of water. Do not crush or chew the medicine.

For Dispersible Tablet: Disperse the medicine in the specified quantity of water as mentioned in the label. Consume the medicine immediately after reconstitution.

Your doctor will decide the correct dose and duration of therapy for you depending upon your age, body weight and severity of the condition.

introduction:
Introduction About ACECLOREN P TABLET

ACECLOREN P TABLET is used for pain management associated with osteoarthritis, rheumatoid arthritis and ankylosing spondylitis. It can also be used to reduce pain caused due to sprains, strains, sports injuries, tendon pain, bone fracture pain and minor surgical and other pains. It is a combination of Aceclofenac + Paracetamol which are pain relieving agents.

Take ACECLOREN P TABLET after food to avoid gastric irritation. Do not take this medicine more than the duration recommended by your doctor. Before taking this medicine inform your doctor if you are having any liver, kidney or heart problems. You must also inform your doctor if you have stomach ulcers, gut inflammation, inflammatory bowel diseases or chronic alcoholism, or if you are pregnant or breastfeeding as a precaution.

The most common side effects of taking ACECLOREN P TABLET are indigestion, stomach pain, bloating and headache which can be managed by taking this medicine with meals and by following simple diet with less spicy food and limiting alcohol consumption.

mechanismOfAction:
How ACECLOREN P TABLET Works

ACECLOREN P TABLET contains aceclofenac and paracetamol which works together to relieve pain and inflammation. Aceclofenac is a non-steroidal anti-inflammatory drug (NSAID) that blocks enzymes called cyclooxygenase (COX) enzymes, reducing the production of chemicals called prostaglandins, which are responsible for causing pain and inflammation.

Paracetamol, on the other hand, works by reducing the perception of pain in the brain and also helps lower fever by acting on the heat-regulating centers in the brain. Together, they provide stronger pain relief and reduce inflammation.

The usual dose is one tablet 1-2 times a day, depending on the condition being treated and your doctor's instructions.
Do not exceed the prescribed dose, and follow the timing as recommended for the best results.
Always consult your doctor for personalized advice on dosage and duration.

warnings.details: ACECLOREN P TABLET should be used in pregnant women only after consulting your doctor.
ACECLOREN P TABLET should be used in breastfeeding women only after consulting your doctor.
Do not take ACECLOREN P TABLET while driving or operating machines since it may cause blurred vision, dizziness and/or drowsiness.

ACECLOREN P TABLET is not recommended for use in patients with kidney problems such as severely impaired renal organ function. It should be used with caution in patients with kidney problems such as mild hepatic impairment.
ACECLOREN P TABLET is not recommended for use in patients with liver problems such as severely impaired hepatic function.
Do not take ACECLOREN P TABLET if you are allergic (hypersensitive) to aceclofenac, paracetamol and/or other ingredients of this medicine.
ACECLOREN P TABLET is not recommended for use in patients with lung problems such as asthma, bronchospasm.
ACECLOREN P TABLET is not recommended for use in patients with heart problems such as severe heart failure.
ACECLOREN P TABLET should be used in children aged above 6 years after doctor consultation. It is not suitable for use in children aged below 6 years due to lack of safety data.
ACECLOREN P TABLET should be used with caution in elderly patients (aged 65 years and above). Consult your doctor before taking this medicine.

Others

Before taking ACECLOREN P TABLET, inform your doctor if you:

A history of gastrointestinal ulceration (stomach ulcer)
Have inflammatory bowel disease like (ulcerative colitis /Crohn’s disease)
Bleeding diathesis (increased susceptibility of bleeding/bruising)
Haematological abnormalities

Before receiving NEOMOL I.V INFUSION, inform your doctor if you have heart, lung, liver or kidney problems or if you suffer from alcoholism or alcohol abuse, malnourishment and severely low blood volume due to dehydration or blood loss.

NEOMOL I.V INFUSION should be used with caution in pregnant and breastfeeding women only if clearly advised by the doctor. NEOMOL I.V INFUSION should be used with caution in children and elderly patients.

The most common side effects of receiving NEOMOL I.V INFUSION are nausea, vomiting, headache, sleep problems and itching. Inform your doctor if any of these side effect worsens.

It is indicated in post-surgical pain, dental pain, pain associated with muscle spasm, cancer pain, neuropathic pain, low back pain and migraine.

Avoid consumption of alcohol while taking FLUGESIC P TABLET as it increases the risk of liver damage.

FLUGESIC P TABLET is not recommended for use in patients with liver or kidney diseases. Contact your doctor before taking.

FLUGESIC P TABLET is not recommended for use in breastfeeding women as it may pass through the breast milk. Contact your doctor before taking.

FLUGESIC P TABLET is not recommended for use in children and adolescents under 18 years of age. Contact your doctor before taking.

FLUGESIC P TABLET is not recommended for use in elderly patients aged 65 years or above. Contact your doctor before taking.

The most common side effects of this medicine are nausea, vomiting, abdominal discomfort, diarrhoea, constipation, heartburn, flatulence, dry mouth, headache, drowsiness, dizziness, fatigue, disorientation or shaking (tremors), hallucinations. Contact your physician if any of the above side effects worsen.

introduction:
Introduction About BABYGESIC 250MG ORAL SUSPENSION

Babygesic 250 suspension is an analgesic (relieves pain) and antipyretic (reduces fever) medicine that is used in children to manage fever and mild to moderate pain such as headache, migraine, nerve pain, toothache, sore throat, general body pains. It is also used to relieve symptoms of cold and flu. It contains Paracetamol as an active ingredient.

Paracetamol blocks the release of chemical messengers in the brain that regulate pain and inflammation. It also acts on the hypothalamus (heat regulating centre) in brain and decreases fever.

Always give Babygesic 250 suspension to your child exactly as advised by your child’s doctor. Shake well before use. Do not exceed the daily recommended dosages. Before giving Babygesic 250 suspension inform your child’s doctor if /he or she has liver or kidney diseases, fructose, or any other sugar intolerance.

name: Iconac Spt Tablet 10'S
introduction:
Introduction About ICONAC SPT TABLET

ICONAC SPT TABLET is used to relieve inflammation and pain due to bone and soft tissue injuries in affected individuals. It is also used to reduce high temperatures and provide relief from cold (while sneezing) in affected individuals. This medicine is also indicated for use to resolve post-operative inflammation, oedema, and pain. It is also used to provide relief from illnesses such as headaches, moderate migraines, and musculoskeletal pain.

ICONAC SPT TABLET is a combination of Aceclofenac, Paracetamol, and Serratiopeptidase, which belong to the group of medicines called Nonsteroidal anti-inflammatory agents, Analgesics and Antipyretics, and Proteolytic enzymes, respectively. It helps to reduce pain and inflammation by blocking certain chemical messengers in the brain, and it also promotes healing by breaking down abnormal proteins at the site of inflammation, thereby healing the infected site.

ICONAC SPT TABLET is not recommended for use in patients allergic to Aceclofenac, Paracetamol, or Serratiopeptidase. It is also not recommended for use in patients with active or recurrent peptic ulcers or haemorrhages (bleeding), severe heart, liver, or kidney diseases. Before taking ICONAC SPT TABLET, inform your doctor if you suffer from uncontrolled high blood pressure, diabetes, hyperlipidaemia (high-fat level in the blood), gastrointestinal diseases such as ulcerative colitis (inflammatory bowel disease), and/or aseptic meningitis (inflammation of the brain).

ICONAC SPT TABLET is not recommended for use by pregnant and breastfeeding women. It is also not recommended for use in children and adolescents (below 18 years old). Consult your doctor before taking the medicine. The most common side effects of taking ICONAC SPT TABLET are abdominal pain, nausea, vomiting, diarrhea, flatulence, constipation, indigestion, and/or dizziness. Consult and inform your doctor if any of these side effects get worse.

introduction:
Introduction About PACINOVA DS ORAL SUSPENSION

Pacinova-DS Oral Suspension is a painkiller and anti-pyretic medicine. It is used to manage pyrexia (including recurrent fever), body ache and traumatic injury in children. It contains paracetamol as an active ingredient that reduces fever and pain.

Paracetamol relieves pain by increasing the pain threshold by inhibiting certain enzymes (COX-1 and COX-2) involved in synthesis of chemicals responsible for inducing pain (prostaglandins). It reduces fever by directly acting on heat-regulating centers in the brain, resulting in vessel relaxation, sweating and loss of body heat.

Always give Pacinova-DS Oral Suspension to your child as advised by the doctor. Shake well before use. Do not exceed the recommended daily dosage. Use a measuring cup to properly measure the dose. Do not give Pacinova-DS Oral Suspension to your child if your child is allergic to any of its components.

name: Acezon Tablet 10'S
introduction:
Introduction About ACEZON TABLET

ACEZON TABLET is a combination of Chlorzoxazone and Paracetamol which belongs to the group of medicines called Muscle relaxants and Analgesics respectively. It is used to manage muscular pains and spasms. It can also be used to provide relief from joint pain (Ex. osteoarthritis, rheumatoid arthritis), back pain (Ex. ankylosing spondylitis) and neck pain.

Take ACEZON TABLET preferably with meals to avoid gut irritation. Avoid consumption of alcohol as it could aggravate the risk of stomach problems. Do not take ACEZON TABLET if you have any ulcers, bleeding or perforations in the gut.

Before taking ACEZON TABLET inform your doctor if you have any liver or kidney problems. You must also inform your doctor if you have asthma, alcoholism, any eating disorder or any disease that causes loss of skeletal muscles and fats (such as cachexia) as a precaution.

Consult your doctor before taking ACEZON TABLET if you are pregnant or breastfeeding. The common side effects of taking ACEZON TABLET are stomach upset and orangish urine. Consult your doctor if any of these side effect worsens.

usesDetails:
Uses Of ACEZON TABLET

It is used to manage:

Muscle pain and spasms
Joint pain, back pain, neck pain
mechanismOfAction:
How ACEZON TABLET Works

ACEZON TABLET contains two medicines namely Chlorzoxazone and paracetamol. Chlorzoxazone is a muscle relaxant. It acts by increasing the effects of certain chemical messengers (such as GABA) in the brain and in spinal cord that induces muscle relaxation. As a result, it manages muscle twitching, relieves pain caused due to muscle spasms and improves muscle movement.

Paracetamol is a pain-relieving agent. It provides pain relief by blocking the release of certain chemicals (such as prostaglandins) in the body that causes pain, inflammation and swelling. Collectively, these action helps in reducing muscle spasms, joint pain and inflammation.

Your doctor will decide the correct dose and duration of therapy for you depending upon your age, body weight and disease condition.

introduction:
Introduction About ZACY SP TABLET

ZACY SP TABLET is used to relieve inflammation and pain due to bone and soft tissue injuries in affected individuals. It is also used to reduce high temperatures and provide relief from cold (while sneezing) in affected individuals. This medicine is also indicated for use to resolve post-operative inflammation, oedema, and pain. It is also used to provide relief from illnesses such as headaches, moderate migraines, and musculoskeletal pain.

ZACY SP TABLET is a combination of Aceclofenac, Paracetamol, and Serratiopeptidase, which belong to the group of medicines called Nonsteroidal anti-inflammatory agents, Analgesics and Antipyretics, and Proteolytic enzymes, respectively. It helps to reduce pain and inflammation by blocking certain chemical messengers in the brain, and it also promotes healing by breaking down abnormal proteins at the site of inflammation, thereby healing the infected site.

ZACY SP TABLET is not recommended for use in patients allergic to Aceclofenac, Paracetamol, or Serratiopeptidase. It is also not recommended for use in patients with active or recurrent peptic ulcers or haemorrhages (bleeding), severe heart, liver, or kidney diseases. Before taking ZACY SP TABLET, inform your doctor if you suffer from uncontrolled high blood pressure, diabetes, hyperlipidaemia (high-fat level in the blood), gastrointestinal diseases such as ulcerative colitis (inflammatory bowel disease), and/or aseptic meningitis (inflammation of the brain).

ZACY SP TABLET is not recommended for use by pregnant and breastfeeding women. It is also not recommended for use in children and adolescents (below 18 years old). Consult your doctor before taking the medicine. The most common side effects of taking ZACY SP TABLET are abdominal pain, nausea, vomiting, diarrhea, flatulence, constipation, indigestion, and/or dizziness. Consult and inform your doctor if any of these side effects get worse.

introduction:
Introduction About PARALYF DS SUSPENSION

Paralyf DS Suspension belongs to analgesic and antipyretic, used for mild to moderate pain including headache, migraine, nerve pain, toothache, sore throat and general aches and pains. It is also used to relieve the symptoms of cold and flu. It is also used to help reduce a fever (high temperature). It contains Paracetamol as an active ingredient.

Paracetamol acts as an analgesic, and antipyretic, which works by inhibiting the cyclooxygenase, COX-1 and COX-2 which are involved in prostaglandin (PG) synthesis. Thus, helps to reduce pain and fever.

Always take Paralyf DS Suspension as advised by the physician. Shake well before use. Taking Paralyf DS Suspension more than daily dose may cause serious liver damage or allergic reactions (swelling of the face, mouth and throat, difficulty in breathing, itching or rash). Do not take if you are allergic to paracetamol.

introduction:
Introduction About SUMOL 650MG TABLET

SUMOL 650MG TABLET contains Paracetamol which belongs to the group of medicines called Analgesics and Antipyretics. It is used to relieve mild to moderate pain (including headaches, backache, toothache, severe nerve pain, sore throat, period pain, low back and leg pain, muscle, connective tissue and joint pain, symptomatic relief of sprains, strain, joint swelling and stiffness). It is also used to lower fever (high body temperature) and relieves the symptoms of cold or flu.   

Before taking SUMOL 650MG TABLET, inform your doctor if you or your child have liver or kidney problems or any allergies. It should be used with caution in patients with liver problems due to alcohol to manage the risk of liver damage.

SUMOL 650MG TABLET should be used with caution in pregnant women only if clearly advised by the doctor and can be used in breastfeeding women. SUMOL 650MG TABLET is not recommended for use in children less than 10 years of age and should be used with caution in elderly patients.

Consult your doctor if you experience any side effects or unusual effects during management with SUMOL 650MG TABLET.

mechanismOfAction:
How SUMOL 650MG TABLET Works

SUMOL 650MG TABLET relieves pain by increasing the pain threshold by inhibiting certain enzymes (COX-1 and COX-2) involved in the synthesis of chemicals responsible for inducing pain (prostaglandins). It reduces fever by directly acting on heat-regulating centers in the brain, resulting in vessel relaxation, sweating and loss of body heat.
usageDetails:
How to use SUMOL 650MG TABLET

Take SUMOL 650MG TABLET as advised by your physician. It can be taken with or without food.

For Tablet, Capsule: Swallow SUMOL 650MG TABLET with a glass of water. Do not crush or chew the medicine.

For Dispersible Tablet: Disperse the medicine in the specified quantity of water as mentioned in the label. Consume the medicine immediately after reconstitution.

Your doctor will decide the correct dose and duration of therapy for you depending upon your age, body weight and severity of the condition.

introduction:
Introduction About MEFNIWEL P TABLET

MEFNIWEL P TABLET is a combination of Mefenamic acid and Paracetamol, which belongs to a group of medicines called Non-steroidal Anti-inflammatory Drugs (NSAIDs) and Analgesics and Antipyretics. It is used to manage fever. It is also used for the management of mild to moderate pain, such as headaches, toothaches, joint or muscle pains, and period pain.

MEFNIWEL P TABLET is not recommended for use in patients with asthma or aspirin-sensitive asthma, kidney or liver disease, or heart failure. Contact your doctor before taking.

Pregnant women should generally avoid using MEFNIWEL P TABLET. Contact your doctor before taking.

MEFNIWEL P TABLET is generally not recommended for use in breastfeeding women as it may pass through the breast milk. Contact your doctor before taking it.

MEFNIWEL P TABLET is not recommended for use in children. Contact your doctor before taking.

MEFNIWEL P TABLET should be used with caution in elderly patients (aged 65 years or above). Contact your doctor before taking.

The most common side effects of this medicine are nausea, vomiting, abdominal pain, diarrhea, constipation, indigestion, flatulence, anorexia, dry mouth, heartburn, peptic ulcers, perforation or GI bleeding, and ulcerative stomatitis. Contact your doctor if any of the above side effects worsen.

Introduction About PACINOVA ORAL SUSPENSION

Pacinova Oral Suspension is a painkiller and anti-pyretic medicine. It is used to manage pyrexia (including recurrent fever), body ache and traumatic injury in children. It contains paracetamol as an active ingredient that reduces fever and pain.

Paracetamol relieves pain by increasing the pain threshold by inhibiting certain enzymes (COX-1 and COX-2) involved in synthesis of chemicals responsible for inducing pain (prostaglandins). It reduces fever by directly acting on heat-regulating centers in the brain, resulting in vessel relaxation, sweating and loss of body heat.

Always give Pacinova Oral Suspension to your child as advised by the doctor. Shake well before use. Do not exceed the recommended daily dosage as it may cause serious liver damage or allergic reactions. Use a measuring cup to properly measure the dose. Do not give Pacinova Oral Suspension to your child if your child is allergic to any of its components.

Paracetamol helps in relieving pain and fever and other symptoms due to its ability to inhibit pain and inflammation pathways in the body, which results in the decrease in the secretion of Prostaglandins, which elicits the pain response in body. Hence, 99f 650 Tablet effectively reduces the pain sensation and fever in the body.

99f 650 Tablet is to be taken as advised by your doctor. It is for oral administration. Do not crush or chew it. Also, take 99f 650 Tablet only after consultation from doctor if you are pregnant, nursing, planning pregnancy and are diagnosed with liver disease. Do not take it if you are already taking any other medication containing acetaminophen and/or are taking blood thinners like warfarin.

introduction:
Introduction About ALCINAC RB CAPSULE

ALCINAC RB CAPSULE is a combination of Aceclofenac and Rabeprazole which belongs to the group of medicines called Analgesics and Proton pump inhibitors respectively. It is used to manage inflammation and relive pain in conditions like rheumatoid arthritis (autoimmune disease that causes inflammation in the joints), osteoarthritis (loss of the cartilage and bone tissue causing joint pain), back pain or postsurgical pain.

Do not use ALCINAC RB CAPSULE if you are allergic to other NSAIDs like ibuprofen or aspirin. Before taking ALCINAC RB CAPSULE, inform your doctor if you have a history of stomach ulcer or tumour, have vomited blood, passed blood in faeces, have any kidney, heart, liver, bowel or blood clotting problems, porphyria, diabetes, chicken pox or if you have undergone any bypass surgery.

Avoid smoking while taking ALCINAC RB CAPSULE. ALCINAC RB CAPSULE is not recommended for use in pregnant women, breast-feeding women, children and adolescents (under 18 years of age) so, consult your doctor for advice.

The most common side effects of taking ALCINAC RB CAPSULE are headache, nausea, vomiting, pain or discomfort right below your ribs, gastrointestinal irritation or bleeding, diarrhoea, constipation and stomach pain. Consult your doctor if any of the symptoms worsen over time.

introduction:
Introduction About PACIMOL ACTIVE TABLET

PACIMOL ACTIVE TABLET is a combination of Caffeine and Paracetamol, which belongs to the group of medicines called CNS stimulants, Analgesics, and Antipyretics respectively. It is effective in providing pain relief and in reducing fever.

It is used to manage headache, muscle pain, back pain, joint pain, nerve pain, period pain, tooth pain, and any other conditions that involve minor aches and pains for a temporary period. It can also be used to manage the symptoms of the common cold, fever, and sore throat.

PACIMOL ACTIVE TABLET is suitable for use both in adults and in children (aged 12 years or above). Before taking PACIMOL ACTIVE TABLET, inform your doctor if you have any liver, kidney, or heart problems. You must also inform your doctor if you have asthma, high blood pressure, anxiety, gout, or alcoholism as a precaution.

Do not take PACIMOL ACTIVE TABLET without consulting your doctor if you have ulcers in the stomach or intestines, or if you are pregnant or breastfeeding. PACIMOL ACTIVE TABLET is generally safe and well tolerated. However, it may cause gastric irritation in some patients when used continuously for a certain period. Consult your doctor if it troubles you.

mechanismOfAction:
How PACIMOL ACTIVE TABLET Works

PACIMOL ACTIVE TABLET contains two medicines, namely paracetamol and caffeine. Paracetamol is a pain-relieving medicine with fever-reducing properties. It reduces fever and pain sensations by blocking the release of certain chemicals within the body (such as prostaglandins) that cause fever, pain, inflammation, and swelling.

Caffeine is a brain stimulant. It reduces pain sensation by interfering with the pain signals traveling between the damaged nerves and the brain. It also improves the pain-relieving actions of paracetamol and reduces tiredness and boredom among the affected patients.

Take PACIMOL ACTIVE TABLET as advised by your physician. Swallow the medicine with a glass of water. Do not crush or chew the medicine.

Your doctor will decide the correct dose and duration of therapy for you depending upon your age, body weight, and disease condition.

introduction:
Introduction About COLDMINE DROPS

COLDMINE DROPS is a combination of Chlorpheniramine, Paracetamol and Phenylephrine which belongs to the group of medicines called Antihistamines, Analgesics and Nasal decongestants respectively. It is used to relieve the symptoms of allergic rhinitis (hay fever), common cold, other upper respiratory allergies, like headache, facial congestion and pressure, nasal congestion, runny nose, sneezing, minor aches and pains, itching of the nose, throat, or eyes, and watery eyes. It can also be used as an adjunct with antibiotics in sinusitis (inflammation of cavities around your nose), tonsillitis (inflammation of tonsils), and otitis media (inflammation inside the middle ear). Hay fever is a seasonal allergy that occurs in response to specific allergens like pollens, present at certain times of the year (spring or fall) and causes more short-term symptoms.

COLDMINE DROPS is not recommended for use in children (aged less than 2 months). Consult your doctor for advice. Before taking COLDMINE DROPS, inform your doctor if you have any kidney, liver, heart, thyroid, or lung problems, diabetes, or glaucoma. Consult your doctor for advice. COLDMINE DROPS should be used with caution in pregnant and breastfeeding women, so consult your doctor before taking it.

The most common side effects of taking COLDMINE DROPS are vomiting, nausea, allergic reaction, sleepiness, and headache. Contact your doctor if any of the above side effects worsen.

mechanismOfAction:
How COLDMINE DROPS Works

COLDMINE DROPS relieves upper respiratory symptoms where Chlorpheniramine binds to the histamine H1 receptor and blocks its action, resulting in temporary relief of the negative symptoms (runny nose, sneezing, watery and itchy eyes) brought on by histamine. Paracetamol relieves pain by elevation of the pain threshold and reduces fever by acting on the on the heat-regulating centre in your brain. Phenylephrine constricts blood vessels and reduces the blood flow to certain areas, thus decreasing swelling and allowing nasal and respiratory passages to open up.

How to use COLDMINE DROPS

Take COLDMINE DROPS as advised by your physician. Shake well before use. Your doctor will decide the correct dose and duration for you depending upon your age, body weight and disease condition.

introduction:
Introduction About DOMSTAL NP 250 TABLET

DOMSTAL NP 250 TABLET is a combination of Domperidone and Naproxen, which belong to the groups of medicines called antiemetics and NSAIDs (non-steroidal anti-inflammatory drugs), respectively. It is used to manage the symptoms of migraine, menstrual migraine, and chronic daily headaches associated with nausea and vomiting.

A migraine is a recurring headache that often involves one side of the head and causes severe pain that is pulsating or throbbing and is accompanied by nausea, weakness, and sensitivity to sound and light.

DOMSTAL NP 250 TABLET is not recommended in patients with severe liver, kidney, or heart problems, stomach ulcers, bleeding in the stomach or intestine, intestinal tears, or pituitary gland tumours. DOMSTAL NP 250 TABLET should be taken with caution in patients with lung disease, diabetes, high cholesterol, systemic lupus erythematosus, a blood clotting disorder, a history of gastrointestinal diseases, and a habit of drinking or smoking.

DOMSTAL NP 250 TABLET is not recommended for use during pregnancy, while breastfeeding, or in children less than 5 years old. It should be used with caution in elderly patients (those over the age of 60). The common side effect of taking DOMSTAL NP 250 TABLET may include dry mouth. Consult your doctor immediately if your symptoms get worse or persist.

mechanismOfAction:
How DOMSTAL NP 250 TABLET Works

DOMSTAL NP 250 TABLET effectively manages migraine, which is commonly associated with nausea and vomiting, by blocking the centres in the brain and stomach that regulate nausea and vomiting. It also increases the contractions and movements in the stomach. DOMSTAL NP 250 TABLET stops the pain pathways and reduces the release of substances (prostaglandins) that cause inflammation, thus decreasing pain and inflammation.

Take DOMSTAL NP 250 TABLET as advised by your physician. Swallow the medicine with a glass of water. Do not crush or chew the medicine. Your doctor will decide the correct dose and duration of DOMSTAL NP 250 TABLET for you depending on your age, body weight and disease condition.

Introduction About MEDOMOL BISCUIT FLAVOUR 120 ORAL SUSPENSION

Medomol Biscuit Flavour 120 Oral Suspension is an analgesic and antipyretic medicine used to manage fever, mild to moderate pain, tooth pain and post vaccination pain. It contains Paracetamol as an active ingredient.

Paracetamol manages fever by directly acting on the heat-regulating centres of our brain. This leads to dilation of blood vessels of peripheral body causing sweating and loss of body heat. It inhibits the specific pathways that are necessary for activating the pain mechanism. It does this by the suppressing the synthesis of prostaglandins (pain causing chemicals) at the affected site.

Always give Medomol Biscuit Flavour 120 Oral Suspension as advised by your doctor. Shake well before use. It is for paediatric use. Do not exceed the recommended daily dosage. Do not give if your child is allergic to paracetamol.

name: MAGADOL Oral Suspension 60ml
introduction:
Introduction About MAGADOL ORAL SUSPENSION

MAGADOL ORAL SUSPENSION contains Paracetamol which belongs to the group of medicines called Analgesics and Antipyretics. It is used to relieve mild to moderate pain like headache, migraine, nerve pain, toothache, sore throat, period pains, teething, immunisation, earache, and general aches and pains. It can also be used to manage fever (high temperature), and symptoms of cold or flu.

Before taking MAGADOL ORAL SUSPENSION, inform your doctor if you have liver or kidney problems, fructose intolerance, Gilberts syndrome, glucose-6-phosphate dehydrogenase deficiency, hemolytic anaemia, reduced glutathione levels, malnourishment, dehydration or if you weigh less than 50 kg.

MAGADOL ORAL SUSPENSION should be used in pregnant women only if considered necessary. Avoid consumption of alcohol during management with MAGADOL ORAL SUSPENSION, as it might make you more prone to side effects.

MAGADOL ORAL SUSPENSION is not recommended for use in children (2-3 months old, weighing less than 4 kg or born before 37 weeks). Contact your doctor if you get any side effects of any of the symptoms get worse.
uses: Relieves mild to moderate pain, fever, and symptoms of cold or flu
usesDetails:
Uses Of MAGADOL ORAL SUSPENSION
Relieves mild to moderate pain, fever, and symptoms of cold or flu
mechanismOfAction:
How MAGADOL ORAL SUSPENSION Works

MAGADOL ORAL SUSPENSION relieves pain by increasing the pain threshold by inhibiting certain enzymes (COX-1 and COX-2) involved in synthesis of chemicals responsible for inducing pain (prostaglandins). It reduces fever by directly acting on heat-regulating centers in the brain, resulting in vessel relaxation, sweating, and loss of body heat.
usageDetails:
How to use MAGADOL ORAL SUSPENSION

Take MAGADOL ORAL SUSPENSION as advised by your physician. Shake well before use. Your doctor will decide the correct dose and duration for you based upon your age, body weight and disease condition.
