MAGADOL ORAL SUSPENSION should be used in breastfeeding women only if considered necessary. Consult your doctor before taking it.
Consult your doctor if you feel any side effect during management with MAGADOL ORAL SUSPENSION that may stop you from driving or using machines.
Avoid consumption of alcohol while taking MAGADOL ORAL SUSPENSION. Before taking MAGADOL ORAL SUSPENSION, inform your doctor if you have chronic alcoholism.
MAGADOL ORAL SUSPENSION should be used with caution in patients with severe kidney problems. Consult your doctor before taking it.

MAGADOL ORAL SUSPENSION should be used with caution in patients with severe liver problems, liver problems due to excessive alcohol intake, or have Gilberts syndrome (liver doesn't process bilirubin properly). Consult your doctor before taking it.
Do not take MAGADOL ORAL SUSPENSION if you are allergic to Paracetamol or any of the other ingredients of this medicine.

Others

Before taking MAGADOL ORAL SUSPENSION, inform your doctor if you:

Have fructose intolerance or any other type of sugar intolerance
Have sepsis (circulation of bacteria and their toxins in the blood leading to organ damage)
Are malnourished
Are glucose-6-phosphate dehydrogenase deficient (enzyme deficiency)
Have haemolytic anaemia (decreased red blood cells which can make the skin pale yellow and cause weakness or breathlessness)
Have reduced glutathione levels
Are dehydrated or weigh less than 50 kg

Use in pediatrics:

MAGADOL ORAL SUSPENSION is not recommended for use in children (2-3 months old, weighing less than 4 kg or born before 37 weeks). Consult your doctor before taking it.

Use in geriatrics:

MAGADOL ORAL SUSPENSION should be used with caution in elderly patients. Consult your doctor before taking it.

name: Leemol DC Syrup 60ml
introduction:
Introduction About LEEMOL DC SYRUP

LEEMOL DC SYRUP is a combination of Dicyclomine, and Paracetamol which belongs to the group of medicines called Antispasmodics, Analgesic and Anti-pyretic respectively. It is used to manage functional bowel disease and irritable bowel syndrome (IBS), intestinal colic, stomach cramps, infantile colic, renal and biliary colic, worm colic, non-specific abdominal pain, spasmodic dysmenorrhea as well as pain from gynaecologic or surgical conditions.

Avoid consumption of alcohol while taking LEEMOL DC SYRUP, as it may increase the side effects. LEEMOL DC SYRUP is not recommended in patients with unstable cardiovascular condition with acute haemorrhage, myasthenia gravis, glaucoma, obstructive uropathy, obstructive disease of the gastrointestinal tract, severe ulcerative colitis, reflux esophagitis.

LEEMOL DC SYRUP should be used with caution in patients with asthma, liver disease, cirrhosis, kidney disease, hypertension, coronary heart disease, congestive heart failure, and cardiac tachyarrhythmia, psychosis, and delirium (such as elderly patients and/or in patients with mental illness), incomplete intestinal obstruction (small intestine partially or totally blocked).

LEEMOL DC SYRUP should be also used with caution in patients with salmonella dysentery, ulcerative colitis (inflammatory bowel disease), prostatic hypertrophy (prostate gland enlargement), autonomic neuropathy (injury to the nerves that regulate automatic body functions), hypothyroidism, hiatal hernia, suffered from alcoholism, malnutrition, arthritis or must take painkillers often, infection, glucose-6-phosphatedehydrogenase deficiency, haemolytic anaemia (breakdown of red blood cells), bleeding problems.

LEEMOL DC SYRUP should be used during pregnancy, if considered necessary. LEEMOL DC SYRUP is not recommended for use by breastfeeding women and in infants less than 6 months of age. LEEMOL DC SYRUP should be used with caution in elderly patients.

The most common side effects of taking LEEMOL DC SYRUP are hypersensitivity reactions, dry mouth, upset stomach, vomiting, constipation and gas or bloating. Contact your doctor if any of the symptoms got worse.

How LEEMOL DC SYRUP Works

LEEMOL DC SYRUP is an antispasmodic works by relaxing the muscles in your stomach and gut (intestine). It manages unexpected muscular contractions (spasms). It also reduces bloating, pain, cramps, and discomfort. Paracetamol is analgesics and antipyretic as well works by inhibiting both COX-1 and COX-2 enzyme and manages prostaglandin synthesis, thus reliefs pain.

name: PACIMOL MF 125mg Suspension 60ml
introduction:
Introduction About PACIMOL MF 125MG SUSPENSION

PACIMOL MF 125MG SUSPENSION is a combination of Mefenamic acid and Paracetamol, which belongs to a group of medicines called Non-steroidal Anti-inflammatory Drugs (NSAIDs) and Analgesics and Antipyretics. It is indicated for the management of fever in children. It is also used for the management of mild to moderate pain such as headache, toothache, joint or muscle pain, and period pain.

PACIMOL MF 125MG SUSPENSION is not recommended for use in patients with asthma or aspirin-sensitive asthma, severe liver, kidney, or heart disease. Contact your doctor before taking.

PACIMOL MF 125MG SUSPENSION is generally not recommended for use in pregnant women. Contact your doctor before taking.

introduction:
Introduction About FLUPIRZA 100MG CAPSULE

FLUPIRZA 100MG CAPSULE contains Flupirtine which belongs to a group of medicines called Nonopioid, Non-NSAID analgesics. It is used in the management of acute and chronic pain (such as primary headache, tumor pain, menstrual cramps, pain after traumatologic/orthopaedic operations and injuries and painful increased muscle tone of the posture and motor muscles).  

FLUPIRZA 100MG CAPSULE is not recommended for use in patients with liver problems. Before taking FLUPIRZA 100MG CAPSULE, inform your doctor if you have kidney disease, myasthenia gravis, had or have a history of tinnitus (ringing in the ears) or if you are allergic to Flupirtine. FLUPIRZA 100MG CAPSULE is not recommended for use in pregnant and breast-feeding women unless clearly advised by the doctor.

FLUPIRZA 100MG CAPSULE is not recommended for use in children and adolescents (below 18 years of age) unless deemed necessary and it should be used with caution in elderly patients, especially in patients with kidney problems. The most common side effects of taking FLUPIRZA 100MG CAPSULE are fatigue, dizziness, heartburn, nausea, vomiting, dry mouth, constipation and diarrhea. Consult your doctor if any of the side effects worsen.

FLUPIRZA 100MG CAPSULE works by managing the transmission of pain signals by blocking neuronal excitability and reducing the calcium influx into the cells that is responsible for the sense of pain and inflammation produced at the site of injury and damage and hence it is useful in providing relief from pain, including that is associated with muscle tension.

name: THIOFORD PLUS Cream 15gm
introduction:
Introduction About THIOFORD PLUS CREAM

THIOFORD PLUS CREAM is a combination of Diclofenac, Linseed Oil, Menthol, Methyl Salicylate, and Thiocolchicoside which belongs to the group of medicines called Non-steroidal Anti-inflammatory Drug (NSAID), Cooling agents and Muscle Relaxant respectively. It is used to relieve muscle pain and spasms. It provides fast and lasting relief from back pain, osteoarthritis pain, rheumatologic disorders, and related conditions. This medicine is non-greasy and non-staining formulation, which gets absorbed quickly and has fast pain-relieving action.

Avoid exposure to the sun after using THIOFORD PLUS CREAM. Consult your doctor for advice. THIOFORD PLUS CREAM is not recommended for use in patients who have kidney diseases, had asthma, flaccid paralysis (sagging of face), muscular hypotonia (weak muscles), urticaria (allergic reaction) after use of NSAIDs such as aspirin, setting of coronary artery bypass graft surgery, or broken or irritated skin.

THIOFORD PLUS CREAM is not recommended for use among women who are pregnant and breastfeeding. THIOFORD PLUS CREAM is not recommended to use in children and adolescents below 15 years of age and children having flu, chickenpox, or fever. Caution must be exercised while using THIOFORD PLUS CREAM in elderly patients. The most common side effects of using THIOFORD PLUS CREAM are skin irritation, redness of the skin, rashes, dermatitis, burning or stinging sensation at the site of application. Consult your doctor’s advice if any of these doesn’t improve or worsen.

mechanismOfAction:
How THIOFORD PLUS CREAM Works

THIOFORD PLUS CREAM helps in relieving muscle pains and spasms whereas Diclofenac is an NSAID that causes relief in pain and inflammation by inhibiting the factors that cause inflammation and pain called prostaglandins. Linseed oil helps in minimizing skin irritation, soothes and calms the skin. Methyl salicylate acts by dilating the blood vessels and increasing blood flow. It causes irritation of the skin and because of counter-irritation, there is a sensation of warmth and relief in musculoskeletal pain. Menthol acts by acting as an irritant and imparts coolness to the skin and then warmth. Thiocolchicoside works through selective binding to the GABA-A receptor (neurotransmitter) which manages muscle contractions by activating the GABA inhibitory motor pathway and inhibiting the glycine receptors (neurotransmitters). Thus, relaxing the muscle pain and spasms.

Apply THIOFORD PLUS CREAM as advised by your physician. It is for external use only. Gently rub THIOFORD PLUS CREAM on the affected area till it disappears. Your doctor will prescribe the right dose depends on your age, body weight and severity of the infection.

introduction:
Introduction About DOLGON P TABLET

DOLGON P TABLET is used for pain management associated with osteoarthritis, rheumatoid arthritis and ankylosing spondylitis. It can also be used to reduce pain caused due to sprains, strains, sports injuries, tendon pain, bone fracture pain and minor surgical and other pains. It is a combination of Aceclofenac + Paracetamol which are pain relieving agents.

Take DOLGON P TABLET after food to avoid gastric irritation. Do not take this medicine more than the duration recommended by your doctor. Before taking this medicine inform your doctor if you are having any liver, kidney or heart problems. You must also inform your doctor if you have stomach ulcers, gut inflammation, inflammatory bowel diseases or chronic alcoholism, or if you are pregnant or breastfeeding as a precaution.

The most common side effects of taking DOLGON P TABLET are indigestion, stomach pain, bloating and headache which can be managed by taking this medicine with meals and by following simple diet with less spicy food and limiting alcohol consumption.

mechanismOfAction:
How DOLGON P TABLET Works

DOLGON P TABLET contains aceclofenac and paracetamol which works together to relieve pain and inflammation. Aceclofenac is a non-steroidal anti-inflammatory drug (NSAID) that blocks enzymes called cyclooxygenase (COX) enzymes, reducing the production of chemicals called prostaglandins, which are responsible for causing pain and inflammation.

Paracetamol, on the other hand, works by reducing the perception of pain in the brain and also helps lower fever by acting on the heat-regulating centers in the brain. Together, they provide stronger pain relief and reduce inflammation.

Typically, they are taken orally with water, preferably after food to avoid stomach upset.
The usual dose is one tablet 1-2 times a day, depending on the condition being treated and your doctor's instructions.
Do not exceed the prescribed dose, and follow the timing as recommended for the best results.
Always consult your doctor for personalized advice on dosage and duration.

introduction:
Introduction About MEPAR TABLET

MEPAR TABLET is a combination of Mefenamic acid and Paracetamol, which belongs to a group of medicines called Non-steroidal Anti-inflammatory Drugs (NSAIDs) and Analgesics and Antipyretics. It is used to manage fever. It is also used for the management of mild to moderate pain, such as headaches, toothaches, joint or muscle pains, and period pain.

MEPAR TABLET is not recommended for use in patients with asthma or aspirin-sensitive asthma, kidney or liver disease, or heart failure. Contact your doctor before taking.

Pregnant women should generally avoid using MEPAR TABLET. Contact your doctor before taking.

MEPAR TABLET is generally not recommended for use in breastfeeding women as it may pass through the breast milk. Contact your doctor before taking it.

MEPAR TABLET is not recommended for use in children. Contact your doctor before taking.

MEPAR TABLET should be used with caution in elderly patients (aged 65 years or above). Contact your doctor before taking.

The most common side effects of this medicine are nausea, vomiting, abdominal pain, diarrhea, constipation, indigestion, flatulence, anorexia, dry mouth, heartburn, peptic ulcers, perforation or GI bleeding, and ulcerative stomatitis. Contact your doctor if any of the above side effects worsen.
uses: Fever
Mild to moderate pain (headache, toothache, joint or muscle pains, and period pains)
usesDetails:
Uses Of MEPAR TABLET

It is used to manage:

Fever
Mild to moderate pain (headache, toothache, joint or muscle pains, and period pains)
mechanismOfAction:
How MEPAR TABLET Works

MEPAR TABLET helps to relieve fever and pain, where paracetamol acts on the hypothalamus (heat regulating center) of the brain, resulting in peripheral vasodilation, sweating, and loss of body heat, and it also increases the pain threshold by inhibiting COX-1 and COX-2 enzymes, and mefenamic acid works by inhibiting COX-1 and COX-2 enzymes, which are involved in prostaglandin synthesis (responsible for pain and inflammation).
usageDetails:
How to use MEPAR TABLET

Take MEPAR TABLET as advised by your physician. It can be taken with or without food.

For Tablet, Capsule: Swallow MEPAR TABLET with a glass of water. Do not crush or chew the medicine.

For Dispersible Tablet: Disperse the medicine in the specified quantity of water as mentioned in the label. Consume the medicine immediately after reconstitution.

Your doctor will decide the correct dose and duration of therapy for you depending upon your age, body weight, and disease condition.

Yellowing of your skin or eyes, pale faeces, and dark urine

Signs of infections such as fever, sore throat, and mouth ulcers

MEPAR TABLET is generally not recommended for use in breastfeeding women as it may pass through the breast milk. Consult your doctor before taking it.
Do not drive or operate any machines if you feel dizziness, drowsiness, fatigue, and visual disturbances after taking MEPAR TABLET.
Avoid consumption of alcohol while taking MEPAR TABLET, as it increases the risk of liver injury and stomach bleeding.
MEPAR TABLET is not recommended for use in patients with kidney disease. Contact your doctor before taking.
MEPAR TABLET is not recommended for use in patients with liver disease. Contact your doctor before taking it.
Do not take MEPAR TABLET if you are allergic to mefenamic acid, paracetamol, or any other ingredients of this medicine.

MEPAR TABLET is not recommended for use in patients with lung diseases such as asthma, sinusitis with or without nasal polyps (aspirin triad), or aspirin-sensitive asthma. Contact your doctor before taking it.

Introduction About MACFAST 650MG TABLET

MACFAST 650MG TABLET contains Paracetamol which belongs to the group of medicines called Analgesics and Antipyretics. It is used to relieve mild to moderate pain (including headaches, backache, toothache, severe nerve pain, sore throat, period pain, low back and leg pain, muscle, connective tissue and joint pain, symptomatic relief of sprains, strain, joint swelling and stiffness). It is also used to lower fever (high body temperature) and relieves the symptoms of cold or flu.   

Before taking MACFAST 650MG TABLET, inform your doctor if you or your child have liver or kidney problems or any allergies. It should be used with caution in patients with liver problems due to alcohol to manage the risk of liver damage.

MACFAST 650MG TABLET should be used with caution in pregnant women only if clearly advised by the doctor and can be used in breastfeeding women. MACFAST 650MG TABLET is not recommended for use in children less than 10 years of age and should be used with caution in elderly patients.

How MACFAST 650MG TABLET Works

MACFAST 650MG TABLET relieves pain by increasing the pain threshold by inhibiting certain enzymes (COX-1 and COX-2) involved in the synthesis of chemicals responsible for inducing pain (prostaglandins). It reduces fever by directly acting on heat-regulating centers in the brain, resulting in vessel relaxation, sweating and loss of body heat.

Take MACFAST 650MG TABLET as advised by your physician. It can be taken with or without food.

For Tablet, Capsule: Swallow MACFAST 650MG TABLET with a glass of water. Do not crush or chew the medicine.

For Dispersible Tablet: Disperse the medicine in the specified quantity of water as mentioned in the label. Consume the medicine immediately after reconstitution.

Your doctor will decide the correct dose and duration of therapy for you depending upon your age, body weight and severity of the condition.

introduction:
Introduction About PYRIGESIC DROPS

Pyrigesic Drops used for fever due to bacterial, viral infections, post-immunisation and mild to moderate pain associated with sore throat, headache, earaches, joint and muscle pain in children. It contains Paracetamol as an active ingredient.

Paracetamol acts as an analgesic, and antipyretic, which works by blocking certain chemical messengers and pathways in the brain (cyclooxygenase, COX-1 and COX-2) that send signals about pain and fever.

Always give Pyrigesic Drops as advised by the physician. It is for paediatric use. Shake well before use. Do not give more than daily dose as it may cause serious liver damage or allergic reactions (e.g., swelling of the face, mouth and throat, difficulty in breathing, itching or rash). Do not give if your child is allergic to paracetamol.

Fepanil Drops is an analgesic and antipyretic medicine that is used in children to manage pain and fever. It also helps to relieve headache, migraine, nerve pain, toothache and teething pains, sore throat, influenza, feverishness, and feverish colds. It contains Paracetamol as an active ingredient which blocks the pain and fever causing mechanism in the body.

Always give Fepanil Drops to your child exactly as advised by your child’s doctor. It is for paediatric use (1-12 months). Shake well before use. Do not exceed the daily recommended dosages. It contains a medicine called paracetamol which alleviate pain and reduce fever by inhibiting the release of certain chemicals within the body that causes pain and fever. It is commonly used to provide relief from headaches, migraines, tooth pain, sore throats, periods pain, joint pain, muscle aches, and symptoms of the common cold.

It is recommended to take SINACIN 650 TABLET as directed by your doctor. Taking it preferably with meals may reduce stomach upset. Do not take more than the recommended dosages as it could affect your liver. SINACIN 650 TABLET starts working within 30 minutes of its intake. Leave a time gap of 4 hours between each dose of SINACIN 650 TABLET.

In most cases, SINACIN 650 TABLET is well-tolerated, with side effects being rare. However, some individuals may experience temporary stomach discomfort, nausea, or vomiting. If any of these side effects persist or become troublesome, consult your doctor. Do not take this medicine, without consulting your doctor if you have severe liver problems. Consult your doctor before taking SINACIN 650 TABLET , if you are pregnant or breastfeeding.

Before using this medication, inform your doctor if you have any liver or kidney issues, are allergic to paracetamol, or are taking other medications as a precaution.

Introduction About SUPPOL 250 SUPPOSITORIES

SUPPOL 250 Suppositories is an Analgesic and Antipyretic. It is used to manage pain and fever (high temperature) in children (from 3 months to 12 years of age) who find it difficult to take the medicine orally.  It contains paracetamol as an active ingredient.

Suppol (Paracetamol Suppository) which ensures accurate dosage with no wastage. unlike suspension or syrup, Suppol suppsitory is the better alternative to injectable – no pricks, no pain. Suppol suppository can be administered easily even when the child is sleeping.

Paracetamol relieves pain by increasing the pain threshold by inhibiting certain enzymes (COX-1 and COX-2) involved in the synthesis of chemicals responsible for inducing pain (prostaglandins). It reduces fever by directly acting on heat-regulating centres in the brain, resulting in vessel relaxation, sweating, and loss of body heat.

Administer SUPPOL 250MG SUPPOSITORY to your child as advised by the physician. It is for rectal use only. 15mg/kg body weight in 4-6 divided doses not exceeding 1 gm per dose and 60 mg/kg body weight in a day. Your child’s bowel needs to be empty when you administer it. Wash your hands and peel the wrapping apart. Do not break the medicine before use. Smoothly push into the back passage of the child with the pointed end first. Slightly warm it between your hands beforehand to make it easier. Tell your child to keep still for a minute or two, and then clean your hands.
sideEffectsDetails:
Side Effects Of SUPPOL 250 SUPPOSITORIES

Consult your doctor if you notice any unusual side effects like redness or soreness in and around the back passage after using SUPPOL 250 Suppositories.

faqs.question: Q: What happens if I accidentally administer an extra dose of SUPPOL 250MG SUPPOSITORY to my child?
faqs.answer: A: If you have administered more SUPPOL 250MG SUPPOSITORY to your child accidentally, consult the child’s doctor immediately or visit the nearby hospital, even if the child feels well, as it can cause delayed serious liver damage.

faqs.question: Q: Is SUPPOL 250MG SUPPOSITORY safe to use in children with liver problems?
faqs.answer: A: SUPPOL 250MG SUPPOSITORY should be used with caution in children with liver problems. The child’s doctor may monitor the liver function test before and during management with this medicine to manage the risk of liver damage. introduction:
Introduction About ACECLO SERA TABLET

ACECLO SERA TABLET is used to relieve inflammation and pain due to bone and soft tissue injuries in affected individuals. It is also used to reduce high temperatures and provide relief from cold (while sneezing) in affected individuals. This medicine is also indicated for use to resolve post-operative inflammation, oedema, and pain. It is also used to provide relief from illnesses such as headaches, moderate migraines, and musculoskeletal pain.

ACECLO SERA TABLET is a combination of Aceclofenac, Paracetamol, and Serratiopeptidase, which belong to the group of medicines called Nonsteroidal anti-inflammatory agents, Analgesics and Antipyretics, and Proteolytic enzymes, respectively. It helps to reduce pain and inflammation by blocking certain chemical messengers in the brain, and it also promotes healing by breaking down abnormal proteins at the site of inflammation, thereby healing the infected site.

ACECLO SERA TABLET is not recommended for use in patients allergic to Aceclofenac, Paracetamol, or Serratiopeptidase. It is also not recommended for use in patients with active or recurrent peptic ulcers or haemorrhages (bleeding), severe heart, liver, or kidney diseases. Before taking ACECLO SERA TABLET, inform your doctor if you suffer from uncontrolled high blood pressure, diabetes, hyperlipidaemia (high-fat level in the blood), gastrointestinal diseases such as ulcerative colitis (inflammatory bowel disease), and/or aseptic meningitis (inflammation of the brain).

ACECLO SERA TABLET is not recommended for use by pregnant and breastfeeding women. It is also not recommended for use in children and adolescents (below 18 years old). Consult your doctor before taking the medicine. The most common side effects of taking ACECLO SERA TABLET are abdominal pain, nausea, vomiting, diarrhea, flatulence, constipation, indigestion, and/or dizziness. Consult and inform your doctor if any of these side effects get worse.

Overdosage:

If you or anyone else accidentally takes too much of ACECLO SERA TABLET, consult your doctor immediately or visit the nearby hospital. Symptoms of an overdose are headache, pallor, nausea, vomiting, epigastric pain, gastrointestinal irritation and bleeding, diarrhea, disorientation, excitation, drowsiness, dizziness, tinnitus, hypotension, respiratory depression, fainting, convulsions, anorexia, and/or abdominal pain.

introduction:
Introduction About SUGANRIL 20MG TABLET

SUGANRIL 20MG TABLET contains Piroxicam, which belongs to the group of medicines called Non-Steroidal Anti-Inflammatory Drugs. It helps to reduce pain and swelling affecting the joints. It is also used to relieve the symptoms caused by osteoarthritis (a joint disease that occurs when the protective tissues at the end of the bones wear out and is characterised by joint pain in the hands, neck, and hip), rheumatoid arthritis (autoimmune disease-causing painful swelling of joints and stiffness), and ankylosing spondylitis (rheumatism of the spine resulting in a hunched forward posture).

SUGANRIL 20MG TABLET is not recommended for use in patients with heart problems, and it should be used with caution in patients with asthma, liver, and kidney problems. SUGANRIL 20MG TABLET is not recommended for use in pregnant women, especially during the last three months of pregnancy, and it should be used with caution during breastfeeding.

The safety and effectiveness of SUGANRIL 20MG TABLET in children and adolescents have not been established. SUGANRIL 20MG TABLET is not recommended for use in elderly patients of 80 years and above. The most common side effects of this medicine are nausea (feeling sick), vomiting, indigestion, stomach pain, skin rash, headache, and drowsiness. Consult your physician if any of the symptoms worsen.

introduction:
Introduction About FLUGESIC SR TABLET

FLUGESIC SR TABLET contains Flupirtine which belongs to a group of medicines called Nonopioid, Non-NSAID analgesics. It is used in the management of acute and chronic pain (such as primary headache, tumor pain, menstrual cramps, pain after traumatologic/orthopaedic operations and injuries and painful increased muscle tone of the posture and motor muscles).  

FLUGESIC SR TABLET is not recommended for use in patients with liver problems. Before taking FLUGESIC SR TABLET, inform your doctor if you have kidney disease, myasthenia gravis, had or have a history of tinnitus (ringing in the ears) or if you are allergic to Flupirtine. FLUGESIC SR TABLET is not recommended for use in pregnant and breast-feeding women unless clearly advised by the doctor.

FLUGESIC SR TABLET is not recommended for use in children and adolescents (below 18 years of age) unless deemed necessary and it should be used with caution in elderly patients, especially in patients with kidney problems. The most common side effects of taking FLUGESIC SR TABLET are fatigue, dizziness, heartburn, nausea, vomiting, dry mouth, constipation and diarrhea. Consult your doctor if any of the side effects worsen.

name: Pacimol DS Suspension 60ml
introduction:
Introduction About PACIMOL DS SUSPENSION

Pacimol DS Suspension is a painkiller and anti-pyretic medicine. It is used in children to temporarily relieve mild to moderate pain such as headache, toothache, migraine, nerve pain, sore throat, period pains and general aches and helps to reduce fever (high body temperature). Also, it relieves symptoms of cold and flu. It contains paracetamol as an active ingredient that reduces fever and pain.  

Paracetamol relieves pain by increasing the pain threshold by inhibiting certain enzymes (COX-1 and COX-2) involved in synthesis of chemicals responsible for inducing pain (prostaglandins). It reduces fever by directly acting on heat-regulating centers in the brain, resulting in vessel relaxation, sweating and loss of body heat.

Always give Pacimol DS Suspension to your child as advised by the doctor. Shake well before use. Do not exceed the recommended daily dosage. Use a measuring cup to properly measure the dose. Do not give Pacimol DS Suspension to your child if your child is allergic to any of its components.

Introduction About DOLO 120MG SUSPENSION

Dolo 120 Suspension is an analgesic and antipyretic medicine that is used in infants and children to manage pain such as headache, migraine, nerve pain, toothache and teething pains, sore throat, rheumatic aches and pains, and influenza.

It also helps in managing fever. It contains paracetamol as an active ingredient which blocks the pain and fever causing mechanism in the body.

Paracetamol works by inhibiting the production of a chemical called prostaglandins in the body which is responsible for causing pain and swelling. It reduces fever by affecting an area of the brain that is responsible for regulating our body temperature called hypothalamic heat-regulating centre.

Give Dolo 120 Suspension to your child as directed by your doctor. It is for oral use only. Shake well before use. Use the measuring cup provided with the bottle. Do not exceed the daily recommended dosage. It is not recommended for use Dolo 120 Suspension in children who weigh less than 4kg, were born before 37 weeks of gestation, or have allergy to paracetamol. Before giving Dolo 120 Suspension to your child, inform the doctor if he/she has liver, kidney diseases or sugar intolerance.

Febrex 125mg Suspension is an analgesic and antipyretic medicine used to relieve mild to moderate pain such as headache, muscle ache, sore throat, toothache, backache and vaccination pain in children. It is also used to reduce fever. It contains Paracetamol as an active ingredient.

Paracetamol manages fever by directly acting on the heat-regulating centres of our brain. This leads to stimulation of sweating mechanism and loss of body heat. It inhibits the activation of the pain mechanism. It does this by the minimizing the synthesis of prostaglandins (pain causing chemicals) at the affected site.

Always give Febrex 125mg Suspension as advised by the doctor. Shake well before use. Do not exceed the recommended daily dosage. Do not give if your child is allergic to paracetamol.

name: Flugesic 100mg Capsule 10'S
introduction:
Introduction About FLUGESIC 100MG CAPSULE

FLUGESIC 100MG CAPSULE contains Flupirtine which belongs to a group of medicines called Nonopioid, Non-NSAID analgesics. It is used in the management of acute and chronic pain (such as primary headache, tumor pain, menstrual cramps, pain after traumatologic/orthopaedic operations and injuries and painful increased muscle tone of the posture and motor muscles).  

FLUGESIC 100MG CAPSULE is not recommended for use in patients with liver problems. Before taking FLUGESIC 100MG CAPSULE, inform your doctor if you have kidney disease, myasthenia gravis, had or have a history of tinnitus (ringing in the ears) or if you are allergic to Flupirtine. FLUGESIC 100MG CAPSULE is not recommended for use in pregnant and breast-feeding women unless clearly advised by the doctor.

FLUGESIC 100MG CAPSULE is not recommended for use in children and adolescents (below 18 years of age) unless deemed necessary and it should be used with caution in elderly patients, especially in patients with kidney problems. The most common side effects of taking FLUGESIC 100MG CAPSULE are fatigue, dizziness, heartburn, nausea, vomiting, dry mouth, constipation and diarrhea. Consult your doctor if any of the side effects worsen.

introduction:
Introduction About SUMO L PLUS DS SUSPENSION

SUMO L PLUS DS SUSPENSION is a combination of Mefenamic acid and Paracetamol, which belongs to a group of medicines called Non-steroidal Anti-inflammatory Drugs (NSAIDs) and Analgesics and Antipyretics. It is indicated for the management of fever in children. It is also used for the management of mild to moderate pain such as headache, toothache, joint or muscle pain, and period pain.

SUMO L PLUS DS SUSPENSION is not recommended for use in patients with asthma or aspirin-sensitive asthma, severe liver, kidney, or heart disease. Contact your doctor before taking.

SUMO L PLUS DS SUSPENSION is generally not recommended for use in pregnant women. Contact your doctor before taking.

SUMO L PLUS DS SUSPENSION is generally not recommended for use in breastfeeding women as it may pass through the breast milk. Contact your doctor before taking it.

SUMO L PLUS DS SUSPENSION is not recommended for use in children under 6 months of age. Contact your doctor before taking.

SUMO L PLUS DS SUSPENSION should be used with caution in elderly patients (aged 65 years or above). Contact your doctor before taking.

The most common side effects of this medicine are skin rash, nausea, vomiting, diarrhea, abdominal pain, constipation, indigestion, flatulence, anorexia, dry mouth, heartburn, peptic ulcers, perforation or GI bleeding, and ulcerative stomatitis. Contact your doctor if any of the side effects worsen.

Mild to moderate pain (headache, toothache, joint or muscle pains, and period pains)

SUMO L PLUS DS SUSPENSION helps to relieve fever and pain, where paracetamol acts on the hypothalamus (heat regulating center) of the brain, resulting in peripheral vasodilation, sweating, and loss of body heat, and it also increases the pain threshold by inhibiting COX-1 and COX-2 enzymes, and mefenamic acid works by inhibiting COX-1 and COX-2 enzymes, which are involved in prostaglandin synthesis (responsible for pain and inflammation).

name: Pyrit 650mg Tablet 15'S
introduction:
Introduction About PYRIT 650MG TABLET

Pyrit 650 Tablet belongs to antipyretic and analgesic (pain killers) medicine which is used to relieve mild to moderate pain (such as headache, toothache, back and menstrual pain) and fever. It contains paracetamol as an active ingredient which is used to manage a wide range of painful conditions and fever.

Paracetamol acts as an antipyretic as well as painkiller. It works by inhibiting the production of a chemical called prostaglandins in the body, which are responsible for causing pain and swelling in the body. As a result, it reduces various pain. It also has a direct action on heat regulating centres in the brain, leading to peripheral vasodilation, sweating and loss of body temperature. Thus, it reduces fever.

Always take Pyrit 650 Tablet as advised by the physician. Swallow the medicine as a whole with a glass of water and do not crush or chew the medicine. Do not exceed the recommended daily dosage.
author: Dr. R. Dinesh John Rajkumar

name: SUPPOL DELICIOUS RASPBERRY FLAVOUR Suspension 60ml
introduction:
Introduction About SUPPOL DELICIOUS RASPBERRY FLAVOUR SUSPENSION

SUPPOL DELICIOUS RASPBERRY FLAVOUR Suspension is an analgesic and antipyretic medicine used to manage fever and pain in children. It contains Paracetamol as active ingredient.

The central analgesic action of paracetamol is achieved by inhibiting multiple pathways involved in the activation of the pain mechanism and managing the manufacture of pain-causing molecules (prostaglandins) at the affected site. It also has an antipyretic effect by directly acting on the heat-regulating centres in the brain, inducing peripheral vasodilation, sweating, and loss of body heat and manages fever.

Always give SUPPOL DELICIOUS RASPBERRY FLAVOUR Suspension as advised by your doctor. Do not exceed its intake beyond the recommended dosage. Do not give if your child is allergic to paracetamol.

name: Dolo Infusion 100ml
introduction:
Introduction About DOLO INFUSION

DOLO INFUSION contains Paracetamol which belongs to the group of medicines called Analgesics and Antipyretics. It is used for short-term management of moderate pain (especially after surgery) and fever when administered by the intravenous route is clinically justified.

Before receiving DOLO INFUSION, inform your doctor if you have heart, lung, liver or kidney problems or if you suffer from alcoholism or alcohol abuse, malnourishment and severely low blood volume due to dehydration or blood loss.

DOLO INFUSION should be used with caution in pregnant and breastfeeding women only if clearly advised by the doctor. DOLO INFUSION should be used with caution in children and elderly patients.

The most common side effects of receiving DOLO INFUSION are nausea, vomiting, headache, sleep problems and itching. Inform your doctor if any of these side effect worsens.
uses: For short-term management of moderate pain (especially after surgery) and fever

mechanismOfAction:
How DOLO INFUSION Works

DOLO INFUSION relieves pain by increasing the pain threshold by inhibiting certain enzymes (COX-1 and COX-2) involved in the synthesis of chemicals responsible for inducing pain (prostaglandins). It reduces fever by directly acting on heat-regulating centers in the brain, resulting in vessel relaxation, sweating and loss of body heat.

How to use DOLO INFUSION

DOLO INFUSION will be given to you only by a doctor or a nurse into the vein as an intravenous infusion. Your doctor will decide the correct dose and duration for you based on your age, body weight and disease condition.

introduction:
Introduction About PYRITEC DS ORAL SUSPENSION

Pyritec DS suspension is an analgesic and antipyretic medicine used to manage pain and fever in children. It also helps to relieve headache, migraine, toothache, nerve pain and sore throat. Pyritec DS suspension contains Paracetamol as an active ingredient that helps to reduce pain and temperature.

Paracetamol relieve fever and pain by blocking chemical messengers in the brain called prostaglandins that regulate pain and heat.

Always give Pyritec DS suspension as advised by your doctor. Shake well before use. Do not exceed the daily recommended dosages as it may cause liver damage. Before giving Pyritec DS suspension to your child, tell your doctor if your child has liver or kidney diseases, fructose, or any other sugar intolerance. Pyritec DS suspension is not recommended if your child is allergic to paracetamol.

introduction:
Introduction About OMOL 650 TABLET

OMOL 650 TABLET contains Paracetamol which belongs to the group of medicines called Analgesics and Antipyretics. It is used to relieve mild to moderate pain (including headaches, backache, toothache, severe nerve pain, sore throat, period pain, low back and leg pain, muscle, connective tissue and joint pain, symptomatic relief of sprains, strain, joint swelling and stiffness). It is also used to lower fever (high body temperature) and relieves the symptoms of cold or flu.   

Before taking OMOL 650 TABLET, inform your doctor if you or your child have liver or kidney problems or any allergies. It should be used with caution in patients with liver problems due to alcohol to manage the risk of liver damage.

OMOL 650 TABLET should be used with caution in pregnant women only if clearly advised by the doctor and can be used in breastfeeding women. OMOL 650 TABLET is not recommended for use in children less than 10 years of age and should be used with caution in elderly patients.

Consult your doctor if you experience any side effects or unusual effects during management with OMOL 650 TABLET.

usesDetails:

Relieves mild to moderate pain (such as headache, toothache, joint pain)
Lowers fever and relieves the symptoms of cold or flu
mechanismOfAction:
How OMOL 650 TABLET Works

OMOL 650 TABLET relieves pain by increasing the pain threshold by inhibiting certain enzymes (COX-1 and COX-2) involved in the synthesis of chemicals responsible for inducing pain (prostaglandins). It reduces fever by directly acting on heat-regulating centers in the brain, resulting in vessel relaxation, sweating and loss of body heat.
usageDetails:
How to use OMOL 650 TABLET

Take OMOL 650 TABLET as advised by your physician. It can be taken with or without food.

For Tablet, Capsule: Swallow OMOL 650 TABLET with a glass of water. Do not crush or chew the medicine.

For Dispersible Tablet: Disperse the medicine in the specified quantity of water as mentioned in the label. Consume the medicine immediately after reconstitution.

Your doctor will decide the correct dose and duration of therapy for you depending upon your age, body weight and severity of the condition.

Introduction About CENTAMOL PLUS SUSPENSION

CENTAMOL PLUS SUSPENSION is a combination of Mefenamic acid and Paracetamol, which belongs to a group of medicines called Non-steroidal Anti-inflammatory Drugs (NSAIDs) and Analgesics and Antipyretics. It is indicated for the management of fever in children. It is also used for the management of mild to moderate pain such as headache, toothache, joint or muscle pain, and period pain.

CENTAMOL PLUS SUSPENSION is not recommended for use in patients with asthma or aspirin-sensitive asthma, severe liver, kidney, or heart disease. Contact your doctor before taking.

CENTAMOL PLUS SUSPENSION is generally not recommended for use in breastfeeding women as it may pass through the breast milk. Contact your doctor before taking it.

CENTAMOL PLUS SUSPENSION is not recommended for use in children under 6 months of age. Contact your doctor before taking.

CENTAMOL PLUS SUSPENSION should be used with caution in elderly patients (aged 65 years or above). Contact your doctor before taking.

The most common side effects of this medicine are skin rash, nausea, vomiting, diarrhea, abdominal pain, constipation, indigestion, flatulence, anorexia, dry mouth, heartburn, peptic ulcers, perforation or GI bleeding, and ulcerative stomatitis. Contact your doctor if any of the side effects worsen.

CENTAMOL PLUS SUSPENSION helps to relieve fever and pain, where paracetamol acts on the hypothalamus (heat regulating center) of the brain, resulting in peripheral vasodilation, sweating, and loss of body heat, and it also increases the pain threshold by inhibiting COX-1 and COX-2 enzymes, and mefenamic acid works by inhibiting COX-1 and COX-2 enzymes, which are involved in prostaglandin synthesis (responsible for pain and inflammation).

How to use CENTAMOL PLUS SUSPENSION

Take this medicine as advised by your doctor. Shake well before use. Your doctor will decide the correct dose and duration of therapy for you depending upon your age, body weight, and disease condition.

Do not drive or operate any machines if you feel dizziness, drowsiness, fatigue, and visual disturbances after taking CENTAMOL PLUS SUSPENSION.
Avoid consumption of alcohol while taking CENTAMOL PLUS SUSPENSION, as it increases the risk of liver injury and stomach bleeding.
CENTAMOL PLUS SUSPENSION is not recommended for use in patients with severe kidney disease. Contact your doctor before taking.
CENTAMOL PLUS SUSPENSION is not recommended for use in patients with severe liver disease. Contact your doctor before taking.
Do not take CENTAMOL PLUS SUSPENSION if you are allergic to mefenamic acid, paracetamol, sucrose, or other NSAIDs such as aspirin, ibuprofen, celecoxib, or any other ingredients of this medicine.

CENTAMOL PLUS SUSPENSION is not recommended for use in patients with lung diseases such as asthma, sinusitis with or without nasal polyps (aspirin triad), or aspirin-sensitive asthma. Contact your doctor before taking.
CENTAMOL PLUS SUSPENSION is not recommended for use in patients with severe heart disease or hypertension. Contact your doctor before taking.

CENTAMOL PLUS SUSPENSION is not recommended for use in children under 6 months of age. Your doctor will prescribe the right dose depending on your child’s age, body weight, and disease condition. Contact your doctor before taking.
CENTAMOL PLUS SUSPENSION should be used with caution in elderly patients (aged 65 years or above). Contact your doctor before taking.

Others

CENTAMOL PLUS SUSPENSION is not recommended for use if you:

Have peptic ulcer, bleeding in the stomach, severe gastritis, active ulceration/bleeding, or chronic inflammation of the upper or lower gastrointestinal (GI) tract
Have inflammatory bowel disease (Ex. ulcerative colitis, Crohn's disease)
Have obstructive uropathy
Had coronary artery bypass graft (CABG) surgery

Before taking CENTAMOL PLUS SUSPENSION, inform your doctor if you have:

Hyperthyroidism
Closed-angle glaucoma
Fluid retention or edema
Poor general health
Previous anaphylactic reactions to NSAIDs
Anemia
Intolerance to fructose or other sugars
Bleeding disorder
Major operation
Connective tissue disorder (Ex. Systemic Lupus Erythematous)
Epilepsy
Dehydration
Diabetes
High cholesterol levels
Smoking history

interactions:
Interactions

A. Drug-Drug interactions:

Inform your physician if you are taking any of the following medicine:

Cholestyramine (medicines used to decrease high cholesterol levels)
Metoclopramide and domperidone (medicine used to manage nausea and vomiting)
Medicines used to thin the blood (Ex. warfarin, aspirin, clopidogrel)
Medicine used to manage seizures (Ex. phenytoin, phenobarbitone)
Isoniazid (medicines used for tuberculosis)
Medicine used for high blood pressure or heart diseases (captopril, atenolol, ramipril, valsartan, chlorothiazide, chlorthalidone, sotalol, diltiazem)
Ibuprofen, ketoprofen, diclofenac, celecoxib (medicine used to manage pain)
Lithium (medicine used to manage depression and mania)
Medicines used for heartburn or indigestion (Ex. magnesium hydroxide)
Medicine used to manage bacterial infections (Ex. chloramphenicol, aminoglycosides like amikacin, tobramycin, gentamicin, and quinolone antibiotics like ciprofloxacin)
Digoxin (medicine used for heart failure)
Medicines suppress the immune system (Ex. cyclosporine, tacrolimus, methotrexate)
Medicines used to manage diabetes mellitus (Ex. glimepiride, metformin, glipizide, glibenclamide)
Antiplatelet like low-dose aspirin (medicine used to manage platelet aggregation)
Corticosteroids (medicines used to manage arthritis and inflammation)
Mifepristone (medicines used to terminate pregnancy)
Zidovudine (medicine used for HIV infection, AIDS)
Oral contraceptives (medicines used to manage pregnancy)
Medicines used to manage depression (Ex. paroxetine)
Medicines used for anxiety and depression (Ex. amitriptyline)
Barbiturates (used for insomnia)
Probenecid (medicines used to manage gout)
Propantheline (medicines used to manage ulcers)
Narcotic analgesics (medicines sued to manage severe pain)

Overdosage:

If you or anyone else accidentally took too much of this medicine, consult your doctor immediately. Symptoms of overdose are severe stomach pain, coffee ground-like vomit, dark stool, ringing in the ears, change in amount of urine, unusually fast or slow heartbeat, muscle weakness, slow or shallow breathing, confusion, and severe headache.

introduction:
Introduction About PARADAY 650 TABLET

PARADAY 650 TABLET contains Paracetamol which belongs to the group of medicines called Analgesics and Antipyretics. It is used to relieve mild to moderate pain (including headaches, backache, toothache, severe nerve pain, sore throat, period pain, low back and leg pain, muscle, connective tissue and joint pain, symptomatic relief of sprains, strain, joint swelling and stiffness). It is also used to lower fever (high body temperature) and relieves the symptoms of cold or flu.   

Before taking PARADAY 650 TABLET, inform your doctor if you or your child have liver or kidney problems or any allergies. It should be used with caution in patients with liver problems due to alcohol to manage the risk of liver damage.

PARADAY 650 TABLET should be used with caution in pregnant women only if clearly advised by the doctor and can be used in breastfeeding women. PARADAY 650 TABLET is not recommended for use in children less than 10 years of age and should be used with caution in elderly patients.

Consult your doctor if you experience any side effects or unusual effects during management with PARADAY 650 TABLET.
uses: Relieves mild to moderate pain (such as headache, toothache, joint pain)
Lowers fever and relieves the symptoms of cold or flu
usesDetails:
Uses Of PARADAY 650 TABLET
Relieves mild to moderate pain (such as headache, toothache, joint pain)
Lowers fever and relieves the symptoms of cold or flu
mechanismOfAction:
How PARADAY 650 TABLET Works

PARADAY 650 TABLET relieves pain by increasing the pain threshold by inhibiting certain enzymes (COX-1 and COX-2) involved in the synthesis of chemicals responsible for inducing pain (prostaglandins). It reduces fever by directly acting on heat-regulating centers in the brain, resulting in vessel relaxation, sweating and loss of body heat.
usageDetails:
How to use PARADAY 650 TABLET

Take PARADAY 650 TABLET as advised by your physician. It can be taken with or without food.

For Tablet, Capsule: Swallow PARADAY 650 TABLET with a glass of water. Do not crush or chew the medicine.

For Dispersible Tablet: Disperse the medicine in the specified quantity of water as mentioned in the label. Consume the medicine immediately after reconstitution.

Your doctor will decide the correct dose and duration of therapy for you depending upon your age, body weight and severity of the condition.

warnings.details: PARADAY 650 TABLET should be used with caution in pregnant women only if considered clearly necessary. Your doctor may use the lowest possible dose to reduce the pain and fever only for a shorter duration in pregnant women. Consult your doctor before taking PARADAY 650 TABLET.
PARADAY 650 TABLET should be used with caution in breastfeeding women. Consult your doctor before taking it.
PARADAY 650 TABLET has no influence on the ability to drive and operate machinery.
PARADAY 650 TABLET should be used with caution in patients with chronic alcoholism. Consult your doctor before taking it.
PARADAY 650 TABLET should be used with caution in patients with severe kidney problems. Consult your doctor before taking it.
PARADAY 650 TABLET should be used with caution in patients with severe liver problems or liver problems due to alcohol. Consult your doctor before taking it.
Do not take PARADAY 650 TABLET if you are allergic to Paracetamol or any other ingredients of this medicine.

Others

Before taking PARADAY 650 TABLET, inform your doctor if you:

Have sepsis (circulation of bacteria and their toxins in the blood leading to organ damage)
Are malnourished

Use in pediatrics:

PARADAY 650 TABLET is not recommended for use in children less than 10 years of age. It can be used in children and adolescents aged above 10 and your child’s doctor may adjust the dose based on the child’s age and body weight. Consult your child’s doctor for advice.

Use in geriatrics:

PARADAY 650 TABLET should be used with caution in elderly patients. Consult your doctor before taking it.

name: Sumo L Plus mango flavour Suspension 60ml
introduction:
Introduction About SUMO L PLUS SUSPENSION

SUMO L PLUS SUSPENSION is a combination of Mefenamic acid and Paracetamol, which belongs to a group of medicines called Non-steroidal Anti-inflammatory Drugs (NSAIDs) and Analgesics and Antipyretics. It is indicated for the management of fever in children. It is also used for the management of mild to moderate pain such as headache, toothache, joint or muscle pain, and period pain.

SUMO L PLUS SUSPENSION is not recommended for use in patients with asthma or aspirin-sensitive asthma, severe liver, kidney, or heart disease. Contact your doctor before taking.

SUMO L PLUS SUSPENSION is generally not recommended for use in pregnant women. Contact your doctor before taking.

SUMO L PLUS SUSPENSION is generally not recommended for use in breastfeeding women as it may pass through the breast milk. Contact your doctor before taking it.

SUMO L PLUS SUSPENSION is not recommended for use in children under 6 months of age. Contact your doctor before taking.

SUMO L PLUS SUSPENSION should be used with caution in elderly patients (aged 65 years or above). Contact your doctor before taking.

The most common side effects of this medicine are skin rash, nausea, vomiting, diarrhea, abdominal pain, constipation, indigestion, flatulence, anorexia, dry mouth, heartburn, peptic ulcers, perforation or GI bleeding, and ulcerative stomatitis. Contact your doctor if any of the side effects worsen.

introduction:
Introduction About PACINOVA 650 TABLET

PACINOVA 650 TABLET contains Paracetamol which belongs to the group of medicines called Analgesics and Antipyretics. It is used to relieve mild to moderate pain (including headaches, backache, toothache, severe nerve pain, sore throat, period pain, low back and leg pain, muscle, connective tissue and joint pain, symptomatic relief of sprains, strain, joint swelling and stiffness). It is also used to lower fever (high body temperature) and relieves the symptoms of cold or flu.   

Before taking PACINOVA 650 TABLET, inform your doctor if you or your child have liver or kidney problems or any allergies. It should be used with caution in patients with liver problems due to alcohol to manage the risk of liver damage.

PACINOVA 650 TABLET should be used with caution in pregnant women only if clearly advised by the doctor and can be used in breastfeeding women. PACINOVA 650 TABLET is not recommended for use in children less than 10 years of age and should be used with caution in elderly patients.

Consult your doctor if you experience any side effects or unusual effects during management with PACINOVA 650 TABLET.

mechanismOfAction:
How PACINOVA 650 TABLET Works

PACINOVA 650 TABLET relieves pain by increasing the pain threshold by inhibiting certain enzymes (COX-1 and COX-2) involved in the synthesis of chemicals responsible for inducing pain (prostaglandins). It reduces fever by directly acting on heat-regulating centers in the brain, resulting in vessel relaxation, sweating and loss of body heat.
usageDetails:
How to use PACINOVA 650 TABLET

Take PACINOVA 650 TABLET as advised by your physician. It can be taken with or without food.

For Tablet, Capsule: Swallow PACINOVA 650 TABLET with a glass of water. Do not crush or chew the medicine.

For Dispersible Tablet: Disperse the medicine in the specified quantity of water as mentioned in the label. Consume the medicine immediately after reconstitution.

Your doctor will decide the correct dose and duration of therapy for you depending upon your age, body weight and severity of the condition.

introduction:
Introduction About WILLGO P TABLET

WILLGO P TABLET is used for pain management associated with osteoarthritis, rheumatoid arthritis and ankylosing spondylitis. It can also be used to reduce pain caused due to sprains, strains, sports injuries, tendon pain, bone fracture pain and minor surgical and other pains. It is a combination of Aceclofenac + Paracetamol which are pain relieving agents.

Take WILLGO P TABLET after food to avoid gastric irritation. Do not take this medicine more than the duration recommended by your doctor. Before taking this medicine inform your doctor if you are having any liver, kidney or heart problems. You must also inform your doctor if you have stomach ulcers, gut inflammation, inflammatory bowel diseases or chronic alcoholism, or if you are pregnant or breastfeeding as a precaution.

The most common side effects of taking WILLGO P TABLET are indigestion, stomach pain, bloating and headache which can be managed by taking this medicine with meals and by following simple diet with less spicy food and limiting alcohol consumption.

mechanismOfAction:
How WILLGO P TABLET Works

WILLGO P TABLET contains aceclofenac and paracetamol which works together to relieve pain and inflammation. Aceclofenac is a non-steroidal anti-inflammatory drug (NSAID) that blocks enzymes called cyclooxygenase (COX) enzymes, reducing the production of chemicals called prostaglandins, which are responsible for causing pain and inflammation.

Paracetamol, on the other hand, works by reducing the perception of pain in the brain and also helps lower fever by acting on the heat-regulating centers in the brain. Together, they provide stronger pain relief and reduce inflammation.

introduction:
Introduction About ULTRACET SEMI TABLET

ULTRACET SEMI TABLET is a combination of Paracetamol and Tramadol which belongs to the group of medicines called Analgesics and Opioid analgesics respectively. ULTRACET SEMI TABLET is used in the management of moderate to severe pain.

Pain is a complex and unpleasant sensation consisting of a physiological and a psychological response to a noxious stimulus. Pain is a warning mechanism that protects us by influencing it to withdraw from harmful stimuli, which is primarily associated with injury.

Before taking ULTRACET SEMI TABLET, inform your doctor if you have respiratory disorders, gastrointestinal obstruction, including paralytic ileus, fits or seizures, have recently suffered from a head injury, depression, intolerance to some sugars, kidney or liver problems.

ULTRACET SEMI TABLET is not recommended for use in pregnant women and during breast-feeding more than once as it may pass through breast milk.  

ULTRACET SEMI TABLET is not recommended for use in children (under 12 years of age) and should be used with caution in elderly patients (aged 65 years and above).  

The common side effects of taking ULTRACET SEMI TABLET are nausea, dizziness, drowsiness, vomiting, gastrointestinal problems (such as constipation, flatulence, diarrhoea), stomach pain and dry mouth. Consult your physician if any of the side effects worsen.

Paracetamol acts as an analgesic by inhibiting the release of certain chemical mediators that produce pain. Tramadol and paracetamol, in combination, have a faster action and provide quick relief from pain.

introduction:
Introduction About CALPOL 500MG TABLET

CALPOL 500MG TABLET contains Paracetamol which belongs to the group of medicines called Analgesics and Antipyretics. It is used to relieve mild to moderate pain (including headaches, backache, toothache, severe nerve pain, sore throat, period pain, low back and leg pain, muscle, connective tissue and joint pain, symptomatic relief of sprains, strain, joint swelling and stiffness). It is also used to lower fever (high body temperature) and relieve cold or flu symptoms.

Before taking CALPOL 500MG TABLET, inform your doctor if you or your child have liver or kidney problems or any allergies. It should be used with caution in patients with liver problems due to alcohol to manage the risk of liver damage.

CALPOL 500MG TABLET should be used with caution in pregnant women only if clearly advised by the doctor and can be used in breastfeeding women. CALPOL 500MG TABLET is not recommended for use in children less than 10 years of age and should be used with caution in elderly patients.

Consult your doctor if you experience any side effects or unusual effects during management with CALPOL 500MG TABLET.
uses: Relieves mild to moderate pain (such as headache, toothache, joint pain)
Lowers fever and relieves the symptoms of cold or flu
usesDetails:
Uses Of CALPOL 500MG TABLET
Relieves mild to moderate pain (such as headache, toothache, joint pain)
Lowers fever and relieves the symptoms of cold or flu
mechanismOfAction:
How CALPOL 500MG TABLET Works

CALPOL 500MG TABLET relieves pain by increasing the pain threshold by inhibiting certain enzymes (COX-1 and COX-2) involved in the synthesis of chemicals responsible for inducing pain (prostaglandins). It reduces fever by directly acting on heat-regulating centers in the brain, resulting in vessel relaxation, sweating and loss of body heat.
usageDetails:
How to use CALPOL 500MG TABLET

Take CALPOL 500MG TABLET as advised by your physician. It can be taken with or without food.

For Tablet, Capsule: Swallow CALPOL 500MG TABLET with a glass of water. Do not crush or chew the medicine.

For Dispersible Tablet: Disperse the medicine in the specified quantity of water as mentioned on the label. Consume the medicine immediately after reconstitution.

Your doctor will decide the correct dose and duration of therapy for you depending upon your age, body weight and severity of the condition.

introduction:
Introduction About DOLOPAR M SUSPENSION

DOLOPAR M SUSPENSION is a combination of Mefenamic acid and Paracetamol, which belongs to a group of medicines called Non-steroidal Anti-inflammatory Drugs (NSAIDs) and Analgesics and Antipyretics. It is indicated for the management of fever in children. It is also used for the management of mild to moderate pain such as headache, toothache, joint or muscle pain, and period pain.

DOLOPAR M SUSPENSION is not recommended for use in patients with asthma or aspirin-sensitive asthma, severe liver, kidney, or heart disease. Contact your doctor before taking.

DOLOPAR M SUSPENSION is generally not recommended for use in pregnant women. Contact your doctor before taking.

DOLOPAR M SUSPENSION is generally not recommended for use in breastfeeding women as it may pass through the breast milk. Contact your doctor before taking it.

DOLOPAR M SUSPENSION is not recommended for use in children under 6 months of age. Contact your doctor before taking.

DOLOPAR M SUSPENSION should be used with caution in elderly patients (aged 65 years or above). Contact your doctor before taking.

The most common side effects of this medicine are skin rash, nausea, vomiting, diarrhea, abdominal pain, constipation, indigestion, flatulence, anorexia, dry mouth, heartburn, peptic ulcers, perforation or GI bleeding, and ulcerative stomatitis. Contact your doctor if any of the side effects worsen.

introduction:
Introduction About PARACETAMOL 500MG TABLET

PARACETAMOL 500MG TABLET contains Paracetamol which belongs to the group of medicines called Analgesics and Antipyretics. It is used to relieve mild to moderate pain (including headaches, backache, toothache, severe nerve pain, sore throat, period pain, low back and leg pain, muscle, connective tissue and joint pain, symptomatic relief of sprains, strain, joint swelling and stiffness). It is also used to lower fever (high body temperature) and relieve cold or flu symptoms.

Before taking PARACETAMOL 500MG TABLET, inform your doctor if you or your child have liver or kidney problems or any allergies. It should be used with caution in patients with liver problems due to alcohol to manage the risk of liver damage.

PARACETAMOL 500MG TABLET should be used with caution in pregnant women only if clearly advised by the doctor and can be used in breastfeeding women. PARACETAMOL 500MG TABLET is not recommended for use in children less than 10 years of age and should be used with caution in elderly patients.

Consult your doctor if you experience any side effects or unusual effects during management with PARACETAMOL 500MG TABLET.

Lowers fever and relieves the symptoms of cold or flu
usesDetails:

Relieves mild to moderate pain (such as headache, toothache, joint pain)

mechanismOfAction:
How PARACETAMOL 500MG TABLET Works

PARACETAMOL 500MG TABLET relieves pain by increasing the pain threshold by inhibiting certain enzymes (COX-1 and COX-2) involved in the synthesis of chemicals responsible for inducing pain (prostaglandins). It reduces fever by directly acting on heat-regulating centers in the brain, resulting in vessel relaxation, sweating and loss of body heat.
usageDetails:
How to use PARACETAMOL 500MG TABLET

Take PARACETAMOL 500MG TABLET as advised by your physician. It can be taken with or without food.

For Tablet, Capsule: Swallow PARACETAMOL 500MG TABLET with a glass of water. Do not crush or chew the medicine.

For Dispersible Tablet: Disperse the medicine in the specified quantity of water as mentioned on the label. Consume the medicine immediately after reconstitution.

Your doctor will decide the correct dose and duration of therapy for you depending upon your age, body weight and severity of the condition.

Introduction About ARCURE TABLET

ARCURE TABLET is a combination of Ibuprofen and Paracetamol, which belongs to the group of medicines called Non-steroidal anti-inflammatory drugs (NSAIDs) and Analgesics respectively. It is used to manage minor aches and pains such as headaches, toothaches, muscular aches, backaches, pain due to inflammation and for reduction of fever due to any of the above conditions in adults and children aged 12 years and above. Analgesics help to reduce fever.

Before taking this medicine, inform your doctor if you are allergic (hypersensitive) to ibuprofen, paracetamol, or any other NSAIDs such as aspirin.

Also tell the doctor if you have, liver, kidney, or heart problems. Pregnant and breastfeeding women should consult their doctors before taking the medicine.

The most common side effects are diarrhoea, nausea, vomiting, stomach pain, and dizziness. Consult your doctor for advice if any of the above side effects worsen or persist for a longer duration.

introduction:
Introduction About TAKOL CR 100MG CAPSULE

TAKOL CR 100MG CAPSULE contains Tramadol which belongs to the group of medicines called Opioids. It is used in the management of moderate to severe pain (such as sudden or long-standing pain like pain after an operation or after an injury) in adults and adolescents aged 12 years and older.

TAKOL CR 100MG CAPSULE is not recommended for use in patients with severe liver of kidney insufficiency, seizures (fits) which are not controlled by the management, who have consumed alcohol, withdrawal symptoms due to addiction of drugs or those have accidentally consumed extra dose of sleeping tablets, antipsychotics, antidepressants or other pain killers (which can slow down the breathing and reactions).

Before taking TAKOL CR 100MG CAPSULE, inform your doctor if you have mild to moderate liver or kidney insufficiency, asthma or breathing trouble, recently had a head injury or have a very bad headache that makes you sick, had convulsions (fits) or suffer from epilepsy, have recently felt confused, sleepy or fainted, are going to have any surgery (which requires anaesthesia), have tendency to drug addiction or abuse and if you are addicted to morphine.

TAKOL CR 100MG CAPSULE is not recommended for use in pregnant women and not more than once or alternatively in breastfeeding women. TAKOL CR 100MG CAPSULE is not recommended for use in children (below 12 years of age) and in children with breathing problems. It should be cautiously used among elderly patients (aged 75 years and above).

The most common side effects of taking TAKOL CR 100MG CAPSULE are nausea, vomiting, dizziness, headache, constipation and dry mouth. Consult your doctor if any of the side effects worsens.
uses: Manage moderate to severe pain (such as sudden or long-standing pain)
usesDetails:
Uses Of TAKOL CR 100MG CAPSULE
Manage moderate to severe pain (such as sudden or long-standing pain)
mechanismOfAction:
How TAKOL CR 100MG CAPSULE Works

TAKOL CR 100MG CAPSULE inhibits the reuptake of the natural neurotransmitters (norepinephrine and serotonin) and binds weakly to certain receptors (μ-opioid), blocking the transmission of pain signals to the brain. Thus, it reduces moderate to severe pain by acting on specific nerve cells of the spinal cord and the brain.

Your doctor will decide the correct dose and duration for you depending upon your age, body weight and disease condition.

Introduction About PARAFAST 500MG TABLET

PARAFAST 500MG TABLET contains Paracetamol which belongs to the group of medicines called Analgesics and Antipyretics. It is used to relieve mild to moderate pain (including headaches, backache, toothache, severe nerve pain, sore throat, period pain, low back and leg pain, muscle, connective tissue and joint pain, symptomatic relief of sprains, strain, joint swelling and stiffness). It is also used to lower fever (high body temperature) and relieve cold or flu symptoms.

Before taking PARAFAST 500MG TABLET, inform your doctor if you or your child have liver or kidney problems or any allergies. It should be used with caution in patients with liver problems due to alcohol to manage the risk of liver damage.

PARAFAST 500MG TABLET should be used with caution in pregnant women only if clearly advised by the doctor and can be used in breastfeeding women. PARAFAST 500MG TABLET is not recommended for use in children less than 10 years of age and should be used with caution in elderly patients.

Consult your doctor if you experience any side effects or unusual effects during management with PARAFAST 500MG TABLET.

How PARAFAST 500MG TABLET Works

PARAFAST 500MG TABLET relieves pain by increasing the pain threshold by inhibiting certain enzymes (COX-1 and COX-2) involved in the synthesis of chemicals responsible for inducing pain (prostaglandins). It reduces fever by directly acting on heat-regulating centers in the brain, resulting in vessel relaxation, sweating and loss of body heat.

Take PARAFAST 500MG TABLET as advised by your physician. It can be taken with or without food.

For Tablet, Capsule: Swallow PARAFAST 500MG TABLET with a glass of water. Do not crush or chew the medicine.

For Dispersible Tablet: Disperse the medicine in the specified quantity of water as mentioned on the label. Consume the medicine immediately after reconstitution.

Your doctor will decide the correct dose and duration of therapy for you depending upon your age, body weight and severity of the condition.

name: Parawel 650mg Tablet 15'S
introduction:
Introduction About PARAWEL 650MG TABLET

Parawel-650 Tablet belongs to antipyretic and analgesic (pain killers) medicine which is used to relieve mild to moderate pain (such as headache, toothache, back and menstrual pain) and fever. It contains paracetamol as an active ingredient which is used to manage a wide range of painful conditions and fever.

Paracetamol acts as an antipyretic as well as painkiller. It works by inhibiting the production of a chemical called prostaglandins in the body, which are responsible for causing pain and swelling in the body. As a result, it reduces various pain. It also has a direct action on heat regulating centres in the brain, leading to peripheral vasodilation, sweating and loss of body temperature. Thus, it reduces fever.

Always take Parawel-650 Tablet as advised by the physician. Swallow the medicine as a whole with a glass of water and do not crush or chew the medicine. Do not exceed the recommended daily dosage.

introduction:
Introduction About CIPMOL PINEAPPLE FLAVOUR DROPS

Cipmol Pineapple Flavour Drops is an analgesic and antipyretic medicine used in children to reduce high temperature (fever) and provides relief from mild to moderate pain. It contains paracetamol as an active ingredient to effectively reduce fever and relieves pain.

Paracetamol acts as an antipyretic as well as painkiller. It works by inhibiting the production of a chemical called prostaglandins in the body, which are responsible for causing pain and swelling in the body. As a result, it reduces various pain. It also has a direct action on heat regulating centres in the brain, leading to peripheral vasodilation, sweating and loss of body temperature. Thus, it reduces fever.

Always give Cipmol Pineapple Flavour Drops to your child as advised by the physician. Shake well before each use. Use a dropper provided with the package for correct dosing. Recommended dosage is 10-15mg/kg throughout the 24-hour period. Administering more than the daily dosage may cause serious liver damage or allergic reactions (such as swelling of the face, mouth and throat, difficulty in breathing, itching or rash).

name: CIPMOL PAIN RELIEF Tablet 10's
introduction:
Introduction About CIPMOL PAIN RELIEF TABLET

Cipmol Pain Relief Tablet helps to provide relief from headache. It contains paracetamol and caffeine as active ingredients for effective headache relief.  

Paracetamol blocks the release of certain chemical substances in the brain called prostaglandins which are responsible for pain whereas caffeine blocks adenosine receptors that influences pain signalling.

Always take Cipmol Pain Relief Tablet as advised by the doctor. Swallow the medicine as a whole with a glass of water and do not crush or chew the medicine. Recommended dosage is 1 tablet, 3 to 4 times in divided doses in 24 hours or as directed by the doctor. Maximum dosage is 4 tablets in equally divided doses in 24 hours. Do not use for more than two days unless directed by the doctor. It is not recommended for use in children below 12 years of age. Consult your doctor before taking this medicine if you have liver/kidney impairment or blood clotting disorder.

introduction:
Introduction About POLYMOL 650 TABLET

POLYMOL 650 TABLET contains Paracetamol which belongs to the group of medicines called Analgesics and Antipyretics. It is used to relieve mild to moderate pain (including headaches, backache, toothache, severe nerve pain, sore throat, period pain, low back and leg pain, muscle, connective tissue and joint pain, symptomatic relief of sprains, strain, joint swelling and stiffness). It is also used to lower fever (high body temperature) and relieves the symptoms of cold or flu.   

Before taking POLYMOL 650 TABLET, inform your doctor if you or your child have liver or kidney problems or any allergies. It should be used with caution in patients with liver problems due to alcohol to manage the risk of liver damage.

POLYMOL 650 TABLET should be used with caution in pregnant women only if clearly advised by the doctor and can be used in breastfeeding women. POLYMOL 650 TABLET is not recommended for use in children less than 10 years of age and should be used with caution in elderly patients.

Consult your doctor if you experience any side effects or unusual effects during management with POLYMOL 650 TABLET.

name: TRAMPOL Tablet 10's
introduction:
Introduction About TRAMPOL TABLET

TRAMPOL TABLET is a combination of Paracetamol and Tramadol which belongs to the group of medicines called Analgesics and Opioid analgesics respectively. TRAMPOL TABLET is used in the management of moderate to severe pain.     

Pain is a complex and unpleasant sensation consisting of a physiological and a psychological response to a noxious stimulus. Pain is a warning mechanism that protects us by influencing it to withdraw from harmful stimuli, which is primarily associated with injury.              

Before taking TRAMPOL TABLET, inform your doctor if you have respiratory disorders, gastrointestinal obstruction, including paralytic ileus, fits or seizures, have recently suffered from a head injury, depression, intolerance to some sugars, kidney or liver problems.

TRAMPOL TABLET is not recommended for use in pregnant women and during breast-feeding more than once as it may pass through breast milk.  

TRAMPOL TABLET is not recommended for use in children (under 12 years of age) and should be used with caution in elderly patients (aged 65 years and above).  

The common side effects of taking TRAMPOL TABLET are nausea, dizziness, drowsiness, vomiting, gastrointestinal problems (such as constipation, flatulence, diarrhoea), stomach pain and dry mouth. Consult your physician if any of the side effects worsen.
uses: Manage moderate to severe pain
usesDetails:
Uses Of TRAMPOL TABLET
Manage moderate to severe pain
mechanismOfAction:
How TRAMPOL TABLET Works

TRAMPOL TABLET contains Tramadol and Paracetamol. Tramadol acts on pain receptors present in the central nervous system. It blocks the nerve signals responsible for pain.  Paracetamol acts as an analgesic by inhibiting the release of certain chemical mediators that produce pain. Tramadol and paracetamol, in combination, have a faster action and provide quick relief from pain.
usageDetails:
How to use TRAMPOL TABLET

Take TRAMPOL TABLET as advised by your physician.

For tablet:

 Swallow the medicine with a glass of water. Do not crush or chew the medicine.

For effervescent tablet:

Take TRAMPOL TABLET by dissolving in a glass of drinking water.

Your doctor will decide the correct dose and duration for you depending upon your age, body weight and disease condition.

introduction:
Introduction About TRAPALIN TABLET

TRAPALIN TABLET is a combination of Paracetamol and Tramadol which belongs to the group of medicines called Analgesics and Opioid analgesics respectively. TRAPALIN TABLET is used in the management of moderate to severe pain.

Pain is a complex and unpleasant sensation consisting of a physiological and a psychological response to a noxious stimulus. Pain is a warning mechanism that protects us by influencing it to withdraw from harmful stimuli, which is primarily associated with injury.

Before taking TRAPALIN TABLET, inform your doctor if you have respiratory disorders, gastrointestinal obstruction, including paralytic ileus, fits or seizures, have recently suffered from a head injury, depression, intolerance to some sugars, kidney or liver problems.

TRAPALIN TABLET is not recommended for use in pregnant women and during breast-feeding more than once as it may pass through breast milk.  

TRAPALIN TABLET is not recommended for use in children (under 12 years of age) and should be used with caution in elderly patients (aged 65 years and above).  

The common side effects of taking TRAPALIN TABLET are nausea, dizziness, drowsiness, vomiting, gastrointestinal problems (such as constipation, flatulence, diarrhoea), stomach pain and dry mouth. Consult your physician if any of the side effects worsen.
uses: Manage moderate to severe pain
usesDetails:
Uses Of TRAPALIN TABLET
Manage moderate to severe pain
mechanismOfAction:
How TRAPALIN TABLET Works

TRAPALIN TABLET contains Tramadol and Paracetamol. Tramadol acts on pain receptors present in the central nervous system. It blocks the nerve signals responsible for pain. Paracetamol acts as an analgesic by inhibiting the release of certain chemical mediators that produce pain. Tramadol and paracetamol, in combination, have a faster action and provide quick relief from pain.
usageDetails:
How to use TRAPALIN TABLET

Take TRAPALIN TABLET as advised by your physician.

For tablet:

 Swallow the medicine with a glass of water. Do not crush or chew the medicine.

For effervescent tablet:

Take TRAPALIN TABLET by dissolving in a glass of drinking water.

Your doctor will decide the correct dose and duration for you depending upon your age, body weight and disease condition.

TACIL TABLET contains Tramadol and Paracetamol. Tramadol acts on pain receptors present in the central nervous system. It blocks the nerve signals responsible for pain. Paracetamol acts as an analgesic by inhibiting the release of certain chemical mediators that produce pain. Tramadol and paracetamol, in combination, have a faster action and provide quick relief from pain.
usageDetails:
How to use TACIL TABLET

Take TACIL TABLET as advised by your physician.

For tablet:

 Swallow the medicine with a glass of water. Do not crush or chew the medicine.

For effervescent tablet:

Take TACIL TABLET by dissolving in a glass of drinking water.

Your doctor will decide the correct dose and duration for you depending upon your age, body weight and disease condition.
