warnings.details: TACIL TABLET is generally not recommended for use in pregnant women. Consult your doctor before taking it.
TACIL TABLET is not recommended for use during breast-feeding more than once as it may pass through breast milk. Consult your doctor before taking it.
Do not drive or operate any machines if you feel drowsy after taking TACIL TABLET.
Avoid consumption of alcohol while taking TACIL TABLET because it might make you feel drowsy and it is not recommended for use in patients with acute alcohol poisoning.
TACIL TABLET should be used with caution in patients with kidney problems. Consult your doctor before taking TACIL TABLET.

TACIL TABLET is not recommended for use in patients with severe liver disorder and should be used with caution in patients with liver problems or jaundice. Consult your doctor before taking TACIL TABLET.
Do not take TACIL TABLET if you are allergic to Paracetamol, Tramadol or any other ingredients of this medicine.
TACIL TABLET should be used with caution in patients who have severe difficulties in breathing like asthma or severe lung problems. Consult your doctor before taking TACIL TABLET.

Others

TACIL TABLET is not recommended for use if you:

Have epilepsy (which is not adequately controlled by your current medicine)
Known or suspected gastrointestinal obstruction including paralytic ileus

Before taking TACIL TABLET, inform your doctor if you:

Have epilepsy or already experienced fits or seizures
Have recently suffered from a head injury, shock or severe headaches associated with vomiting
Have intolerance to certain sugars
Have depression

Use in pediatrics:

TACIL TABLET is not recommended for use in children (under 12 years of age). Consult your child’s doctor for advice.

Use in geriatrics:

TACIL TABLET should be used with caution in elderly patients (aged 65 years and above). Consult your doctor before taking it.

Interactions

A. Drug - Drug interactions:

Before taking TACIL TABLET, inform your doctor if you are taking any of the following medicines:

Medicines used to manage nausea and vomiting (Ex. metoclopramide, domperidone or ondansetron)
Medicines used against infections (Ex. ketoconazole, flucloxacillin, erythromycin)
Medicine used to reduce cholesterol in the blood (Ex. cholestyramine)
Medicine used in the management of depression or Parkinson’s disease (Ex. monoamine oxidase inhibitors such as phenelzine, isocarboxazid)  
Amitriptyline (used to manage depression)
Medicine used to help stop smoking (Ex. bupropion)
Baclofen (used as muscle relaxant)
Warfarin, phenprocoumon (used to manage or manage blood clots)
Medicine used to manage epilepsy (Ex. carbamazepine)
Morphine, buprenorphine, nalbuphine or pentazocine (used to manage severe pain)

Overdosage:

If you or anyone else accidentally take too much of TACIL TABLET, consult your doctor immediately or visit the nearby hospital. Overdosage symptoms of TACIL TABLET includes loss of appetite, nausea, vomiting, malaise, pallor, excess sweating, respiratory depression and seizures.

introduction:
Introduction About TAPNEX ER 50MG TABLET

TAPNEX ER 50MG TABLET contains Tapentadol which belongs to the group of medicines called Opioids. It is used in adults for the management of severe chronic pain which can only be managed by a strong (opioid) painkiller.

TAPNEX ER 50MG TABLET is not recommended for use in patients having severe kidney or liver problems, asthma or if your breathing is dangerously slow or shallow (respiratory depression, hypercapnia), paralysis of the gut (muscles of the gastrointestinal tract).

TAPNEX ER 50MG TABLET should be used with caution in patients who have slow or shallow breathing, increased pressure in the brain, disturbed consciousness up to coma, head injury or brain tumour, pancreatic or biliary tract disease (pancreatitis), increased tendency towards epilepsy, have tendency to abuse medicines (habituating), moderate liver problems, kidney disease and intolerance to certain sugars (such as lactose).

TAPNEX ER 50MG TABLET is not recommended for use in pregnant women unless recommended by the doctor and it is not recommended for use in breast-feeding women. TAPNEX ER 50MG TABLET is not recommended for use in children and adolescents (below 18 years of age) and it should be used with caution in elderly patients (aged 65 years of age).

The most common side effects of taking TAPNEX ER 50MG TABLET are nausea, constipation, dizziness, drowsiness, headache, decreased appetite, indigestion and flushing. Consult your doctor if any of the side effects worsen.
uses: Manages severe chronic pain in adults
usesDetails:
Uses Of TAPNEX ER 50MG TABLET
Manages severe chronic pain in adults
mechanismOfAction:
How TAPNEX ER 50MG TABLET Works

TAPNEX ER 50MG TABLET acts directly on the central nervous system and reduces the feeling of pain by interrupting the way in which pain is signalled between brain and the body. TAPNEX ER 50MG TABLET binds with certain receptors called µ-opioid receptors and also increases the release of a nerve chemical called norepinephrine which causes inhibition of certain receptors leading to pain relief.

warnings.details: TAPNEX ER 50MG TABLET is not recommended for use in pregnant women unless recommended by the doctor as it can cause withdrawal symptoms in the new-born baby when used for prolonged period of time, which might be life threatening and could also possibly lead to dangerously slow or shallow breathing in the newborn. TAPNEX ER 50MG TABLET is not recommended for use in breastfeeding women as it may pass through the breast milk. Consult your doctor before taking TAPNEX ER 50MG TABLET.
Do not drive or use any machinery while taking TAPNEX ER 50MG TABLET if you experience drowsiness, dizziness, blurred vision or impairment of reactions.
Avoid consumption of alcohol while taking TAPNEX ER 50MG TABLET as it may increase the effect of drowsiness.

TAPNEX ER 50MG TABLET is not recommended for use in patients with severe kidney problems. It should be used with caution in patients suffering from kidney disease. Consult your doctor before taking TAPNEX ER 50MG TABLET.

TAPNEX ER 50MG TABLET is not recommended for use in patients with severe liver problems. TAPNEX ER 50MG TABLET should be used with caution in patients with moderate liver problems and your doctor may adjust the dose. Consult your doctor before taking TAPNEX ER 50MG TABLET.
Do not take TAPNEX ER 50MG TABLET if you are allergic to Tapentadol or any other ingredients of this medicine.

TAPNEX ER 50MG TABLET is not recommended for use in patients having lung diseases such as asthma or dangerously slow and shallow breathing (hypercapnia, respiratory depression). It should be used with caution in patients having other breathing issues (slow or shallow breathing). Consult your doctor before taking TAPNEX ER 50MG TABLET.

Others

TAPNEX ER 50MG TABLET is not recommended for use if you:

Have paralysis of the gut (muscles of the gastrointestinal tract)
Have acute poisoning of alcohol, sleeping pills, pain relievers or other psychotropic medicines (medicines that affect mood and emotions)

Before taking TAPNEX ER 50MG TABLET inform your doctor if you:

Have increased pressure in the brain or disturbed consciousness up to coma
Had a head injury or brain tumour
Have a disease affecting the pancreas (such as pancreatitis) or biliary tract
Have tendency towards fits
Have tendency to abuse medicines (getting habitual of it)
Have lactose intolerance

Use in paediatrics:

TAPNEX ER 50MG TABLET is not recommended for use in children and adolescents (below 18 years of age). Consult your child’s doctor for advice.     

 Use in geriatrics:

TAPNEX ER 50MG TABLET should be used with caution in elderly patients (aged 65 years and above) due to delayed excretion of this medicine in this age group and your doctor may adjust the dose. Consult your doctor before taking TAPNEX ER 50MG TABLET.

Interactions

A. Drug–Drug Interactions:

Before taking TAPNEX ER 50MG TABLET inform your doctor if you are taking any of the following medicines:

Sedatives such as zolpidem, barbiturates (Ex. amobarbital, pentobarbital) antidepressants such as paroxetine, sertraline and anti-psychotics such as loxapine, clozapine, monoamine oxidase inhibitors (MAOIs) such as isocarboxazid (used to manage depression, anxiety, mood disorders, sleep disturbances) 
Opioids such as codeine, oxymorphone, mixed mu-opioid agonist/antagonists such as pentazocine, nalbuphine, partial mu-opioid agonists such as buprenorphine (used to manage severe pain)
Antihistamines such as cetirizine, loratadine (used to manage allergy)
Rifampicin (used to manage tuberculosis)
St. john’s wort (herbal medicine used to manage depression)

Overdosage:

If you or anyone else accidentally takes too much of TAPNEX ER 50MG TABLET, consult your doctor immediately or visit the nearby hospital. Overdosage symptoms of TAPNEX ER 50MG TABLET are pin-point pupils, vomiting, fast heartbeat, drop in blood pressure, collapse, disturbed consciousness or coma (deep unconsciousness), epileptic fits (convulsions), dangerously slow or shallow breathing or stopping breathing may occur.

name: Dolomol 500mg Tablet 10'S
introduction:
Introduction About DOLOMOL 500MG TABLET

DOLOMOL 500MG TABLET contains Paracetamol which belongs to the group of medicines called Analgesics and Antipyretics. It is used to relieve mild to moderate pain (including headaches, backache, toothache, severe nerve pain, sore throat, period pain, low back and leg pain, muscle, connective tissue and joint pain, symptomatic relief of sprains, strain, joint swelling and stiffness). It is also used to lower fever (high body temperature) and relieve cold or flu symptoms.

Before taking DOLOMOL 500MG TABLET, inform your doctor if you or your child have liver or kidney problems or any allergies. It should be used with caution in patients with liver problems due to alcohol to manage the risk of liver damage.

DOLOMOL 500MG TABLET should be used with caution in pregnant women only if clearly advised by the doctor and can be used in breastfeeding women. DOLOMOL 500MG TABLET is not recommended for use in children less than 10 years of age and should be used with caution in elderly patients.

Consult your doctor if you experience any side effects or unusual effects during management with DOLOMOL 500MG TABLET.
uses: Relieves mild to moderate pain (such as headache, toothache, joint pain)
Lowers fever and relieves the symptoms of cold or flu
usesDetails:
Uses Of DOLOMOL 500MG TABLET
Relieves mild to moderate pain (such as headache, toothache, joint pain)
Lowers fever and relieves the symptoms of cold or flu
mechanismOfAction:
How DOLOMOL 500MG TABLET Works

DOLOMOL 500MG TABLET relieves pain by increasing the pain threshold by inhibiting certain enzymes (COX-1 and COX-2) involved in the synthesis of chemicals responsible for inducing pain (prostaglandins). It reduces fever by directly acting on heat-regulating centers in the brain, resulting in vessel relaxation, sweating and loss of body heat.
usageDetails:
How to use DOLOMOL 500MG TABLET

Take DOLOMOL 500MG TABLET as advised by your physician. It can be taken with or without food.

For Tablet, Capsule: Swallow DOLOMOL 500MG TABLET with a glass of water. Do not crush or chew the medicine.

For Dispersible Tablet: Disperse the medicine in the specified quantity of water as mentioned on the label. Consume the medicine immediately after reconstitution.

Your doctor will decide the correct dose and duration of therapy for you depending upon your age, body weight and severity of the condition.

name: Calpol 500mg Tablet 1000'S
introduction:
Introduction About CALPOL 500MG TABLET

Calpol 500mg Tablet is used to relieve mild to moderate pain and fever. It contains Paracetamol as active ingredient used for pain relief.

Paracetamol relieves pain by increasing the pain threshold by inhibiting certain enzymes (COX-1 and COX-2) involved in the synthesis of chemicals responsible for inducing pain (prostaglandins). It reduces fever by directly acting on heat-regulating centers in the brain, resulting in vessel relaxation, sweating and loss of body heat.

Take Calpol Tablet as advised by your doctor. Do not exceed the recommended daily dosage.  Swallow with a glass of water, do not crush or chew the medicine. It should be used with caution in patients with liver or kidney problem. Inform  your doctor if you are pregnant or breastfeeding.

Introduction About PARACIN 250MG SUSPENSION

PARACIN 250MG SUSPENSION contains Paracetamol which belongs to the group of medicines called Analgesics and Antipyretics. It is used to relieve mild to moderate pain like headache, migraine, nerve pain, toothache, sore throat, period pains, teething, immunisation, earache, and general aches and pains. Before taking PARACIN 250MG SUSPENSION, inform your doctor if you have liver or kidney problems, fructose intolerance, Gilberts syndrome, glucose-6-phosphate dehydrogenase deficiency, hemolytic anaemia, reduced glutathione levels, malnourishment, dehydration or if you weigh less than 50 kg.

PARACIN 250MG SUSPENSION should be used in pregnant women only if considered necessary. Avoid consumption of alcohol during management with PARACIN 250MG SUSPENSION, as it might make you more prone to side effects.

PARACIN 250MG SUSPENSION is not recommended for use in children (2-3 months old, weighing less than 4 kg or born before 37 weeks). Contact your doctor if you get any side effects of any of the symptoms get worse.

introduction:
Introduction About TRAMASTAT PLUS TABLET

TRAMASTAT PLUS TABLET is a combination of Paracetamol and Tramadol which belongs to the group of medicines called Analgesics and Opioid analgesics respectively. TRAMASTAT PLUS TABLET is used in the management of moderate to severe pain.

Pain is a complex and unpleasant sensation consisting of a physiological and a psychological response to a noxious stimulus. Pain is a warning mechanism that protects us by influencing it to withdraw from harmful stimuli, which is primarily associated with injury.

Before taking TRAMASTAT PLUS TABLET, inform your doctor if you have respiratory disorders, gastrointestinal obstruction, including paralytic ileus, fits or seizures, have recently suffered from a head injury, depression, intolerance to some sugars, kidney or liver problems.

TRAMASTAT PLUS TABLET is not recommended for use in pregnant women and during breast-feeding more than once as it may pass through breast milk.  

TRAMASTAT PLUS TABLET is not recommended for use in children (under 12 years of age) and should be used with caution in elderly patients (aged 65 years and above).  

The common side effects of taking TRAMASTAT PLUS TABLET are nausea, dizziness, drowsiness, vomiting, gastrointestinal problems (such as constipation, flatulence, diarrhoea), stomach pain and dry mouth. Consult your physician if any of the side effects worsen.
uses: Manage moderate to severe pain

Manage moderate to severe pain
mechanismOfAction:
How TRAMASTAT PLUS TABLET Works

TRAMASTAT PLUS TABLET contains Tramadol and Paracetamol. Tramadol acts on pain receptors present in the central nervous system. It blocks the nerve signals responsible for pain. Paracetamol acts as an analgesic by inhibiting the release of certain chemical mediators that produce pain. Tramadol and paracetamol, in combination, have a faster action and provide quick relief from pain.

For effervescent tablet:

Take TRAMASTAT PLUS TABLET by dissolving in a glass of drinking water.

Your doctor will decide the correct dose and duration for you depending upon your age, body weight and disease condition.

ACUGESIC T TABLET contains Tramadol and Paracetamol. Tramadol acts on pain receptors present in the central nervous system. It blocks the nerve signals responsible for pain. Paracetamol acts as an analgesic by inhibiting the release of certain chemical mediators that produce pain. Tramadol and paracetamol, in combination, have a faster action and provide quick relief from pain.
usageDetails:
How to use ACUGESIC T TABLET

Take ACUGESIC T TABLET as advised by your physician.

For tablet:

 Swallow the medicine with a glass of water. Do not crush or chew the medicine.

For effervescent tablet:

Take ACUGESIC T TABLET by dissolving in a glass of drinking water.

Your doctor will decide the correct dose and duration for you depending upon your age, body weight and disease condition.

warnings.details: ACUGESIC T TABLET is generally not recommended for use in pregnant women. Consult your doctor before taking it.
ACUGESIC T TABLET is not recommended for use during breast-feeding more than once as it may pass through breast milk. Consult your doctor before taking it.
Do not drive or operate any machines if you feel drowsy after taking ACUGESIC T TABLET.
Avoid consumption of alcohol while taking ACUGESIC T TABLET because it might make you feel drowsy and it is not recommended for use in patients with acute alcohol poisoning.
ACUGESIC T TABLET should be used with caution in patients with kidney problems. Consult your doctor before taking ACUGESIC T TABLET.

ACUGESIC T TABLET is not recommended for use in patients with severe liver disorder and should be used with caution in patients with liver problems or jaundice. Consult your doctor before taking ACUGESIC T TABLET.
Do not take ACUGESIC T TABLET if you are allergic to Paracetamol, Tramadol or any other ingredients of this medicine.
ACUGESIC T TABLET should be used with caution in patients who have severe difficulties in breathing like asthma or severe lung problems. Consult your doctor before taking ACUGESIC T TABLET.

Others

ACUGESIC T TABLET is not recommended for use if you:

Have epilepsy (which is not adequately controlled by your current medicine)
Known or suspected gastrointestinal obstruction including paralytic ileus

Before taking ACUGESIC T TABLET, inform your doctor if you:

Have epilepsy or already experienced fits or seizures
Have recently suffered from a head injury, shock or severe headaches associated with vomiting
Have intolerance to certain sugars
Have depression

Use in pediatrics:

ACUGESIC T TABLET is not recommended for use in children (under 12 years of age). Consult your child’s doctor for advice.

Use in geriatrics:

ACUGESIC T TABLET should be used with caution in elderly patients (aged 65 years and above). Consult your doctor before taking it.

interactions:
Interactions

A. Drug - Drug interactions:

Before taking ACUGESIC T TABLET, inform your doctor if you are taking any of the following medicines:

Medicines used to manage nausea and vomiting (Ex. metoclopramide, domperidone or ondansetron)
Medicines used against infections (Ex. ketoconazole, flucloxacillin, erythromycin)
Medicine used to reduce cholesterol in the blood (Ex. cholestyramine)
Medicine used in the management of depression or Parkinson’s disease (Ex. monoamine oxidase inhibitors such as phenelzine, isocarboxazid)  
Amitriptyline (used to manage depression)
Medicine used to help stop smoking (Ex. bupropion)
Baclofen (used as muscle relaxant)
Warfarin, phenprocoumon (used to manage or manage blood clots)
Medicine used to manage epilepsy (Ex. carbamazepine)
Morphine, buprenorphine, nalbuphine or pentazocine (used to manage severe pain)

Overdosage:

If you or anyone else accidentally take too much of ACUGESIC T TABLET, consult your doctor immediately or visit the nearby hospital. Overdosage symptoms of ACUGESIC T TABLET includes loss of appetite, nausea, vomiting, malaise, pallor, excess sweating, respiratory depression and seizures.

name: DOLOCET Tablet 10's
introduction:
Introduction About DOLOCET TABLET

DOLOCET TABLET is a combination of Paracetamol and Tramadol which belongs to the group of medicines called Analgesics and Opioid analgesics respectively. DOLOCET TABLET is used in the management of moderate to severe pain.

Pain is a complex and unpleasant sensation consisting of a physiological and a psychological response to a noxious stimulus. Pain is a warning mechanism that protects us by influencing it to withdraw from harmful stimuli, which is primarily associated with injury.

Before taking DOLOCET TABLET, inform your doctor if you have respiratory disorders, gastrointestinal obstruction, including paralytic ileus, fits or seizures, have recently suffered from a head injury, depression, intolerance to some sugars, kidney or liver problems.

DOLOCET TABLET is not recommended for use in pregnant women and during breast-feeding more than once as it may pass through breast milk.  

DOLOCET TABLET is not recommended for use in children (under 12 years of age) and should be used with caution in elderly patients (aged 65 years and above).  

The common side effects of taking DOLOCET TABLET are nausea, dizziness, drowsiness, vomiting, gastrointestinal problems (such as constipation, flatulence, diarrhoea), stomach pain and dry mouth. Consult your physician if any of the side effects worsen.

name: Febrex 500mg Tablet 15'S
introduction:
Introduction About FEBREX 500MG TABLET

Febrex 500mg Tablet is an analgesic antipyretic used for fever and helps to relieve pain. It contains Paracetamol as an active ingredient that helps to reduce pain and temperature (fever).

Paracetamol blocks the production of prostaglandins (chemical messengers in the brain that regulate pain and heat) that helps to relieve fever and pain.

Always take Febrex 500mg Tablet as advised by your doctor. Swallow Febrex 500mg Tablet with a glass of water. Do not exceed the daily recommended dosages. Do not take if you are allergic to any of its ingredients. It is not recommended to give Febrex 500mg Tablet for children below 10 years of age. Before taking, inform your doctor if you are pregnant, breast feeding or having liver or kidney diseases. Stop taking Febrex 500mg Tablet and contact doctor immediately if you experience symptoms such as swelling in legs, arms, face, throat or tongue, difficulty in breathing, swallowing, rashes.

Do not take TRALOCET TABLET if you are allergic to Paracetamol, Tramadol or any other ingredients of this medicine.

Lungs

TRALOCET TABLET should be used with caution in patients who have severe difficulties in breathing like asthma or severe lung problems. Consult your doctor before taking TRALOCET TABLET.

introduction:
Introduction About NICETAMOL 250MG SUSPENSION

NICETAMOL 250MG SUSPENSION contains Paracetamol which belongs to the group of medicines called Analgesics and Antipyretics. It is used to relieve mild to moderate pain like headache, migraine, nerve pain, toothache, sore throat, period pains, teething, immunisation, earache, and general aches and pains. It can also be used to manage fever (high temperature), and symptoms of cold or flu.

Before taking NICETAMOL 250MG SUSPENSION, inform your doctor if you have liver or kidney problems, fructose intolerance, Gilberts syndrome, glucose-6-phosphate dehydrogenase deficiency, hemolytic anaemia, reduced glutathione levels, malnourishment, dehydration or if you weigh less than 50 kg.

NICETAMOL 250MG SUSPENSION should be used in pregnant women only if considered necessary. Avoid consumption of alcohol during management with NICETAMOL 250MG SUSPENSION, as it might make you more prone to side effects.

NICETAMOL 250MG SUSPENSION is not recommended for use in children (2-3 months old, weighing less than 4 kg or born before 37 weeks). Contact your doctor if you get any side effects of any of the symptoms get worse.
uses: Relieves mild to moderate pain, fever, and symptoms of cold or flu
usesDetails:

mechanismOfAction:
How NICETAMOL 250MG SUSPENSION Works

NICETAMOL 250MG SUSPENSION relieves pain by increasing the pain threshold by inhibiting certain enzymes (COX-1 and COX-2) involved in synthesis of chemicals responsible for inducing pain (prostaglandins). It reduces fever by directly acting on heat-regulating centers in the brain, resulting in vessel relaxation, sweating, and loss of body heat.

Take NICETAMOL 250MG SUSPENSION as advised by your physician. Shake well before use. Your doctor will decide the correct dose and duration for you based upon your age, body weight and disease condition.

introduction:
Introduction About PARACIP INFUSION

PARACIP INFUSION contains Paracetamol which belongs to the group of medicines called Analgesics and Antipyretics. It is used for short-term management of moderate pain (especially after surgery) and fever when administered by the intravenous route is clinically justified.

Before receiving PARACIP INFUSION, inform your doctor if you have heart, lung, liver or kidney problems or if you suffer from alcoholism or alcohol abuse, malnourishment and severely low blood volume due to dehydration or blood loss.

PARACIP INFUSION should be used with caution in pregnant and breastfeeding women only if clearly advised by the doctor. PARACIP INFUSION should be used with caution in children and elderly patients.

The most common side effects of receiving PARACIP INFUSION are nausea, vomiting, headache, sleep problems and itching. Inform your doctor if any of these side effect worsens.

name: TRAUSPI Tablet 10's
introduction:
Introduction About TRAUSPI TABLET

TRAUSPI TABLET is a combination of Paracetamol and Tramadol which belongs to the group of medicines called Analgesics and Opioid analgesics respectively. TRAUSPI TABLET is used in the management of moderate to severe pain.

Pain is a complex and unpleasant sensation consisting of a physiological and a psychological response to a noxious stimulus. Pain is a warning mechanism that protects us by influencing it to withdraw from harmful stimuli, which is primarily associated with injury.

Before taking TRAUSPI TABLET, inform your doctor if you have respiratory disorders, gastrointestinal obstruction, including paralytic ileus, fits or seizures, have recently suffered from a head injury, depression, intolerance to some sugars, kidney or liver problems.

TRAUSPI TABLET is not recommended for use in pregnant women and during breast-feeding more than once as it may pass through breast milk.  

TRAUSPI TABLET is not recommended for use in children (under 12 years of age) and should be used with caution in elderly patients (aged 65 years and above).  

The common side effects of taking TRAUSPI TABLET are nausea, dizziness, drowsiness, vomiting, gastrointestinal problems (such as constipation, flatulence, diarrhoea), stomach pain and dry mouth. Consult your physician if any of the side effects worsen.
uses: Manage moderate to severe pain
usesDetails:
Uses Of TRAUSPI TABLET
Manage moderate to severe pain
mechanismOfAction:
How TRAUSPI TABLET Works

TRAUSPI TABLET contains Tramadol and Paracetamol. Tramadol acts on pain receptors present in the central nervous system. It blocks the nerve signals responsible for pain. Paracetamol acts as an analgesic by inhibiting the release of certain chemical mediators that produce pain. Tramadol and paracetamol, in combination, have a faster action and provide quick relief from pain.
usageDetails:
How to use TRAUSPI TABLET

Take TRAUSPI TABLET as advised by your physician.

For tablet:

 Swallow the medicine with a glass of water. Do not crush or chew the medicine.

For effervescent tablet:

Take TRAUSPI TABLET by dissolving in a glass of drinking water.

Your doctor will decide the correct dose and duration for you depending upon your age, body weight and disease condition.

introduction:
Introduction About FASTRAM TABLET

FASTRAM TABLET is a combination of Paracetamol and Tramadol which belongs to the group of medicines called Analgesics and Opioid analgesics respectively. FASTRAM TABLET is used in the management of moderate to severe pain.

Pain is a complex and unpleasant sensation consisting of a physiological and a psychological response to a noxious stimulus. Pain is a warning mechanism that protects us by influencing it to withdraw from harmful stimuli, which is primarily associated with injury.

Before taking FASTRAM TABLET, inform your doctor if you have respiratory disorders, gastrointestinal obstruction, including paralytic ileus, fits or seizures, have recently suffered from a head injury, depression, intolerance to some sugars, kidney or liver problems.

FASTRAM TABLET is not recommended for use in pregnant women and during breast-feeding more than once as it may pass through breast milk.  

FASTRAM TABLET is not recommended for use in children (under 12 years of age) and should be used with caution in elderly patients (aged 65 years and above).  

The common side effects of taking FASTRAM TABLET are nausea, dizziness, drowsiness, vomiting, gastrointestinal problems (such as constipation, flatulence, diarrhoea), stomach pain and dry mouth. Consult your physician if any of the side effects worsen.
uses: Manage moderate to severe pain
usesDetails:
Uses Of FASTRAM TABLET
Manage moderate to severe pain
mechanismOfAction:
How FASTRAM TABLET Works

FASTRAM TABLET contains Tramadol and Paracetamol. Tramadol acts on pain receptors present in the central nervous system. It blocks the nerve signals responsible for pain. Paracetamol acts as an analgesic by inhibiting the release of certain chemical mediators that produce pain. Tramadol and paracetamol, in combination, have a faster action and provide quick relief from pain.

How to use FASTRAM TABLET

Take FASTRAM TABLET as advised by your physician.

For tablet:

 Swallow the medicine with a glass of water. Do not crush or chew the medicine.

For effervescent tablet:

Take FASTRAM TABLET by dissolving in a glass of drinking water.

Your doctor will decide the correct dose and duration for you depending upon your age, body weight and disease condition.

name: Biocetamol 150mg Injection 2ml
introduction:
Introduction About BIOCETAMOL 150MG INJECTION

BIOCETAMOL 150MG INJECTION contains Paracetamol which belongs to the group of medicines called Analgesics and Antipyretics. It is used for short-term management of moderate pain (especially after surgery) and fever when administered by the intravenous route is clinically justified.

Before receiving BIOCETAMOL 150MG INJECTION, inform your doctor if you have heart, lung, liver or kidney problems or if you suffer from alcoholism or alcohol abuse, malnourishment and severely low blood volume due to dehydration or blood loss.

BIOCETAMOL 150MG INJECTION should be used with caution in pregnant and breastfeeding women only if clearly advised by the doctor. BIOCETAMOL 150MG INJECTION should be used with caution in children and elderly patients.

The most common side effects of receiving BIOCETAMOL 150MG INJECTION are nausea, vomiting, headache, sleep problems and itching. Inform your doctor if any of these side effect worsens.
uses: For short-term management of moderate pain (especially after surgery) and fever
usesDetails:
Uses Of BIOCETAMOL 150MG INJECTION
For short-term management of moderate pain (especially after surgery) and fever
mechanismOfAction:
How BIOCETAMOL 150MG INJECTION Works

BIOCETAMOL 150MG INJECTION relieves pain by increasing the pain threshold by inhibiting certain enzymes (COX-1 and COX-2) involved in the synthesis of chemicals responsible for inducing pain (prostaglandins). It reduces fever by directly acting on heat-regulating centers in the brain, resulting in vessel relaxation, sweating and loss of body heat.
usageDetails:
How to use BIOCETAMOL 150MG INJECTION

BIOCETAMOL 150MG INJECTION will be given to you only by a doctor or a nurse into the vein as an intravenous infusion. Your doctor will decide the correct dose and duration for you based on your age, body weight and disease condition.
sideEffects: Serious allergic reaction or skin rash
sideEffectsDetails:
Side Effects Of BIOCETAMOL 150MG INJECTION
Common
Nausea, vomiting, constipation
Headache
Sleep problems
Itching
Rare
Feeling generally unwell
Drop in blood pressure
Abnormal levels of liver enzymes

Inform your doctor immediately if you experience any of the following side effects while receiving BIOCETAMOL 150MG INJECTION:

Serious allergic reaction or skin rash

BIOCETAMOL 150MG INJECTION should be used with caution in patients with alcoholism or those who suffer from alcohol abuse.
BIOCETAMOL 150MG INJECTION should be used with caution in patients with kidney disease. Consult your doctor before receiving it.
BIOCETAMOL 150MG INJECTION is not recommended for use in patients with severe liver disease. It should be used with caution in patients with liver disease. Consult your doctor before receiving it.
Do not receive BIOCETAMOL 150MG INJECTION if you are allergic to Paracetamol, propacetamol or any other ingredients of this medicine.
Repeated use of BIOCETAMOL 150MG INJECTION is not recommended for use in patients with lung disease. Consult your doctor before receiving it.

BIOCETAMOL 150MG INJECTION should be used with caution in children and your child’s doctor may adjust the dose depending upon the child’s age and body weight. Consult your child’s doctor for advice before administration of BIOCETAMOL 150MG INJECTION.

Have anaemia

name: ULTRAMOL RF 650 Tablet 10's
introduction:
Introduction About ULTRAMOL RF 650 TABLET

ULTRAMOL RF 650 Tablet is an analgesic to relieve mild to moderate pain. It contains Paracetamol as an active ingredient to lower fever, common cold or flu.

Paracetamol relieves pain by increasing the pain threshold by inhibiting certain enzymes (COX-1 and COX-2) involved in the synthesis of chemicals responsible for inducing pain (prostaglandins). It reduces fever by directly acting on heat-regulating centres in the brain, resulting in vessel relaxation, sweating and loss of body heat.

Take ULTRAMOL RF 650 Tablet as advised by your doctor. Do not exceed the recommended daily dosage.  Swallow with a glass of water, do not crush or chew the medicine. It should be used with caution in patients with liver or kidney problems. Inform your doctor if you are pregnant or breastfeeding. Not recommended in children below 10 years of age.

name: CENTRA DT Tablet 10's
introduction:
Introduction About CENTRA DT TABLET

CENTRA DT TABLET contains Tramadol which belongs to the group of medicines called Opioids. It is used in the management of moderate to severe pain (such as sudden or long-standing pain like pain after an operation or after an injury) in adults and adolescents aged 12 years and older.

CENTRA DT TABLET is not recommended for use in patients with severe liver of kidney insufficiency, seizures (fits) which are not controlled by the management, who have consumed alcohol, withdrawal symptoms due to addiction of drugs or those have accidentally consumed extra dose of sleeping tablets, antipsychotics, antidepressants or other pain killers (which can slow down the breathing and reactions).

Before taking CENTRA DT TABLET, inform your doctor if you have mild to moderate liver or kidney insufficiency, asthma or breathing trouble, recently had a head injury or have a very bad headache that makes you sick, had convulsions (fits) or suffer from epilepsy, have recently felt confused, sleepy or fainted, are going to have any surgery (which requires anaesthesia), have tendency to drug addiction or abuse and if you are addicted to morphine.

CENTRA DT TABLET is not recommended for use in pregnant women and not more than once or alternatively in breastfeeding women. CENTRA DT TABLET is not recommended for use in children (below 12 years of age) and in children with breathing problems. It should be cautiously used among elderly patients (aged 75 years and above).

The most common side effects of taking CENTRA DT TABLET are nausea, vomiting, dizziness, headache, constipation and dry mouth. Consult your doctor if any of the side effects worsens.

mechanismOfAction:
How CENTRA DT TABLET Works

CENTRA DT TABLET inhibits the reuptake of the natural neurotransmitters (norepinephrine and serotonin) and binds weakly to certain receptors (μ-opioid), blocking the transmission of pain signals to the brain. Thus, it reduces moderate to severe pain by acting on specific nerve cells of the spinal cord and the brain.

introduction:
Introduction About TRAMADUS P TABLET

TRAMADUS P TABLET is a combination of Paracetamol and Tramadol which belongs to the group of medicines called Analgesics and Opioid analgesics respectively. TRAMADUS P TABLET is used in the management of moderate to severe pain.

Pain is a complex and unpleasant sensation consisting of a physiological and a psychological response to a noxious stimulus. Pain is a warning mechanism that protects us by influencing it to withdraw from harmful stimuli, which is primarily associated with injury.

Before taking TRAMADUS P TABLET, inform your doctor if you have respiratory disorders, gastrointestinal obstruction, including paralytic ileus, fits or seizures, have recently suffered from a head injury, depression, intolerance to some sugars, kidney or liver problems.

TRAMADUS P TABLET is not recommended for use in pregnant women and during breast-feeding more than once as it may pass through breast milk.  

TRAMADUS P TABLET is not recommended for use in children (under 12 years of age) and should be used with caution in elderly patients (aged 65 years and above).  

The common side effects of taking TRAMADUS P TABLET are nausea, dizziness, drowsiness, vomiting, gastrointestinal problems (such as constipation, flatulence, diarrhoea), stomach pain and dry mouth. Consult your physician if any of the side effects worsen.
uses: Manage moderate to severe pain
usesDetails:
Uses Of TRAMADUS P TABLET
Manage moderate to severe pain
mechanismOfAction:
How TRAMADUS P TABLET Works

TRAMADUS P TABLET contains Tramadol and Paracetamol. Tramadol acts on pain receptors present in the central nervous system. It blocks the nerve signals responsible for pain. Paracetamol acts as an analgesic by inhibiting the release of certain chemical mediators that produce pain. Tramadol and paracetamol, in combination, have a faster action and provide quick relief from pain.

How to use TRAMADUS P TABLET

Take TRAMADUS P TABLET as advised by your physician.

For tablet:

 Swallow the medicine with a glass of water. Do not crush or chew the medicine.

For effervescent tablet:

Take TRAMADUS P TABLET by dissolving in a glass of drinking water.

Your doctor will decide the correct dose and duration for you depending upon your age, body weight and disease condition.

name: Transdol 75mg Tablet 10'S
introduction:
Introduction About TRANSDOL 75MG TABLET

TRANSDOL 75MG TABLET contains Tapentadol which belongs to the group of medicines called Opioids. It is used in adults for the management of severe chronic pain which can only be managed by a strong (opioid) painkiller.

TRANSDOL 75MG TABLET is not recommended for use in patients having severe kidney or liver problems, asthma or if your breathing is dangerously slow or shallow (respiratory depression, hypercapnia), paralysis of the gut (muscles of the gastrointestinal tract).

TRANSDOL 75MG TABLET should be used with caution in patients who have slow or shallow breathing, increased pressure in the brain, disturbed consciousness up to coma, head injury or brain tumour, pancreatic or biliary tract disease (pancreatitis), increased tendency towards epilepsy, have tendency to abuse medicines (habituating), moderate liver problems, kidney disease and intolerance to certain sugars (such as lactose).

TRANSDOL 75MG TABLET is not recommended for use in pregnant women unless recommended by the doctor and it is not recommended for use in breast-feeding women. TRANSDOL 75MG TABLET is not recommended for use in children and adolescents (below 18 years of age) and it should be used with caution in elderly patients (aged 65 years of age).

The most common side effects of taking TRANSDOL 75MG TABLET are nausea, constipation, dizziness, drowsiness, headache, decreased appetite, indigestion and flushing. Consult your doctor if any of the side effects worsen.
uses: Manages severe chronic pain in adults
usesDetails:
Uses Of TRANSDOL 75MG TABLET
Manages severe chronic pain in adults
mechanismOfAction:
How TRANSDOL 75MG TABLET Works

TRANSDOL 75MG TABLET acts directly on the central nervous system and reduces the feeling of pain by interrupting the way in which pain is signalled between brain and the body. TRANSDOL 75MG TABLET binds with certain receptors called µ-opioid receptors and also increases the release of a nerve chemical called norepinephrine which causes inhibition of certain receptors leading to pain relief.

Take TRANSDOL 75MG TABLET as advised by your doctor. Swallow the medicine with a glass of water. Do not crush or chew the medicine. Your doctor will decide the correct dose and duration for you depending upon your age, body weight and disease condition.

Avoid consumption of alcohol while taking TRANSDOL 75MG TABLET as it may increase the effect of drowsiness.

TRANSDOL 75MG TABLET is not recommended for use in patients with severe kidney problems. It should be used with caution in patients suffering from kidney disease. Consult your doctor before taking TRANSDOL 75MG TABLET.

TRANSDOL 75MG TABLET is not recommended for use in patients with severe liver problems. TRANSDOL 75MG TABLET should be used with caution in patients with moderate liver problems and your doctor may adjust the dose. Consult your doctor before taking TRANSDOL 75MG TABLET.
Do not take TRANSDOL 75MG TABLET if you are allergic to Tapentadol or any other ingredients of this medicine.

TRANSDOL 75MG TABLET is not recommended for use in patients having lung diseases such as asthma or dangerously slow and shallow breathing (hypercapnia, respiratory depression). It should be used with caution in patients having other breathing issues (slow or shallow breathing). Consult your doctor before taking TRANSDOL 75MG TABLET.

Others

TRANSDOL 75MG TABLET is not recommended for use if you:

Have paralysis of the gut (muscles of the gastrointestinal tract)
Have acute poisoning of alcohol, sleeping pills, pain relievers or other psychotropic medicines (medicines that affect mood and emotions)

Before taking TRANSDOL 75MG TABLET inform your doctor if you:

Have increased pressure in the brain or disturbed consciousness up to coma
Had a head injury or brain tumour
Have a disease affecting the pancreas (such as pancreatitis) or biliary tract
Have tendency towards fits
Have tendency to abuse medicines (getting habitual of it)
Have lactose intolerance

Use in paediatrics:

TRANSDOL 75MG TABLET is not recommended for use in children and adolescents (below 18 years of age). Consult your child’s doctor for advice.     

 Use in geriatrics:

TRANSDOL 75MG TABLET should be used with caution in elderly patients (aged 65 years and above) due to delayed excretion of this medicine in this age group and your doctor may adjust the dose. Consult your doctor before taking TRANSDOL 75MG TABLET.

introduction:
Introduction About DAN SP TABLET

DAN SP TABLET is a combination of Diclofenac, Paracetamol and Serratiopeptidase which belongs to the group of medicines called Nonsteroidal Anti-inflammatory Drugs (NSAID),  Analgesics and Anti-pyrectics. It is used to relieve symptoms such as fever, pain and inflammation associated with musculoskeletal and joint disorders.

DAN SP TABLET is not recommended for use in patients with asthma (aspirin sensitive asthma), urticaria or acute rhinitis precipitated by aspirin or other NSAIDs, severe liver disease or kidney disease, severe congestive heart failure, ischemic heart disease (heart attack), blockages of blood vessels to the heart and in patients with history or active peptic ulcer, bleeding (blood in stools, vomiting blood) or perforation or active gastrointestinal bleeding.

DAN SP TABLET should be used with caution in patients with pre-existing asthma, seasonal allergic rhinitis, nasal polyps, chronic obstructive pulmonary disease or chronic infections of the respiratory tract, mild to moderate congestive heart failure and high blood pressure.

DAN SP TABLET is not recommended for use in children. It should be used with caution in elderly patients (aged 65 years or above). Consult your doctor before taking DAN SP TABLET.

The most common side effects of taking DAN SP TABLET are nausea, vomiting, stomach pain, diarrhoea, indigestion, flatulence and gastritis. Consult your physician if any of the side effects worsen during or after management with DAN SP TABLET.

usesDetails:
Uses Of DAN SP TABLET
Relieves symptoms such as fever, pain and inflammation associated with musculoskeletal and joint disorders
mechanismOfAction:
How DAN SP TABLET Works

DAN SP TABLET helps to manage pain, where Diclofenac inhibits COX-1 and COX-2 and blocks the production of prostaglandins (which are responsible for pain), while paracetamol works by decreasing fever by acting on the hypothalamus (heat-regulation centre in the brain) produces peripheral vasodilation, resulting in increased blood flow through the skin, sweating and heat loss. It also increases the pain threshold by inhibiting COX-1 and COX-2 enzymes and serratiopeptidase is an anti-inflammatory agent which reduces inflammation and swelling in the affected area. It also breaks abnormal proteins at the site of inflammation and promotes healing. Together, relieves fever and pain effectively.

Take DAN SP TABLET as advised by your physician. Swallow DAN SP TABLET with a glass of water. Do not crush or chew the medicine. Your doctor will decide the correct dose and duration of DAN SP TABLET for you depending upon your age, body weight and disease condition.

Dehydration problems

Diabetes mellitus

introduction:
Introduction About CIPMOL RASPBERRY FLAVOUR SYRUP

CIPMOL RASPBERRY FLAVOUR Syrup is pediatric oral suspension used to control fever in infants and in young children. It contains paracetamol as the key ingredient. Paracetamol is a pain and fever reducing medicine. It works by blocking the release of certain chemicals within the body that cause pain and fever.

Administer CIPMOL RASPBERRY FLAVOUR Syrup to your child as directed by your physician. Shake the medicine well before use. Measure the required amount of medicine in the measuring cup provided with the pack. Your doctor may advise you to administer this medicine every 4 hours to your child to control the fever effectively. Do not administer CIPMOL RASPBERRY FLAVOUR Syrup more frequently than every 4 hours.

Make sure to rinse the measuring cup in warm water before and after use. Before administering CIPMOL RASPBERRY FLAVOUR Syrup to your child, inform your doctor if your child has any liver or kidney problems. Avoid using this medicine on a long-term basis without consulting your doctor.

introduction:
Introduction About TRAMADUS 50 CAPSULE

TRAMADUS 50 CAPSULE contains Tramadol which belongs to the group of medicines called Opioids. It is used in the management of moderate to severe pain (such as sudden or long-standing pain like pain after an operation or after an injury) in adults and adolescents aged 12 years and older.

TRAMADUS 50 CAPSULE is not recommended for use in patients with severe liver of kidney insufficiency, seizures (fits) which are not controlled by the management, who have consumed alcohol, withdrawal symptoms due to addiction of drugs or those have accidentally consumed extra dose of sleeping tablets, antipsychotics, antidepressants or other pain killers (which can slow down the breathing and reactions).

Before taking TRAMADUS 50 CAPSULE, inform your doctor if you have mild to moderate liver or kidney insufficiency, asthma or breathing trouble, recently had a head injury or have a very bad headache that makes you sick, had convulsions (fits) or suffer from epilepsy, have recently felt confused, sleepy or fainted, are going to have any surgery (which requires anaesthesia), have tendency to drug addiction or abuse and if you are addicted to morphine.

TRAMADUS 50 CAPSULE is not recommended for use in pregnant women and not more than once or alternatively in breastfeeding women. TRAMADUS 50 CAPSULE is not recommended for use in children (below 12 years of age) and in children with breathing problems. It should be cautiously used among elderly patients (aged 75 years and above).

The most common side effects of taking TRAMADUS 50 CAPSULE are nausea, vomiting, dizziness, headache, constipation and dry mouth. Consult your doctor if any of the side effects worsens.

Uses Of TRAMADUS 50 CAPSULE
Manage moderate to severe pain (such as sudden or long-standing pain)
mechanismOfAction:
How TRAMADUS 50 CAPSULE Works

TRAMADUS 50 CAPSULE inhibits the reuptake of the natural neurotransmitters (norepinephrine and serotonin) and binds weakly to certain receptors (μ-opioid), blocking the transmission of pain signals to the brain. Thus, it reduces moderate to severe pain by acting on specific nerve cells of the spinal cord and the brain.

Take TRAMADUS 50 CAPSULE as advised by your physician. Swallow the medicine with a glass of water. You can take this medicine with or without food. Do not crush or chew the medicine. Your doctor will decide the correct dose and duration for you depending upon your age, body weight and disease condition.

introduction:
Introduction About TAPENTA 100MG TABLET

TAPENTA 100MG TABLET contains Tapentadol which belongs to the group of medicines called Opioids. It is used in adults for the management of severe chronic pain which can only be managed by a strong (opioid) painkiller.

TAPENTA 100MG TABLET is not recommended for use in patients having severe kidney or liver problems, asthma or if your breathing is dangerously slow or shallow (respiratory depression, hypercapnia), paralysis of the gut (muscles of the gastrointestinal tract).

TAPENTA 100MG TABLET should be used with caution in patients who have slow or shallow breathing, increased pressure in the brain, disturbed consciousness up to coma, head injury or brain tumour, pancreatic or biliary tract disease (pancreatitis), increased tendency towards epilepsy, have tendency to abuse medicines (habituating), moderate liver problems, kidney disease and intolerance to certain sugars (such as lactose).

TAPENTA 100MG TABLET is not recommended for use in pregnant women unless recommended by the doctor and it is not recommended for use in breast-feeding women. TAPENTA 100MG TABLET is not recommended for use in children and adolescents (below 18 years of age) and it should be used with caution in elderly patients (aged 65 years of age).

The most common side effects of taking TAPENTA 100MG TABLET are nausea, constipation, dizziness, drowsiness, headache, decreased appetite, indigestion and flushing. Consult your doctor if any of the side effects worsen.
uses: Manages severe chronic pain in adults
usesDetails:
Uses Of TAPENTA 100MG TABLET
Manages severe chronic pain in adults
mechanismOfAction:
How TAPENTA 100MG TABLET Works

TAPENTA 100MG TABLET acts directly on the central nervous system and reduces the feeling of pain by interrupting the way in which pain is signalled between brain and the body. TAPENTA 100MG TABLET binds with certain receptors called µ-opioid receptors and also increases the release of a nerve chemical called norepinephrine which causes inhibition of certain receptors leading to pain relief.
usageDetails:
How to use TAPENTA 100MG TABLET

Take TAPENTA 100MG TABLET as advised by your doctor. Swallow the medicine with a glass of water. Do not crush or chew the medicine. Your doctor will decide the correct dose and duration for you depending upon your age, body weight and disease condition.

introduction:
Introduction About PYRODIP ER

PYRODIP ER contains Paracetamol which belongs to the group of medicines called Analgesics and Antipyretics. It is used to relieve mild to moderate pain (including headaches, backache, toothache, severe nerve pain, sore throat, period pain, low back and leg pain, muscle, connective tissue and joint pain, symptomatic relief of sprains, strain, joint swelling and stiffness). It is also used to lower fever (high body temperature) and relieve cold or flu symptoms.

Before taking PYRODIP ER, inform your doctor if you or your child have liver or kidney problems or any allergies. It should be used with caution in patients with liver problems due to alcohol to manage the risk of liver damage.

PYRODIP ER should be used with caution in pregnant women only if clearly advised by the doctor and can be used in breastfeeding women. PYRODIP ER is not recommended for use in children less than 10 years of age and should be used with caution in elderly patients.

Consult your doctor if you experience any side effects or unusual effects during management with PYRODIP ER.

Uses Of PYRODIP ER
Relieves mild to moderate pain (such as headache, toothache, joint pain)
Lowers fever and relieves the symptoms of cold or flu
mechanismOfAction:
How PYRODIP ER Works

PYRODIP ER relieves pain by increasing the pain threshold by inhibiting certain enzymes (COX-1 and COX-2) involved in the synthesis of chemicals responsible for inducing pain (prostaglandins). It reduces fever by directly acting on heat-regulating centers in the brain, resulting in vessel relaxation, sweating and loss of body heat.
usageDetails:
How to use PYRODIP ER

Take PYRODIP ER as advised by your physician. It can be taken with or without food.

For Tablet, Capsule: Swallow PYRODIP ER with a glass of water. Do not crush or chew the medicine.

For Dispersible Tablet: Disperse the medicine in the specified quantity of water as mentioned on the label. Consume the medicine immediately after reconstitution.

Your doctor will decide the correct dose and duration of therapy for you depending upon your age, body weight and severity of the condition.

introduction:
Introduction About NEUROGESIC TABLET

NEUROGESIC TABLET is a combination of Diclofenac and Paracetamol which belongs to the group of medicines called Non-steroidal Anti-inflammatory drugs (NSAIDs). It is used to manage various conditions associated with pain and inflammation such as rheumatoid arthritis (chronic inflammatory condition of joints), ankylosing spondylitis (chronic inflammatory disease of the spine) and osteoarthritis (degenerative joint disorder which is categorized by swelling, stiffness, and painful joints). NEUROGESIC TABLET can also be used in the management of ear and throat pain, muscle pain, back pain, tooth ache, mensural pain, post-operative or post -traumatic pain and also athletic injuries.

Your doctor may perform complete blood test especially in patients undergoing long term management with this medicine to know your existing condition. Along with the management your doctor may also monitor for signs and symptoms for gastrointestinal bleeding. Before taking NEUROGESIC TABLET, inform your doctor if you have blood clotting disorders, diabetes (high blood sugar), habit of smoking, or raised levels of cholesterol. Avoid consumption of alcohol while taking NEUROGESIC TABLET because it might aggravate your existing symptoms.

NEUROGESIC TABLET is not recommended for use in patients having kidney, liver or heart diseases, stomach or intestinal ulcers, gastrointestinal bleeding, or inflammatory intestinal disorders such as Crohn’s disease or ulcerative colitis. Consult your doctor before taking it. NEUROGESIC TABLET is not recommended for use in pregnant women especially in third trimester and in breastfeeding women. Consult your doctor before taking it. NEUROGESIC TABLET is not recommended for use in children below 10 years of age and should be used with caution in elderly patients (aged above 65 years). Consult your doctor before taking. The most common side-effects of NEUROGESIC TABLET are nausea, stomach pain, diarrhoea and indigestion. Consult your doctor if any of these side effects worsens or doesn’t improve.

NEUROGESIC TABLET is not recommended for use in children below 10 years of age. Consult with your child’s doctor before giving it to your child.

Are dehydrated

Have a history of dyspepsia (indigestion)

faqs.question: Q: How does NEUROGESIC TABLET works on my body?
faqs.answer: A: NEUROGESIC TABLET acts as an anti-inflammatory agent as well as a painkiller. It works by inhibiting the production of a chemical called prostaglandins in the body. Which are responsible for causing pain and swelling in the body. As a result, it reduces various pain and swelling in joints.

faqs.question: Q: Is NEUROGESIC TABLET advised to be taken in pregnancy?
faqs.answer: A: No. NEUROGESIC TABLET is not recommended for use in pregnant women especially in the third trimester of pregnancy because it may cross the placenta and cause malformations in the fetus. Women of childbearing potential should use a suitable non-hormonal contraceptive method to avoid getting pregnant while taking NEUROGESIC TABLET. Consult your doctor before taking NEUROGESIC TABLET.

faqs.question: Q: Does NEUROGESIC TABLET affects my ability to drive?
faqs.answer: A: Do not drive or operate any machines if you feel headache, blurred vision, dizziness or drowsiness after taking NEUROGESIC TABLET. You can continue doing your activities as soon as you feel normal again.

faqs.question: Q: Can NEUROGESIC TABLET cause diarrhoea?
faqs.answer: A: Diarrhoea is the most common problem while taking NEUROGESIC TABLET and is occasionally severe. You have less chance of getting diarrhoea if you take NEUROGESIC TABLET with food. If you take an antacid (used to reduce acid in the stomach) you should avoid antacids with magnesium in them as these may make diarrhoea worse. Discuss with your doctor.

faqs.question: Q: Do I need to undergo any tests while taking NEUROGESIC TABLET?
faqs.answer: A: NEUROGESIC TABLET may lead to an increase in blood pressure and so, your doctor may advise you to monitor your blood pressure on a regular basis. If you have heart, liver or kidney problems, your doctor will advise regular monitoring of the same.

faqs.question: Q: Can NEUROGESIC TABLET be used in elderly patients?
faqs.answer: A: NEUROGESIC TABLET should be used with caution in elderly patients (aged above 65 years) because of the increased risk of side effects such as gastrointestinal (GI) adverse events, including inflammation, bleeding, ulceration and perforation of the stomach or intestines. Consult your doctor before taking NEUROGESIC TABLET.

introduction:
Introduction About TRADOL PLUS TABLET

TRADOL PLUS TABLET is a combination of Paracetamol and Tramadol which belongs to the group of medicines called Analgesics and Opioid analgesics respectively. TRADOL PLUS TABLET is used in the management of moderate to severe pain.

Pain is a complex and unpleasant sensation consisting of a physiological and a psychological response to a noxious stimulus. Pain is a warning mechanism that protects us by influencing it to withdraw from harmful stimuli, which is primarily associated with injury.

Before taking TRADOL PLUS TABLET, inform your doctor if you have respiratory disorders, gastrointestinal obstruction, including paralytic ileus, fits or seizures, have recently suffered from a head injury, depression, intolerance to some sugars, kidney or liver problems.

TRADOL PLUS TABLET is not recommended for use in pregnant women and during breast-feeding more than once as it may pass through breast milk.  

TRADOL PLUS TABLET is not recommended for use in children (under 12 years of age) and should be used with caution in elderly patients (aged 65 years and above).  

The common side effects of taking TRADOL PLUS TABLET are nausea, dizziness, drowsiness, vomiting, gastrointestinal problems (such as constipation, flatulence, diarrhoea), stomach pain and dry mouth. Consult your physician if any of the side effects worsen.
uses: Manage moderate to severe pain
usesDetails:
Uses Of TRADOL PLUS TABLET
Manage moderate to severe pain
mechanismOfAction:
How TRADOL PLUS TABLET Works

TRADOL PLUS TABLET contains Tramadol and Paracetamol. Tramadol acts on pain receptors present in the central nervous system. It blocks the nerve signals responsible for pain. Paracetamol acts as an analgesic by inhibiting the release of certain chemical mediators that produce pain. Tramadol and paracetamol, in combination, have a faster action and provide quick relief from pain.
usageDetails:
How to use TRADOL PLUS TABLET

Take TRADOL PLUS TABLET as advised by your physician.

For tablet:

 Swallow the medicine with a glass of water. Do not crush or chew the medicine.

For effervescent tablet:

Take TRADOL PLUS TABLET by dissolving in a glass of drinking water.

Your doctor will decide the correct dose and duration for you depending upon your age, body weight and disease condition.

Tramadol and paracetamol, in combination, have a faster action and provide quick relief from pain.
usageDetails:
How to use WINDOL T TABLET

Take WINDOL T TABLET as advised by your physician.

For tablet:

 Swallow the medicine with a glass of water. Do not crush or chew the medicine.

For effervescent tablet:

Take WINDOL T TABLET by dissolving in a glass of drinking water.

Your doctor will decide the correct dose and duration for you depending upon your age, body weight and disease condition.

Have epilepsy (which is not adequately controlled by your current medicine)
Known or suspected gastrointestinal obstruction including paralytic ileus

Have epilepsy or already experienced fits or seizures
Have recently suffered from a head injury, shock or severe headaches associated with vomiting
Have intolerance to certain sugars
Have depression

WINDOL T TABLET is not recommended for use in children (under 12 years of age). Consult your child’s doctor for advice.

WINDOL T TABLET should be used with caution in elderly patients (aged 65 years and above). Consult your doctor before taking it.

Medicine used to reduce cholesterol in the blood (Ex. cholestyramine)
Medicine used in the management of depression or Parkinson’s disease (Ex. monoamine oxidase inhibitors such as phenelzine, isocarboxazid)  
Amitriptyline (used to manage depression)
Medicine used to help stop smoking (Ex. bupropion)
Baclofen (used as muscle relaxant)
Warfarin, phenprocoumon (used to manage or manage blood clots)

Introduction About TRICARE P TABLET

TRICARE P TABLET is a combination of Paracetamol and Tramadol which belongs to the group of medicines called Analgesics and Opioid analgesics respectively. TRICARE P TABLET is used in the management of moderate to severe pain.

Pain is a complex and unpleasant sensation consisting of a physiological and a psychological response to a noxious stimulus. Pain is a warning mechanism that protects us by influencing it to withdraw from harmful stimuli, which is primarily associated with injury.

Before taking TRICARE P TABLET, inform your doctor if you have respiratory disorders, gastrointestinal obstruction, including paralytic ileus, fits or seizures, have recently suffered from a head injury, depression, intolerance to some sugars, kidney or liver problems.

TRICARE P TABLET is not recommended for use in pregnant women and during breast-feeding more than once as it may pass through breast milk.  

TRICARE P TABLET is not recommended for use in children (under 12 years of age) and should be used with caution in elderly patients (aged 65 years and above).  

The common side effects of taking TRICARE P TABLET are nausea, dizziness, drowsiness, vomiting, gastrointestinal problems (such as constipation, flatulence, diarrhoea), stomach pain and dry mouth. Consult your physician if any of the side effects worsen.
uses: Manage moderate to severe pain

Uses Of TRICARE P TABLET
Manage moderate to severe pain
mechanismOfAction:
How TRICARE P TABLET Works

TRICARE P TABLET contains Tramadol and Paracetamol. Tramadol acts on pain receptors present in the central nervous system. It blocks the nerve signals responsible for pain. Paracetamol acts as an analgesic by inhibiting the release of certain chemical mediators that produce pain. Tramadol and paracetamol, in combination, have a faster action and provide quick relief from pain.

Take TRICARE P TABLET by dissolving in a glass of drinking water.

Your doctor will decide the correct dose and duration for you depending upon your age, body weight and disease condition.

introduction:
Introduction About PARAFAST RASPBERRY FLAVOUR SYRUP

PARAFAST RASPBERRY FLAVOUR Syrup is pediatric oral suspension used to control fever in infants and in toodlers. It contains paracetamol as the key ingredient. Paracetamol is a pain and fever reducing medicine. It works by blocking the release of certain chemicals within the body that causes pain and fever.

Administer PARAFAST RASPBERRY FLAVOUR Syrup to your child as directed by your physician. Shake the medicine well before use. Measure the required amount of the medicine in the measuring cup provided with the pack. Your doctor may advice you to administer this drops every 4-6 hours to your child for controlling fever more effectively. Do not administer this medicine more frequently than every 4 hours.

Make sure to rinse the measuring cup in warm water before and after use. Before administering PARAFAST RASPBERRY FLAVOUR Syrup to your child, inform your doctor if your child has any liver or kidney problems. Avoid using this medicine on a long-term basis without consulting your doctor.

introduction:
Introduction About TRICARE SR TABLET

TRICARE SR TABLET contains Tramadol which belongs to the group of medicines called Opioids. It is used in the management of moderate to severe pain (such as sudden or long-standing pain like pain after an operation or after an injury) in adults and adolescents aged 12 years and older.

TRICARE SR TABLET is not recommended for use in patients with severe liver of kidney insufficiency, seizures (fits) which are not controlled by the management, who have consumed alcohol, withdrawal symptoms due to addiction of drugs or those have accidentally consumed extra dose of sleeping tablets, antipsychotics, antidepressants or other pain killers (which can slow down the breathing and reactions).

Before taking TRICARE SR TABLET, inform your doctor if you have mild to moderate liver or kidney insufficiency, asthma or breathing trouble, recently had a head injury or have a very bad headache that makes you sick, had convulsions (fits) or suffer from epilepsy, have recently felt confused, sleepy or fainted, are going to have any surgery (which requires anaesthesia), have tendency to drug addiction or abuse and if you are addicted to morphine.

TRICARE SR TABLET is not recommended for use in pregnant women and not more than once or alternatively in breastfeeding women. TRICARE SR TABLET is not recommended for use in children (below 12 years of age) and in children with breathing problems. It should be cautiously used among elderly patients (aged 75 years and above).

The most common side effects of taking TRICARE SR TABLET are nausea, vomiting, dizziness, headache, constipation and dry mouth. Consult your doctor if any of the side effects worsens.

How TRICARE SR TABLET Works

TRICARE SR TABLET inhibits the reuptake of the natural neurotransmitters (norepinephrine and serotonin) and binds weakly to certain receptors (μ-opioid), blocking the transmission of pain signals to the brain. Thus, it reduces moderate to severe pain by acting on specific nerve cells of the spinal cord and the brain.

introduction:
Introduction About TAPENTA 75MG TABLET

TAPENTA 75MG TABLET contains Tapentadol which belongs to the group of medicines called Opioids. It is used in adults for the management of severe chronic pain which can only be managed by a strong (opioid) painkiller.

TAPENTA 75MG TABLET is not recommended for use in patients having severe kidney or liver problems, asthma or if your breathing is dangerously slow or shallow (respiratory depression, hypercapnia), paralysis of the gut (muscles of the gastrointestinal tract).

TAPENTA 75MG TABLET should be used with caution in patients who have slow or shallow breathing, increased pressure in the brain, disturbed consciousness up to coma, head injury or brain tumour, pancreatic or biliary tract disease (pancreatitis), increased tendency towards epilepsy, have tendency to abuse medicines (habituating), moderate liver problems, kidney disease and intolerance to certain sugars (such as lactose).

TAPENTA 75MG TABLET is not recommended for use in pregnant women unless recommended by the doctor and it is not recommended for use in breast-feeding women. TAPENTA 75MG TABLET is not recommended for use in children and adolescents (below 18 years of age) and it should be used with caution in elderly patients (aged 65 years of age).

The most common side effects of taking TAPENTA 75MG TABLET are nausea, constipation, dizziness, drowsiness, headache, decreased appetite, indigestion and flushing. Consult your doctor if any of the side effects worsen.
uses: Manages severe chronic pain in adults
usesDetails:
Uses Of TAPENTA 75MG TABLET
Manages severe chronic pain in adults
mechanismOfAction:
How TAPENTA 75MG TABLET Works

TAPENTA 75MG TABLET acts directly on the central nervous system and reduces the feeling of pain by interrupting the way in which pain is signalled between brain and the body. TAPENTA 75MG TABLET binds with certain receptors called µ-opioid receptors and also increases the release of a nerve chemical called norepinephrine which causes inhibition of certain receptors leading to pain relief.

How to use TAPENTA 75MG TABLET

Take TAPENTA 75MG TABLET as advised by your doctor. Swallow the medicine with a glass of water. Do not crush or chew the medicine. Your doctor will decide the correct dose and duration for you depending upon your age, body weight and disease condition.

Do not take TAPENTA 75MG TABLET if you are allergic to Tapentadol or any other ingredients of this medicine.

TAPENTA 75MG TABLET is not recommended for use in patients having lung diseases such as asthma or dangerously slow and shallow breathing (hypercapnia, respiratory depression). It should be used with caution in patients having other breathing issues (slow or shallow breathing). Consult your doctor before taking TAPENTA 75MG TABLET.

Others

TAPENTA 75MG TABLET is not recommended for use if you:

Have paralysis of the gut (muscles of the gastrointestinal tract)
Have acute poisoning of alcohol, sleeping pills, pain relievers or other psychotropic medicines (medicines that affect mood and emotions)

Before taking TAPENTA 75MG TABLET inform your doctor if you:

Have increased pressure in the brain or disturbed consciousness up to coma
Had a head injury or brain tumour
Have a disease affecting the pancreas (such as pancreatitis) or biliary tract
Have tendency towards fits
Have tendency to abuse medicines (getting habitual of it)
Have lactose intolerance

TAPENTA 75MG TABLET is not recommended for use in children and adolescents (below 18 years of age). Consult your child’s doctor for advice.

TAPENTA 75MG TABLET should be used with caution in elderly patients (aged 65 years and above) due to delayed excretion of this medicine in this age group and your doctor may adjust the dose. Consult your doctor before taking TAPENTA 75MG TABLET.

Interactions

A. Drug–Drug Interactions:

Before taking TAPENTA 75MG TABLET inform your doctor if you are taking any of the following medicines:

Sedatives such as zolpidem, barbiturates (Ex. amobarbital, pentobarbital) antidepressants such as paroxetine, sertraline and anti-psychotics such as loxapine, clozapine, monoamine oxidase inhibitors (MAOIs) such as isocarboxazid (used to manage depression, anxiety, mood disorders, sleep disturbances) 
Opioids such as codeine, oxymorphone, mixed mu-opioid agonist/antagonists such as pentazocine, nalbuphine, partial mu-opioid agonists such as buprenorphine (used to manage severe pain)
Antihistamines such as cetirizine, loratadine (used to manage allergy)
Rifampicin (used to manage tuberculosis)
St. john’s wort (herbal medicine used to manage depression)

Overdosage:

If you or anyone else accidentally takes too much of TAPENTA 75MG TABLET, consult your doctor immediately or visit the nearby hospital. Overdosage symptoms of TAPENTA 75MG TABLET are pin-point pupils, vomiting, fast heartbeat, drop in blood pressure, collapse, disturbed consciousness or coma (deep unconsciousness), epileptic fits (convulsions), dangerously slow or shallow breathing or stopping breathing may occur.

name: TRAMACET Tablet 10's
introduction:
Introduction About TRAMACET TABLET

TRAMACET TABLET is a combination of Paracetamol and Tramadol which belongs to the group of medicines called Analgesics and Opioid analgesics respectively. TRAMACET TABLET is used in the management of moderate to severe pain.

Pain is a complex and unpleasant sensation consisting of a physiological and a psychological response to a noxious stimulus. Pain is a warning mechanism that protects us by influencing it to withdraw from harmful stimuli, which is primarily associated with injury.

Before taking TRAMACET TABLET, inform your doctor if you have respiratory disorders, gastrointestinal obstruction, including paralytic ileus, fits or seizures, have recently suffered from a head injury, depression, intolerance to some sugars, kidney or liver problems.

TRAMACET TABLET is not recommended for use in pregnant women and during breast-feeding more than once as it may pass through breast milk.  

TRAMACET TABLET is not recommended for use in children (under 12 years of age) and should be used with caution in elderly patients (aged 65 years and above).  

The common side effects of taking TRAMACET TABLET are nausea, dizziness, drowsiness, vomiting, gastrointestinal problems (such as constipation, flatulence, diarrhoea), stomach pain and dry mouth. Consult your physician if any of the side effects worsen.
uses: Manage moderate to severe pain
usesDetails:
Uses Of TRAMACET TABLET
Manage moderate to severe pain
mechanismOfAction:
How TRAMACET TABLET Works

TRAMACET TABLET contains Tramadol and Paracetamol. Tramadol acts on pain receptors present in the central nervous system. It blocks the nerve signals responsible for pain. Paracetamol acts as an analgesic by inhibiting the release of certain chemical mediators that produce pain. Tramadol and paracetamol, in combination, have a faster action and provide quick relief from pain.
usageDetails:
How to use TRAMACET TABLET

Take TRAMACET TABLET as advised by your physician.

For tablet:

 Swallow the medicine with a glass of water. Do not crush or chew the medicine.

For effervescent tablet:

Take TRAMACET TABLET by dissolving in a glass of drinking water.

Your doctor will decide the correct dose and duration for you depending upon your age, body weight and disease condition.

Introduction About EXPIRTIN 100MG CAPSULE

EXPIRTIN 100MG CAPSULE contains Flupirtine which belongs to a group of medicines called Nonopioid, Non-NSAID analgesics. It is used in the management of acute and chronic pain (such as primary headache, tumor pain, menstrual cramps, pain after traumatologic/orthopaedic operations and injuries and painful increased muscle tone of the posture and motor muscles).  

EXPIRTIN 100MG CAPSULE is not recommended for use in patients with liver problems. Before taking EXPIRTIN 100MG CAPSULE, inform your doctor if you have kidney disease, myasthenia gravis, had or have a history of tinnitus (ringing in the ears) or if you are allergic to Flupirtine. EXPIRTIN 100MG CAPSULE is not recommended for use in pregnant and breast-feeding women unless clearly advised by the doctor.

EXPIRTIN 100MG CAPSULE is not recommended for use in children and adolescents (below 18 years of age) unless deemed necessary and it should be used with caution in elderly patients, especially in patients with kidney problems. The most common side effects of taking EXPIRTIN 100MG CAPSULE are fatigue, dizziness, heartburn, nausea, vomiting, dry mouth, constipation and diarrhea. Consult your doctor if any of the side effects worsen.

name: PARAFAST PINEAPPLE FLAVOUR Drops 15ml
introduction:
Introduction About PARAFAST PINEAPPLE FLAVOUR DROPS

PARAFAST PINEAPPLE FLAVOUR Drops is pediatric oral suspension used to control fever in infants and in toodlers. It contains paracetamol as the key ingredient. Paracetamol is a pain and fever reducing medicine. It works by blocking the release of certain chemicals within the body that causes pain and fever.

Administer PARAFAST PINEAPPLE FLAVOUR Drops to your child as directed by your physician. Shake the medicine well before use. Measure the required amount of the medicine in the measuring dropper provided with the pack. Your doctor may advice you to administer this drops every 4-6 hours to your child for controlling fever more effectively. Do not administer this medicine more frequently than every 4 hours.

Make sure to rinse the measuring dropper in warm water before and after use. Before administering PARAFAST PINEAPPLE FLAVOUR Drops to your child, inform your doctor if your child has any liver or kidney problems. Avoid using this medicine on a long-term basis without consulting your doctor.

name: Tendonex Gel(Topical) 30gm
introduction:
Introduction About TENDONEX GEL(TOPICAL)

Tendonex Gel(Topical) is a topical pain-relieving medicine used to provide relief from lower back pain, sprains and strains, muscular pain, sports injuries and joint pain. It contains Diclofenac, Methyl salicylate, and Flax seed oil as active ingredients. Diclofenac is an analgesic medication. It works by blocking the actions of certain chemicals within the affected region that causes pain and inflammation.

Methyl Salicylate is a skin irritant and rubefacient. It reduces pain sensation by causing a mild skin irritation and redness. It also improves blood circulation in the applied regions that may help in fast recovery. Flax seed oil contains anti-inflammatory properties which helps in reducing pain and inflammation caused due to musculoskeletal injuries.

Apply Tendonex Gel(Topical) on the affected areas as advised by your doctor. It is for external use only. Wash your hands before and after using Tendonex Gel(Topical). Avoid contact of Tendonex Gel(Topical) with your eyes, ears, nose or mouth. In case of accidental contact, rinse it off with plenty of water. Do not apply this medicine on cuts, open wounds or damaged skin.
