name: Akilos SP Tablet 10'S
introduction:
Introduction About AKILOS SP TABLET

AKILOS SP TABLET is used to relieve inflammation and pain due to bone and soft tissue injuries in affected individuals. It is also used to reduce high temperatures and provide relief from cold (while sneezing) in affected individuals. This medicine is also indicated for use to resolve post-operative inflammation, oedema, and pain. It is also used to provide relief from illnesses such as headaches, moderate migraines, and musculoskeletal pain.

AKILOS SP TABLET is a combination of Aceclofenac, Paracetamol, and Serratiopeptidase, which belong to the group of medicines called Nonsteroidal anti-inflammatory agents, Analgesics and Antipyretics, and Proteolytic enzymes, respectively. It helps to reduce pain and inflammation by blocking certain chemical messengers in the brain, and it also promotes healing by breaking down abnormal proteins at the site of inflammation, thereby healing the infected site.

AKILOS SP TABLET is not recommended for use in patients allergic to Aceclofenac, Paracetamol, or Serratiopeptidase. It is also not recommended for use in patients with active or recurrent peptic ulcers or haemorrhages (bleeding), severe heart, liver, or kidney diseases. Before taking AKILOS SP TABLET, inform your doctor if you suffer from uncontrolled high blood pressure, diabetes, hyperlipidaemia (high-fat level in the blood), gastrointestinal diseases such as ulcerative colitis (inflammatory bowel disease), and/or aseptic meningitis (inflammation of the brain).

AKILOS SP TABLET is not recommended for use by pregnant and breastfeeding women. It is also not recommended for use in children and adolescents (below 18 years old). Consult your doctor before taking the medicine. The most common side effects of taking AKILOS SP TABLET are abdominal pain, nausea, vomiting, diarrhea, flatulence, constipation, indigestion, and/or dizziness. Consult and inform your doctor if any of these side effects get worse.

introduction:
Introduction About BIOTRAM PLUS TABLET

BIOTRAM PLUS TABLET is a combination of Paracetamol and Tramadol which belongs to the group of medicines called Analgesics and Opioid analgesics respectively. BIOTRAM PLUS TABLET is used in the management of moderate to severe pain.

Pain is a complex and unpleasant sensation consisting of a physiological and a psychological response to a noxious stimulus. Pain is a warning mechanism that protects us by influencing it to withdraw from harmful stimuli, which is primarily associated with injury.

Before taking BIOTRAM PLUS TABLET, inform your doctor if you have respiratory disorders, gastrointestinal obstruction, including paralytic ileus, fits or seizures, have recently suffered from a head injury, depression, intolerance to some sugars, kidney or liver problems.

BIOTRAM PLUS TABLET is not recommended for use in pregnant women and during breast-feeding more than once as it may pass through breast milk.  

BIOTRAM PLUS TABLET is not recommended for use in children (under 12 years of age) and should be used with caution in elderly patients (aged 65 years and above).  

The common side effects of taking BIOTRAM PLUS TABLET are nausea, dizziness, drowsiness, vomiting, gastrointestinal problems (such as constipation, flatulence, diarrhoea), stomach pain and dry mouth. Consult your physician if any of the side effects worsen.

How BIOTRAM PLUS TABLET Works

BIOTRAM PLUS TABLET contains Tramadol and Paracetamol. Tramadol acts on pain receptors present in the central nervous system. It blocks the nerve signals responsible for pain. Paracetamol acts as an analgesic by inhibiting the release of certain chemical mediators that produce pain. Tramadol and paracetamol, in combination, have a faster action and provide quick relief from pain.

For tablet:

Take BIOTRAM PLUS TABLET by dissolving in a glass of drinking water.

Your doctor will decide the correct dose and duration for you depending upon your age, body weight and disease condition.

introduction:
Introduction About TRAMAFORD TABLET

TRAMAFORD TABLET is a combination of Paracetamol and Tramadol which belongs to the group of medicines called Analgesics and Opioid analgesics respectively. TRAMAFORD TABLET is used in the management of moderate to severe pain.

Pain is a complex and unpleasant sensation consisting of a physiological and a psychological response to a noxious stimulus. Pain is a warning mechanism that protects us by influencing it to withdraw from harmful stimuli, which is primarily associated with injury.

Before taking TRAMAFORD TABLET, inform your doctor if you have respiratory disorders, gastrointestinal obstruction, including paralytic ileus, fits or seizures, have recently suffered from a head injury, depression, intolerance to some sugars, kidney or liver problems.

TRAMAFORD TABLET is not recommended for use in pregnant women and during breast-feeding more than once as it may pass through breast milk.  

TRAMAFORD TABLET is not recommended for use in children (under 12 years of age) and should be used with caution in elderly patients (aged 65 years and above).  

The common side effects of taking TRAMAFORD TABLET are nausea, dizziness, drowsiness, vomiting, gastrointestinal problems (such as constipation, flatulence, diarrhoea), stomach pain and dry mouth. Consult your physician if any of the side effects worsen.
uses: Manage moderate to severe pain
usesDetails:
Uses Of TRAMAFORD TABLET
Manage moderate to severe pain
mechanismOfAction:
How TRAMAFORD TABLET Works

TRAMAFORD TABLET contains Tramadol and Paracetamol. Tramadol acts on pain receptors present in the central nervous system. It blocks the nerve signals responsible for pain. Paracetamol acts as an analgesic by inhibiting the release of certain chemical mediators that produce pain. Tramadol and paracetamol, in combination, have a faster action and provide quick relief from pain.
usageDetails:
How to use TRAMAFORD TABLET

Take TRAMAFORD TABLET as advised by your physician.

For tablet:

 Swallow the medicine with a glass of water. Do not crush or chew the medicine.

For effervescent tablet:

Take TRAMAFORD TABLET by dissolving in a glass of drinking water.

Your doctor will decide the correct dose and duration for you depending upon your age, body weight and disease condition.

introduction:
Introduction About PARAFAST INFUSION

PARAFAST INFUSION contains Paracetamol which belongs to the group of medicines called Analgesics and Antipyretics. It is used for short-term management of moderate pain (especially after surgery) and fever when administered by the intravenous route is clinically justified.

Before receiving PARAFAST INFUSION, inform your doctor if you have heart, lung, liver or kidney problems or if you suffer from alcoholism or alcohol abuse, malnourishment and severely low blood volume due to dehydration or blood loss.

PARAFAST INFUSION should be used with caution in pregnant and breastfeeding women only if clearly advised by the doctor. PARAFAST INFUSION should be used with caution in children and elderly patients.

The most common side effects of receiving PARAFAST INFUSION are nausea, vomiting, headache, sleep problems and itching. Inform your doctor if any of these side effect worsens.
uses: For short-term management of moderate pain (especially after surgery) and fever
usesDetails:
Uses Of PARAFAST INFUSION
For short-term management of moderate pain (especially after surgery) and fever
mechanismOfAction:
How PARAFAST INFUSION Works

PARAFAST INFUSION relieves pain by increasing the pain threshold by inhibiting certain enzymes (COX-1 and COX-2) involved in the synthesis of chemicals responsible for inducing pain (prostaglandins). It reduces fever by directly acting on heat-regulating centers in the brain, resulting in vessel relaxation, sweating and loss of body heat.
usageDetails:
How to use PARAFAST INFUSION

PARAFAST INFUSION will be given to you only by a doctor or a nurse into the vein as an intravenous infusion. Your doctor will decide the correct dose and duration for you based on your age, body weight and disease condition.

introduction:
Introduction About BUTODOL 1MG INJECTION

BUTODOL 1MG INJECTION contains Butorphanol, which belongs to the group of medicines called Opioid agonist/antagonist analgesics. It is used to manage and relieve moderate to severe pain. It is also used as a preoperative/pre-anaesthetic medication, a supplement to balanced anaesthesia, to provide relief from pain during labor and in the management of severe pain for which alternative management is inadequate.

BUTODOL 1MG INJECTION is not recommended for use in patients with lung problems (such as respiratory depression, acute/severe bronchial asthma) and gastrointestinal obstruction (such as paralytic ileus). Before taking BUTODOL 1MG INJECTION, inform your doctor if you have a dependency on narcotics, suffer from cachexia (a condition marked by extreme weight loss and muscle wasting), seizure disorders or hepatic and/or kidney impairment.

BUTODOL 1MG INJECTION should be used with caution in pregnant and breastfeeding women only if necessary. It is not recommended for use in children and adolescents (aged below 18 years). It should be used with caution in elderly patients (aged above 65 years).

The most common side effects associated with the use of BUTODOL 1MG INJECTION are excessive sleepiness, dizziness, nausea, vomiting, nasal congestion, sleeplessness and/or lethargy. Consult your doctor if any of your symptoms get worse.

Consult your doctor for advice before receiving the medicine.

Do not drive or operate machines after receiving BUTODOL 1MG INJECTION as it can impair the mental and/or physical abilities to drive or operate machinery. Consult your doctor before receiving the medicine.
Avoid consumption of alcohol while receiving BUTODOL 1MG INJECTION as it may cause substance abuse, profound sedation, respiratory depression and/or coma.
BUTODOL 1MG INJECTION should be used with caution in patients with renal impairment. Consult your doctor before receiving the medicine.
BUTODOL 1MG INJECTION should be used with caution in patients with hepatic impairment. Consult your doctor before receiving the medicine.
Do not receive BUTODOL 1MG INJECTION if you are allergic to butorphanol tartrate and/or any other ingredients in this medicine.

BUTODOL 1MG INJECTION is not recommended for use in patients with lung problems such as significant respiratory depression or acute/severe bronchial asthma (in an unmonitored setting). It should be used with caution in patients with other lung diseases such as chronic obstructive pulmonary disease, substantially decreased respiratory reserve, hypoxia, hypercapnia and/or respiratory impairment. Consult your doctor before receiving the medication.

BUTODOL 1MG INJECTION should be used with caution in patients with heart diseases such as acute myocardial infarction, ventricular dysfunction and/or coronary insufficiency only if clearly necessary. Consult your doctor before receiving the medicine.

Are dependent on narcotics

Are a debilitated patient
Have a head injury and suffer from impaired consciousness and/or coma
Have seizure disorders

BUTODOL 1MG INJECTION is not recommended for use in children and adolescents (below 18 years of age). Consult your doctor before receiving the medicine.

Use in Geriatrics

BUTODOL 1MG INJECTION should be used with caution in elderly patients (aged 65 years and above). Consult your doctor before receiving the medicine.

A. Drug-Drug Interactions:

Medicines used to manage depression, such as selective serotonin reuptake inhibitors (Ex. citalopram), serotonin and norepinephrine reuptake inhibitors (Ex. paroxetine), tricyclic antidepressants (Ex. amoxapine)
Medicines that can affect the metabolism of certain drugs in the liver (Ex. erythromycin, theophylline)

Muscle relaxants (medicines used for muscle relaxation) Ex. cyclobenzaprine, metaxalone

Antipsychotics (medicines used to manage psychotic disorders) Ex. risperidone
Other opioids (medicines used to block opioid receptors) Ex. fentanyl

BUTODOL 1MG INJECTION will be given to you only by a doctor or nurse in a hospital, so it is unlikely for you to receive an overdose. introduction:
Introduction About FREZE TABLET

FREZE TABLET is a combination of Paracetamol and Tramadol which belongs to the group of medicines called Analgesics and Opioid analgesics respectively. FREZE TABLET is used in the management of moderate to severe pain.

Pain is a complex and unpleasant sensation consisting of a physiological and a psychological response to a noxious stimulus. Pain is a warning mechanism that protects us by influencing it to withdraw from harmful stimuli, which is primarily associated with injury.

Before taking FREZE TABLET, inform your doctor if you have respiratory disorders, gastrointestinal obstruction, including paralytic ileus, fits or seizures, have recently suffered from a head injury, depression, intolerance to some sugars, kidney or liver problems.

FREZE TABLET is not recommended for use in pregnant women and during breast-feeding more than once as it may pass through breast milk.  

FREZE TABLET is not recommended for use in children (under 12 years of age) and should be used with caution in elderly patients (aged 65 years and above).  

The common side effects of taking FREZE TABLET are nausea, dizziness, drowsiness, vomiting, gastrointestinal problems (such as constipation, flatulence, diarrhoea), stomach pain and dry mouth. Consult your physician if any of the side effects worsen.
uses: Manage moderate to severe pain
usesDetails:
Uses Of FREZE TABLET
Manage moderate to severe pain
mechanismOfAction:
How FREZE TABLET Works

FREZE TABLET contains Tramadol and Paracetamol. Tramadol acts on pain receptors present in the central nervous system. It blocks the nerve signals responsible for pain. Paracetamol acts as an analgesic by inhibiting the release of certain chemical mediators that produce pain. Tramadol and paracetamol, in combination, have a faster action and provide quick relief from pain.

Take FREZE TABLET as advised by your physician.

For tablet:

 Swallow the medicine with a glass of water. Do not crush or chew the medicine.

For effervescent tablet:

Take FREZE TABLET by dissolving in a glass of drinking water.

Your doctor will decide the correct dose and duration for you depending upon your age, body weight and disease condition.

Introduction About TRAMCET TABLET

TRAMCET TABLET is a combination of Paracetamol and Tramadol which belongs to the group of medicines called Analgesics and Opioid analgesics respectively. TRAMCET TABLET is used in the management of moderate to severe pain.

Pain is a complex and unpleasant sensation consisting of a physiological and a psychological response to a noxious stimulus. Pain is a warning mechanism that protects us by influencing it to withdraw from harmful stimuli, which is primarily associated with injury.

Before taking TRAMCET TABLET, inform your doctor if you have respiratory disorders, gastrointestinal obstruction, including paralytic ileus, fits or seizures, have recently suffered from a head injury, depression, intolerance to some sugars, kidney or liver problems.

TRAMCET TABLET is not recommended for use in pregnant women and during breast-feeding more than once as it may pass through breast milk.  

TRAMCET TABLET is not recommended for use in children (under 12 years of age) and should be used with caution in elderly patients (aged 65 years and above).  

The common side effects of taking TRAMCET TABLET are nausea, dizziness, drowsiness, vomiting, gastrointestinal problems (such as constipation, flatulence, diarrhoea), stomach pain and dry mouth. Consult your physician if any of the side effects worsen.

Manage moderate to severe pain
mechanismOfAction:
How TRAMCET TABLET Works

TRAMCET TABLET contains Tramadol and Paracetamol. Tramadol acts on pain receptors present in the central nervous system. It blocks the nerve signals responsible for pain. Paracetamol acts as an analgesic by inhibiting the release of certain chemical mediators that produce pain. Tramadol and paracetamol, in combination, have a faster action and provide quick relief from pain.

Take TRAMCET TABLET by dissolving in a glass of drinking water.

Your doctor will decide the correct dose and duration for you depending upon your age, body weight and disease condition.

introduction:
Introduction About FLUTENSE CAPSULE

FLUTENSE CAPSULE contains Flupirtine which belongs to a group of medicines called Nonopioid, Non-NSAID analgesics. It is used in the management of acute and chronic pain (such as primary headache, tumor pain, menstrual cramps, pain after traumatologic/orthopaedic operations and injuries and painful increased muscle tone of the posture and motor muscles).  

FLUTENSE CAPSULE is not recommended for use in patients with liver problems. Before taking FLUTENSE CAPSULE, inform your doctor if you have kidney disease, myasthenia gravis, had or have a history of tinnitus (ringing in the ears) or if you are allergic to Flupirtine. FLUTENSE CAPSULE is not recommended for use in pregnant and breast-feeding women unless clearly advised by the doctor.

FLUTENSE CAPSULE is not recommended for use in children and adolescents (below 18 years of age) unless deemed necessary and it should be used with caution in elderly patients, especially in patients with kidney problems. The most common side effects of taking FLUTENSE CAPSULE are fatigue, dizziness, heartburn, nausea, vomiting, dry mouth, constipation and diarrhea. Consult your doctor if any of the side effects worsen.

introduction:
Introduction About TRANSDOL 100MG TABLET

TRANSDOL 100MG TABLET contains Tapentadol which belongs to the group of medicines called Opioids. It is used in adults for the management of severe chronic pain which can only be managed by a strong (opioid) painkiller.

TRANSDOL 100MG TABLET is not recommended for use in patients having severe kidney or liver problems, asthma or if your breathing is dangerously slow or shallow (respiratory depression, hypercapnia), paralysis of the gut (muscles of the gastrointestinal tract).

TRANSDOL 100MG TABLET should be used with caution in patients who have slow or shallow breathing, increased pressure in the brain, disturbed consciousness up to coma, head injury or brain tumour, pancreatic or biliary tract disease (pancreatitis), increased tendency towards epilepsy, have tendency to abuse medicines (habituating), moderate liver problems, kidney disease and intolerance to certain sugars (such as lactose).

TRANSDOL 100MG TABLET is not recommended for use in pregnant women unless recommended by the doctor and it is not recommended for use in breast-feeding women. TRANSDOL 100MG TABLET is not recommended for use in children and adolescents (below 18 years of age) and it should be used with caution in elderly patients (aged 65 years of age).

The most common side effects of taking TRANSDOL 100MG TABLET are nausea, constipation, dizziness, drowsiness, headache, decreased appetite, indigestion and flushing. Consult your doctor if any of the side effects worsen.

Uses Of TRANSDOL 100MG TABLET
Manages severe chronic pain in adults
mechanismOfAction:
How TRANSDOL 100MG TABLET Works

TRANSDOL 100MG TABLET acts directly on the central nervous system and reduces the feeling of pain by interrupting the way in which pain is signalled between brain and the body. TRANSDOL 100MG TABLET binds with certain receptors called µ-opioid receptors and also increases the release of a nerve chemical called norepinephrine which causes inhibition of certain receptors leading to pain relief.

It should be used with caution in patients having other breathing issues (slow or shallow breathing). Consult your doctor before taking TRANSDOL 100MG TABLET.

Others

TRANSDOL 100MG TABLET is not recommended for use if you:

Have paralysis of the gut (muscles of the gastrointestinal tract)
Have acute poisoning of alcohol, sleeping pills, pain relievers or other psychotropic medicines (medicines that affect mood and emotions)

Have increased pressure in the brain or disturbed consciousness up to coma

Have a disease affecting the pancreas (such as pancreatitis) or biliary tract
Have tendency towards fits

Have lactose intolerance

TRANSDOL 100MG TABLET should be used with caution in elderly patients (aged 65 years and above) due to delayed excretion of this medicine in this age group and your doctor may adjust the dose. Consult your doctor before taking TRANSDOL 100MG TABLET.

name: ZIX S Tablet 10'S
introduction:
Introduction About ZIX S TABLET

ZIX S TABLET is used to relieve inflammation and pain due to bone and soft tissue injuries in affected individuals. It is also used to reduce high temperatures and provide relief from cold (while sneezing) in affected individuals. This medicine is also indicated for use to resolve post-operative inflammation, oedema, and pain. It is also used to provide relief from illnesses such as headaches, moderate migraines, and musculoskeletal pain.

ZIX S TABLET is a combination of Aceclofenac, Paracetamol, and Serratiopeptidase, which belong to the group of medicines called Nonsteroidal anti-inflammatory agents, Analgesics and Antipyretics, and Proteolytic enzymes, respectively. It helps to reduce pain and inflammation by blocking certain chemical messengers in the brain, and it also promotes healing by breaking down abnormal proteins at the site of inflammation, thereby healing the infected site.

ZIX S TABLET is not recommended for use in patients allergic to Aceclofenac, Paracetamol, or Serratiopeptidase. It is also not recommended for use in patients with active or recurrent peptic ulcers or haemorrhages (bleeding), severe heart, liver, or kidney diseases. Before taking ZIX S TABLET, inform your doctor if you suffer from uncontrolled high blood pressure, diabetes, hyperlipidaemia (high-fat level in the blood), gastrointestinal diseases such as ulcerative colitis (inflammatory bowel disease), and/or aseptic meningitis (inflammation of the brain).

ZIX S TABLET is not recommended for use by pregnant and breastfeeding women. It is also not recommended for use in children and adolescents (below 18 years old). Consult your doctor before taking the medicine. The most common side effects of taking ZIX S TABLET are abdominal pain, nausea, vomiting, diarrhea, flatulence, constipation, indigestion, and/or dizziness. Consult and inform your doctor if any of these side effects get worse.

introduction:
Introduction About ONTADOL P TABLET

ONTADOL P TABLET is a combination of Paracetamol and Tramadol which belongs to the group of medicines called Analgesics and Opioid analgesics respectively. ONTADOL P TABLET is used in the management of moderate to severe pain.

Pain is a complex and unpleasant sensation consisting of a physiological and a psychological response to a noxious stimulus. Pain is a warning mechanism that protects us by influencing it to withdraw from harmful stimuli, which is primarily associated with injury.

Before taking ONTADOL P TABLET, inform your doctor if you have respiratory disorders, gastrointestinal obstruction, including paralytic ileus, fits or seizures, have recently suffered from a head injury, depression, intolerance to some sugars, kidney or liver problems.

ONTADOL P TABLET is not recommended for use in pregnant women and during breast-feeding more than once as it may pass through breast milk.  

ONTADOL P TABLET is not recommended for use in children (under 12 years of age) and should be used with caution in elderly patients (aged 65 years and above).  

The common side effects of taking ONTADOL P TABLET are nausea, dizziness, drowsiness, vomiting, gastrointestinal problems (such as constipation, flatulence, diarrhoea), stomach pain and dry mouth. Consult your physician if any of the side effects worsen.
uses: Manage moderate to severe pain
usesDetails:
Uses Of ONTADOL P TABLET
Manage moderate to severe pain
mechanismOfAction:
How ONTADOL P TABLET Works

ONTADOL P TABLET contains Tramadol and Paracetamol. Tramadol acts on pain receptors present in the central nervous system. It blocks the nerve signals responsible for pain. Paracetamol acts as an analgesic by inhibiting the release of certain chemical mediators that produce pain. Tramadol and paracetamol, in combination, have a faster action and provide quick relief from pain.
usageDetails:
How to use ONTADOL P TABLET

Take ONTADOL P TABLET as advised by your physician.

For tablet:

 Swallow the medicine with a glass of water. Do not crush or chew the medicine.

For effervescent tablet:

Take ONTADOL P TABLET by dissolving in a glass of drinking water.

Your doctor will decide the correct dose and duration for you depending upon your age, body weight and disease condition.

introduction:
Introduction About TRANSDOL 50MG TABLET

TRANSDOL 50MG TABLET contains Tapentadol which belongs to the group of medicines called Opioids. It is used in adults for the management of severe chronic pain which can only be managed by a strong (opioid) painkiller.

TRANSDOL 50MG TABLET is not recommended for use in patients having severe kidney or liver problems, asthma or if your breathing is dangerously slow or shallow (respiratory depression, hypercapnia), paralysis of the gut (muscles of the gastrointestinal tract).

TRANSDOL 50MG TABLET should be used with caution in patients who have slow or shallow breathing, increased pressure in the brain, disturbed consciousness up to coma, head injury or brain tumour, pancreatic or biliary tract disease (pancreatitis), increased tendency towards epilepsy, have tendency to abuse medicines (habituating), moderate liver problems, kidney disease and intolerance to certain sugars (such as lactose).

TRANSDOL 50MG TABLET is not recommended for use in pregnant women unless recommended by the doctor and it is not recommended for use in breast-feeding women. TRANSDOL 50MG TABLET is not recommended for use in children and adolescents (below 18 years of age) and it should be used with caution in elderly patients (aged 65 years of age).

The most common side effects of taking TRANSDOL 50MG TABLET are nausea, constipation, dizziness, drowsiness, headache, decreased appetite, indigestion and flushing. Consult your doctor if any of the side effects worsen.

How TRANSDOL 50MG TABLET Works

TRANSDOL 50MG TABLET acts directly on the central nervous system and reduces the feeling of pain by interrupting the way in which pain is signalled between brain and the body. TRANSDOL 50MG TABLET binds with certain receptors called µ-opioid receptors and also increases the release of a nerve chemical called norepinephrine which causes inhibition of certain receptors leading to pain relief.

introduction:
Introduction About DOLOWIN FORTE TABLET

DOLOWIN FORTE TABLET is used to relieve inflammation and pain due to bone and soft tissue injuries in affected individuals. It is also used to reduce high temperatures and provide relief from cold (while sneezing) in affected individuals. This medicine is also indicated for use to resolve post-operative inflammation, oedema, and pain. It is also used to provide relief from illnesses such as headaches, moderate migraines, and musculoskeletal pain.

DOLOWIN FORTE TABLET is a combination of Aceclofenac, Paracetamol, and Serratiopeptidase, which belong to the group of medicines called Nonsteroidal anti-inflammatory agents, Analgesics and Antipyretics, and Proteolytic enzymes, respectively. It helps to reduce pain and inflammation by blocking certain chemical messengers in the brain, and it also promotes healing by breaking down abnormal proteins at the site of inflammation, thereby healing the infected site.

DOLOWIN FORTE TABLET is not recommended for use in patients allergic to Aceclofenac, Paracetamol, or Serratiopeptidase. It is also not recommended for use in patients with active or recurrent peptic ulcers or haemorrhages (bleeding), severe heart, liver, or kidney diseases. Before taking DOLOWIN FORTE TABLET, inform your doctor if you suffer from uncontrolled high blood pressure, diabetes, hyperlipidaemia (high-fat level in the blood), gastrointestinal diseases such as ulcerative colitis (inflammatory bowel disease), and/or aseptic meningitis (inflammation of the brain).

DOLOWIN FORTE TABLET is not recommended for use by pregnant and breastfeeding women. It is also not recommended for use in children and adolescents (below 18 years old). Consult your doctor before taking the medicine. The most common side effects of taking DOLOWIN FORTE TABLET are abdominal pain, nausea, vomiting, diarrhea, flatulence, constipation, indigestion, and/or dizziness. Consult and inform your doctor if any of these side effects get worse.

Introduction About TAPCYNTA 75MG TABLET

TAPCYNTA 75MG TABLET contains Tapentadol which belongs to the group of medicines called Opioids. It is used in adults for the management of severe chronic pain which can only be managed by a strong (opioid) painkiller.

TAPCYNTA 75MG TABLET is not recommended for use in patients having severe kidney or liver problems, asthma or if your breathing is dangerously slow or shallow (respiratory depression, hypercapnia), paralysis of the gut (muscles of the gastrointestinal tract).

TAPCYNTA 75MG TABLET should be used with caution in patients who have slow or shallow breathing, increased pressure in the brain, disturbed consciousness up to coma, head injury or brain tumour, pancreatic or biliary tract disease (pancreatitis), increased tendency towards epilepsy, have tendency to abuse medicines (habituating), moderate liver problems, kidney disease and intolerance to certain sugars (such as lactose).

TAPCYNTA 75MG TABLET is not recommended for use in pregnant women unless recommended by the doctor and it is not recommended for use in breast-feeding women. TAPCYNTA 75MG TABLET is not recommended for use in children and adolescents (below 18 years of age) and it should be used with caution in elderly patients (aged 65 years of age).

The most common side effects of taking TAPCYNTA 75MG TABLET are nausea, constipation, dizziness, drowsiness, headache, decreased appetite, indigestion and flushing. Consult your doctor if any of the side effects worsen.

How TAPCYNTA 75MG TABLET Works

Do not drive or use any machinery while taking TAPCYNTA 75MG TABLET if you experience drowsiness, dizziness, blurred vision or impairment of reactions. 

Alcohol

Avoid consumption of alcohol while taking TAPCYNTA 75MG TABLET as it may increase the effect of drowsiness.

Kidney

TAPCYNTA 75MG TABLET is not recommended for use in patients with severe kidney problems. It should be used with caution in patients suffering from kidney disease. Consult your doctor before taking TAPCYNTA 75MG TABLET. 

Liver

TAPCYNTA 75MG TABLET is not recommended for use in patients with severe liver problems. TAPCYNTA 75MG TABLET should be used with caution in patients with moderate liver problems and your doctor may adjust the dose. Consult your doctor before taking TAPCYNTA 75MG TABLET.  

Allergy

Do not take TAPCYNTA 75MG TABLET if you are allergic to Tapentadol or any other ingredients of this medicine.

Introduction About TRAMATAC P TABLET

TRAMATAC P TABLET is a combination of Paracetamol and Tramadol which belongs to the group of medicines called Analgesics and Opioid analgesics respectively. TRAMATAC P TABLET is used in the management of moderate to severe pain.

Pain is a complex and unpleasant sensation consisting of a physiological and a psychological response to a noxious stimulus. Pain is a warning mechanism that protects us by influencing it to withdraw from harmful stimuli, which is primarily associated with injury.

Before taking TRAMATAC P TABLET, inform your doctor if you have respiratory disorders, gastrointestinal obstruction, including paralytic ileus, fits or seizures, have recently suffered from a head injury, depression, intolerance to some sugars, kidney or liver problems.

TRAMATAC P TABLET is not recommended for use in pregnant women and during breast-feeding more than once as it may pass through breast milk.  

TRAMATAC P TABLET is not recommended for use in children (under 12 years of age) and should be used with caution in elderly patients (aged 65 years and above).  

The common side effects of taking TRAMATAC P TABLET are nausea, dizziness, drowsiness, vomiting, gastrointestinal problems (such as constipation, flatulence, diarrhoea), stomach pain and dry mouth. Consult your physician if any of the side effects worsen.

Uses Of TRAMATAC P TABLET
Manage moderate to severe pain
mechanismOfAction:
How TRAMATAC P TABLET Works

TRAMATAC P TABLET contains Tramadol and Paracetamol. Tramadol acts on pain receptors present in the central nervous system. It blocks the nerve signals responsible for pain. Paracetamol acts as an analgesic by inhibiting the release of certain chemical mediators that produce pain. Tramadol and paracetamol, in combination, have a faster action and provide quick relief from pain.
usageDetails:
How to use TRAMATAC P TABLET

Take TRAMATAC P TABLET as advised by your physician.

For tablet:

 Swallow the medicine with a glass of water. Do not crush or chew the medicine.

For effervescent tablet:

Take TRAMATAC P TABLET by dissolving in a glass of drinking water.

Your doctor will decide the correct dose and duration for you depending upon your age, body weight and disease condition.

introduction:
Introduction About TRAMTAB P TABLET

TRAMTAB P TABLET is a combination of Paracetamol and Tramadol which belongs to the group of medicines called Analgesics and Opioid analgesics respectively. TRAMTAB P TABLET is used in the management of moderate to severe pain.

Pain is a complex and unpleasant sensation consisting of a physiological and a psychological response to a noxious stimulus. Pain is a warning mechanism that protects us by influencing it to withdraw from harmful stimuli, which is primarily associated with injury.

Before taking TRAMTAB P TABLET, inform your doctor if you have respiratory disorders, gastrointestinal obstruction, including paralytic ileus, fits or seizures, have recently suffered from a head injury, depression, intolerance to some sugars, kidney or liver problems.

TRAMTAB P TABLET is not recommended for use in pregnant women and during breast-feeding more than once as it may pass through breast milk.  

TRAMTAB P TABLET is not recommended for use in children (under 12 years of age) and should be used with caution in elderly patients (aged 65 years and above).  

The common side effects of taking TRAMTAB P TABLET are nausea, dizziness, drowsiness, vomiting, gastrointestinal problems (such as constipation, flatulence, diarrhoea), stomach pain and dry mouth. Consult your physician if any of the side effects worsen.
uses: Manage moderate to severe pain
usesDetails:
Uses Of TRAMTAB P TABLET
Manage moderate to severe pain
mechanismOfAction:
How TRAMTAB P TABLET Works

TRAMTAB P TABLET contains Tramadol and Paracetamol. Tramadol acts on pain receptors present in the central nervous system. It blocks the nerve signals responsible for pain. Paracetamol acts as an analgesic by inhibiting the release of certain chemical mediators that produce pain. Tramadol and paracetamol, in combination, have a faster action and provide quick relief from pain.
usageDetails:
How to use TRAMTAB P TABLET

Take TRAMTAB P TABLET as advised by your physician.

For tablet:

 Swallow the medicine with a glass of water. Do not crush or chew the medicine.

For effervescent tablet:

Take TRAMTAB P TABLET by dissolving in a glass of drinking water.

Your doctor will decide the correct dose and duration for you depending upon your age, body weight and disease condition.

Introduction About FEVANEX 250 STRAWBERRY AND VANNILA FLAVOUR ORAL SUSPENSION

FEVANEX 250 STRAWBERRY AND VANNILA FLAVOUR ORAL SUSPENSION contains Paracetamol which belongs to the group of medicines called Analgesics and Antipyretics. It is used to relieve mild to moderate pain like headache, migraine, nerve pain, toothache, sore throat, period pains, teething, immunisation, earache, and general aches and pains. It can also be used to manage fever (high temperature), and symptoms of cold or flu.

Before taking FEVANEX 250 STRAWBERRY AND VANNILA FLAVOUR ORAL SUSPENSION, inform your doctor if you have liver or kidney problems, fructose intolerance, Gilberts syndrome, glucose-6-phosphate dehydrogenase deficiency, hemolytic anaemia, reduced glutathione levels, malnourishment, dehydration or if you weigh less than 50 kg.

FEVANEX 250 STRAWBERRY AND VANNILA FLAVOUR ORAL SUSPENSION should be used in pregnant women only if considered necessary. Avoid consumption of alcohol during management with FEVANEX 250 STRAWBERRY AND VANNILA FLAVOUR ORAL SUSPENSION, as it might make you more prone to side effects.

FEVANEX 250 STRAWBERRY AND VANNILA FLAVOUR ORAL SUSPENSION is not recommended for use in children (2-3 months old, weighing less than 4 kg or born before 37 weeks). Contact your doctor if you get any side effects of any of the symptoms get worse.

introduction:
Introduction About PARAFAST STRAWBERRY FLAVOUR SUSPENSION

Parafast Strawberry Flavour Suspension is a painkiller and anti-pyretic medicine. It is used in children to temporarily relieve mild to moderate pain such as headache, toothache, migraine, nerve pain, sore throat, period pains and general aches and helps to reduce fever (high body temperature). Also, it relieves symptoms of cold and flu. It contains paracetamol as an active ingredient that reduces fever and pain.   

Paracetamol relieves pain by increasing the pain threshold by inhibiting certain enzymes (COX-1 and COX-2) involved in synthesis of chemicals responsible for inducing pain (prostaglandins). It reduces fever by directly acting on heat-regulating centers in the brain, resulting in vessel relaxation, sweating and loss of body heat.

Always give Parafast Strawberry Flavour Suspension to your child as advised by the doctor. Shake well before use. Recommended dosage for children aged 3 months and above is 10-15mg/kg 3-4 times in a day or as directed by the doctor. Do not give more than 4 doses in 24 hours and not to give more than 3 days without consulting a doctor. Do not exceed the recommended daily dosage. Use a measuring cup to properly measure the dose. Do not give Parafast Strawberry Flavour Suspension to your child if your child is allergic to any of its components.

introduction:
Introduction About TOP MONO 25MG TABLET

TOP MONO 25MG TABLET contains Tapentadol which belongs to the group of medicines called Opioids. It is used in adults for the management of severe chronic pain which can only be managed by a strong (opioid) painkiller.

name: Neutram P 500/50mg Tablet 10'S
introduction:
Introduction About NEUTRAM P 500/50MG TABLET

NEUTRAM P 500/50MG TABLET is a combination of Paracetamol and Tramadol which belongs to the group of medicines called Analgesics and Opioid analgesics respectively. NEUTRAM P 500/50MG TABLET is used in the management of moderate to severe pain.

Pain is a complex and unpleasant sensation consisting of a physiological and a psychological response to a noxious stimulus. Pain is a warning mechanism that protects us by influencing it to withdraw from harmful stimuli, which is primarily associated with injury.

Before taking NEUTRAM P 500/50MG TABLET, inform your doctor if you have respiratory disorders, gastrointestinal obstruction, including paralytic ileus, fits or seizures, have recently suffered from a head injury, depression, intolerance to some sugars, kidney or liver problems.

NEUTRAM P 500/50MG TABLET is not recommended for use in pregnant women and during breast-feeding more than once as it may pass through breast milk.  

NEUTRAM P 500/50MG TABLET is not recommended for use in children (under 12 years of age) and should be used with caution in elderly patients (aged 65 years and above).  

The common side effects of taking NEUTRAM P 500/50MG TABLET are nausea, dizziness, drowsiness, vomiting, gastrointestinal problems (such as constipation, flatulence, diarrhoea), stomach pain and dry mouth. Consult your physician if any of the side effects worsen.
uses: Manage moderate to severe pain
usesDetails:
Uses Of NEUTRAM P 500/50MG TABLET
Manage moderate to severe pain
mechanismOfAction:
How NEUTRAM P 500/50MG TABLET Works

NEUTRAM P 500/50MG TABLET contains Tramadol and Paracetamol. Tramadol acts on pain receptors present in the central nervous system. It blocks the nerve signals responsible for pain. Paracetamol acts as an analgesic by inhibiting the release of certain chemical mediators that produce pain. Tramadol and paracetamol, in combination, have a faster action and provide quick relief from pain.
usageDetails:
How to use NEUTRAM P 500/50MG TABLET

Take NEUTRAM P 500/50MG TABLET as advised by your physician.

For tablet:

 Swallow the medicine with a glass of water. Do not crush or chew the medicine.

For effervescent tablet:

Take NEUTRAM P 500/50MG TABLET by dissolving in a glass of drinking water.

Your doctor will decide the correct dose and duration for you depending upon your age, body weight and disease condition.

introduction:
Introduction About P 750MG TABLET

P 750MG TABLET contains Paracetamol which belongs to the group of medicines called Analgesics and Antipyretics. It is used to relieve mild to moderate pain (including headaches, backache, toothache, severe nerve pain, sore throat, period pain, low back and leg pain, muscle, connective tissue and joint pain, symptomatic relief of sprains, strain, joint swelling and stiffness). It is also used to lower fever (high body temperature) and relieves the symptoms of cold or flu.   

Before taking P 750MG TABLET, inform your doctor if you or your child have liver or kidney problems or any allergies. It should be used with caution in patients with liver problems due to alcohol to manage the risk of liver damage.

P 750MG TABLET should be used with caution in pregnant women only if clearly advised by the doctor and can be used in breastfeeding women. P 750MG TABLET is not recommended for use in children less than 10 years of age and should be used with caution in elderly patients.

Consult your doctor if you experience any side effects or unusual effects during management with P 750MG TABLET.

Lowers fever and relieves the symptoms of cold or flu
usesDetails:
Uses Of P 750MG TABLET
Relieves mild to moderate pain (such as headache, toothache, joint pain)
Lowers fever and relieves the symptoms of cold or flu
mechanismOfAction:
How P 750MG TABLET Works

P 750MG TABLET relieves pain by increasing the pain threshold by inhibiting certain enzymes (COX-1 and COX-2) involved in the synthesis of chemicals responsible for inducing pain (prostaglandins). It reduces fever by directly acting on heat-regulating centers in the brain, resulting in vessel relaxation, sweating and loss of body heat.
usageDetails:
How to use P 750MG TABLET

Take P 750MG TABLET as advised by your physician. It can be taken with or without food.

For Tablet, Capsule: Swallow P 750MG TABLET with a glass of water. Do not crush or chew the medicine.

For Dispersible Tablet: Disperse the medicine in the specified quantity of water as mentioned on the label. Consume the medicine immediately after reconstitution.

Your doctor will decide the correct dose and duration of therapy for you depending on your age, body weight and severity of the condition.

introduction:
Introduction About TAPCYNTA 50MG TABLET

TAPCYNTA 50MG TABLET contains Tapentadol which belongs to the group of medicines called Opioids. It is used in adults for the management of severe chronic pain which can only be managed by a strong (opioid) painkiller.

TAPCYNTA 50MG TABLET is not recommended for use in patients having severe kidney or liver problems, asthma or if your breathing is dangerously slow or shallow (respiratory depression, hypercapnia), paralysis of the gut (muscles of the gastrointestinal tract).

TAPCYNTA 50MG TABLET should be used with caution in patients who have slow or shallow breathing, increased pressure in the brain, disturbed consciousness up to coma, head injury or brain tumour, pancreatic or biliary tract disease (pancreatitis), increased tendency towards epilepsy, have tendency to abuse medicines (habituating), moderate liver problems, kidney disease and intolerance to certain sugars (such as lactose).

TAPCYNTA 50MG TABLET is not recommended for use in pregnant women unless recommended by the doctor and it is not recommended for use in breast-feeding women. TAPCYNTA 50MG TABLET is not recommended for use in children and adolescents (below 18 years of age) and it should be used with caution in elderly patients (aged 65 years of age).

The most common side effects of taking TAPCYNTA 50MG TABLET are nausea, constipation, dizziness, drowsiness, headache, decreased appetite, indigestion and flushing. Consult your doctor if any of the side effects worsen.

Uses Of TAPCYNTA 50MG TABLET
Manages severe chronic pain in adults
mechanismOfAction:
How TAPCYNTA 50MG TABLET Works

TAPCYNTA 50MG TABLET acts directly on the central nervous system and reduces the feeling of pain by interrupting the way in which pain is signalled between brain and the body. TAPCYNTA 50MG TABLET binds with certain receptors called µ-opioid receptors and also increases the release of a nerve chemical called norepinephrine which causes inhibition of certain receptors leading to pain relief.

Take TAPCYNTA 50MG TABLET as advised by your doctor. Swallow the medicine with a glass of water. Do not crush or chew the medicine. Your doctor will decide the correct dose and duration for you depending upon your age, body weight and disease condition.

It should be used with caution in patients having other breathing issues (slow or shallow breathing). Consult your doctor before taking TAPCYNTA 50MG TABLET.

Others

TAPCYNTA 50MG TABLET is not recommended for use if you:

Have paralysis of the gut (muscles of the gastrointestinal tract)
Have acute poisoning of alcohol, sleeping pills, pain relievers or other psychotropic medicines (medicines that affect mood and emotions)

Have increased pressure in the brain or disturbed consciousness up to coma
Had a head injury or brain tumour
Have a disease affecting the pancreas (such as pancreatitis) or biliary tract
Have tendency towards fits
Have tendency to abuse medicines (getting habitual of it)
Have lactose intolerance

TAPCYNTA 50MG TABLET should be used with caution in elderly patients (aged 65 years and above) due to delayed excretion of this medicine in this age group and your doctor may adjust the dose. Consult your doctor before taking TAPCYNTA 50MG TABLET.

Overdosage:

If you or anyone else accidentally takes too much of TAPCYNTA 50MG TABLET, consult your doctor immediately or visit the nearby hospital. Overdosage symptoms of TAPCYNTA 50MG TABLET are pin-point pupils, vomiting, fast heartbeat, drop in blood pressure, collapse, disturbed consciousness or coma (deep unconsciousness), epileptic fits (convulsions), dangerously slow or shallow breathing or stopping breathing may occur.

introduction:
Introduction About TRAMADUS INJECTION

TRAMADUS INJECTION contains Tramadol which belongs to the group of medicines called Opioids. It is used in the management of moderate to severe pain.       

TRAMADUS INJECTION is not recommended for use in patients with seizures (fits) which are not controlled by the management, who have consumed alcohol, withdrawal symptoms caused by opiates (morphine-like medicines).   

Before receiving TRAMADUS INJECTION, inform your doctor if you had or have a head injury, breathing difficulties, severe liver or kidney problems, feeling of faint, are in a shocking state (sign may be cold sweat), addicted to alcohol or certain medicines (such as opioids), previously suffered from withdrawal symptoms while stop taking drugs or alcohol (signs include agitation, anxiety, shaking or sweating), adrenal insufficiency and seizures (fits).

TRAMADUS INJECTION is not recommended for use in pregnant and breastfeeding women. TRAMADUS INJECTION is not recommended for use in children (below 12 years of age) and in children with breathing problems. It should be cautiously used among elderly patients (aged 75 years and above).

The most common side effects of receiving TRAMADUS INJECTION are fatigue, vomiting, headache, dry mouth and constipation. Inform your doctor if any of the side effects worsen.
uses: Manage moderate to severe pain
usesDetails:
Uses Of TRAMADUS INJECTION
Manage moderate to severe pain
mechanismOfAction:
How TRAMADUS INJECTION Works

TRAMADUS INJECTION inhibits the reuptake of the natural neurotransmitters (norepinephrine and serotonin) and binds weakly to certain receptors (μ-opioid), blocking the transmission of pain signals to the brain. Thus, it reduces moderate to severe pain by acting on specific nerve cells of the spinal cord and the brain.
usageDetails:
How to use TRAMADUS INJECTION

TRAMADUS INJECTION will be given to you only by a doctor or a nurse into a vein as a slow intravenous infusion or into the muscle as intramuscular injection. Your doctor will decide the correct dose and duration for you depending on your age, body weight and disease condition.

introduction:
Introduction About GAG PLUS TABLET

GAG PLUS TABLET is used for pain management associated with osteoarthritis, rheumatoid arthritis and ankylosing spondylitis. It can also be used to reduce pain caused due to sprains, strains, sports injuries, tendon pain, bone fracture pain and minor surgical and other pains. It is a combination of Aceclofenac + Paracetamol which are pain relieving agents.

Take GAG PLUS TABLET after food to avoid gastric irritation. Do not take this medicine more than the duration recommended by your doctor. Before taking this medicine inform your doctor if you are having any liver, kidney or heart problems. You must also inform your doctor if you have stomach ulcers, gut inflammation, inflammatory bowel diseases or chronic alcoholism, or if you are pregnant or breastfeeding as a precaution.

The most common side effects of taking GAG PLUS TABLET are indigestion, stomach pain, bloating and headache which can be managed by taking this medicine with meals and by following simple diet with less spicy food and limiting alcohol consumption.

mechanismOfAction:
How GAG PLUS TABLET Works

GAG PLUS TABLET contains aceclofenac and paracetamol which works together to relieve pain and inflammation. Aceclofenac is a non-steroidal anti-inflammatory drug (NSAID) that blocks enzymes called cyclooxygenase (COX) enzymes, reducing the production of chemicals called prostaglandins, which are responsible for causing pain and inflammation.

Paracetamol, on the other hand, works by reducing the perception of pain in the brain and also helps lower fever by acting on the heat-regulating centers in the brain. Together, they provide stronger pain relief and reduce inflammation.

Do not exceed the prescribed dose, and follow the timing as recommended for the best results.
Always consult your doctor for personalized advice on dosage and duration.

introduction:
Introduction About TOP MONO 50MG TABLET

TOP MONO 50MG TABLET contains Tapentadol which belongs to the group of medicines called Opioids. It is used in adults for the management of severe chronic pain which can only be managed by a strong (opioid) painkiller.

TOP MONO 50MG TABLET is not recommended for use in patients having severe kidney or liver problems, asthma or if your breathing is dangerously slow or shallow (respiratory depression, hypercapnia), paralysis of the gut (muscles of the gastrointestinal tract).

TOP MONO 50MG TABLET should be used with caution in patients who have slow or shallow breathing, increased pressure in the brain, disturbed consciousness up to coma, head injury or brain tumour, pancreatic or biliary tract disease (pancreatitis), increased tendency towards epilepsy, have tendency to abuse medicines (habituating), moderate liver problems, kidney disease and intolerance to certain sugars (such as lactose).

TOP MONO 50MG TABLET is not recommended for use in pregnant women unless recommended by the doctor and it is not recommended for use in breast-feeding women. TOP MONO 50MG TABLET is not recommended for use in children and adolescents (below 18 years of age) and it should be used with caution in elderly patients (aged 65 years of age).

The most common side effects of taking TOP MONO 50MG TABLET are nausea, constipation, dizziness, drowsiness, headache, decreased appetite, indigestion and flushing. Consult your doctor if any of the side effects worsen.

usesDetails:

Manages severe chronic pain in adults
mechanismOfAction:
How TOP MONO 50MG TABLET Works

TOP MONO 50MG TABLET acts directly on the central nervous system and reduces the feeling of pain by interrupting the way in which pain is signalled between brain and the body. TOP MONO 50MG TABLET binds with certain receptors called µ-opioid receptors and also increases the release of a nerve chemical called norepinephrine which causes inhibition of certain receptors leading to pain relief.

Take TOP MONO 50MG TABLET as advised by your doctor. Swallow the medicine with a glass of water. Do not crush or chew the medicine. Your doctor will decide the correct dose and duration for you depending upon your age, body weight and disease condition.

name: PARALYF Suspension 60ml
introduction:
Introduction About PARALYF SUSPENSION

Paralyf Suspension is an analgesic and antipyretic medicine used to relieve mild to moderate pain such as headaches, muscle aches, sore throats, toothaches, backaches and vaccination pain. It is also used to reduce fever. It contains Paracetamol as an active ingredient.

Paracetamol manages fever by directly acting on the heat-regulating centres of our brain. This leads to stimulation of sweating mechanism and loss of body heat. It exhibits the pain killing action by inhibiting the activation of the pain mechanism. It does this by the minimizing the synthesis of prostaglandins (pain causing chemicals) at the affected site.

Always give Paralyf Suspension as advised by the doctor. Do not exceed the recommended daily dosage. Shake well before use. It is for paediatric use only.

name: SUPPOL CHILD 170mg Suppository 5's
introduction:
Introduction About SUPPOL CHILD 170MG SUPPOSITORY

Suppol Child 170 Suppository is a painkiller and anti-pyretic medicine. It is used in children to relieve pain and fever (high body temperature). It contains paracetamol as an active ingredient that reduces fever and pain. It is ideal when oral administration is inconvenient or not possible to take.

Paracetamol relieves pain by increasing the pain threshold by inhibiting certain enzymes (COX-1 and COX-2) involved in synthesis of chemicals responsible for inducing pain (prostaglandins). It reduces fever by directly acting on heat-regulating centers in the brain, resulting in vessel relaxation, sweating and loss of body heat.  

Always use Suppol Child 170 Suppository for your child as advised by your child’s doctor. It is for rectal route only. For administration, place the baby in sleeping position, hold the legs with hands and gently push the suppository in to the rectum. For grown up children suppository can be inserted in standing or sitting position. Do not administer more than the recommended dosage as it may cause injury to the liver.

introduction:
Introduction About STERWIN 30 INJECTION

STERWIN 30 INJECTION contains Pentazocine which belongs to the group of medicines called Opiate Analgesics. STERWIN 30 INJECTION is used to relieve moderate to severe pain. It may also be used for pre-operative or pre-anesthetic medication and as a supplement to surgical anesthesia. Avoid consuming alcohol, tobacco, and smoking while receiving STERWIN 30 INJECTION as it can increase the side effects.

Do not receive STERWIN 30 INJECTION if you have severe asthma, trouble breathing, or other breathing problems, heart problems, bowel blockage or narrowing of the stomach or intestines, severe pain in the abdomen due to acute appendicitis or pancreatitis, acute respiratory depression, head injury, a risk for seizures, undergone a surgery or are planned to undergo a surgery therefore, consult your doctor before receiving. STERWIN 30 INJECTION should be used with caution in patients who have severe kidney, liver and lung disease, heart disease, migraines, chronic or severe constipation, thyroid, adrenal or prostate gland disorders, low blood pressure, psychiatric problems such as depression, hallucinations or other mental problems, consult your doctor before receiving the medicine.

STERWIN 30 INJECTION is not recommended for use in pregnant and breastfeeding women until necessary, therefore, consult your doctor before receiving it. STERWIN 30 INJECTION is not recommended for administration in children and adolescents less than 12 years of age, consult your doctor for advice. STERWIN 30 INJECTION should be used with caution in elderly patients, therefore consult your doctor before receiving. The most common side effects after receiving STERWIN 30 INJECTION are nausea, vomiting, sedation, sweating, dizziness, euphoria and light-headedness. Consult your doctor immediately in case any of the side effects worsen or you experience an allergic reaction after receiving STERWIN 30 INJECTION.

introduction:
Introduction About PARAVID 650 TABLET

PARAVID 650 TABLET is used to relieve mild to moderate pain (including headaches, backache, toothache, severe nerve pain, sore throat, period pain, low back and leg pain, muscle, connective tissue, and joint pain, symptomatic relief of sprains, strain, joint swelling, and stiffness). It is also used to lower fever (high body temperature) and relieve the symptoms of the cold or flu.

It contains paracetamol, which belongs to the group of medicines called Analgesics and Antipyretics. It works by blocking the release of certain chemicals (like prostaglandins) within the body that cause pain and inflammation. It also manages prostaglandin release in the hypothalamus of the brain, which reduces body temperature.

Take PARAVID 650 Tablet as advised by your physician. Swallow the medicine with a glass of water. It can be taken with or without meals. However, taking it with meals helps reduce stomach upset or irritation.

Strictly follow the dosing schedule as instructed by your doctor. Do not take more than the recommended dosages, as it could affect your liver. PARAVID 650 Tablet starts working within 30 minutes of its intake. Leave a time gap of 4 hours between each dose of PARAVID 650 TABLET.

Before taking PARAVID 650 TABLET, inform your doctor if you have liver or kidney problems or any allergies. It should be used with caution in patients with liver problems due to alcohol to reduce the risk of liver damage.

PARAVID 650 TABLET should be used with caution in pregnant women only if clearly advised by the doctor and can be used in breastfeeding women. PARAVID 650 TABLET is not recommended for use in children less than 10 years of age and should be used with caution in elderly patients.

Consult your doctor if you experience any side effects or unusual effects during management with PARAVID 650 TABLET.

ZYPARA INFUSION contains Paracetamol which belongs to the group of medicines called Analgesics and Antipyretics. It is used for short-term management of moderate pain (especially after surgery) and fever when administered by the intravenous route is clinically justified.

Before receiving ZYPARA INFUSION, inform your doctor if you have heart, lung, liver or kidney problems or if you suffer from alcoholism or alcohol abuse, malnourishment and severely low blood volume due to dehydration or blood loss.

ZYPARA INFUSION should be used with caution in pregnant and breastfeeding women only if clearly advised by the doctor. ZYPARA INFUSION should be used with caution in children and elderly patients.

The most common side effects of receiving ZYPARA INFUSION are nausea, vomiting, headache, sleep problems and itching. Inform your doctor if any of these side effect worsens.

introduction:
Introduction About PEDIMOL 250 SUSPENSION

Pedimol Suspension is a painkiller and anti-pyretic medicine. It is used in children to temporarily relieve mild to moderate pain such as headache, toothache, migraine, nerve pain, sore throat, period pains and general aches and helps to reduce fever (high body temperature). Also, it relieves symptoms of cold and flu. It contains paracetamol as an active ingredient that reduces fever and pain.   

Paracetamol relieves pain by increasing the pain threshold by inhibiting certain enzymes (COX-1 and COX-2) involved in synthesis of chemicals responsible for inducing pain (prostaglandins). It reduces fever by directly acting on heat-regulating centers in the brain, resulting in vessel relaxation, sweating and loss of body heat.

Always give Pedimol Suspension to your child as advised by the doctor. Shake well before use. Recommended dosage for children aged 3 months to 12 years is 10 to 15 mg/kg/dose for 3 to 4 times a day or as directed by the doctor. Use a measuring cup to properly measure the dose. Do not exceed the recommended daily dosage.

introduction:
Introduction About ACEPHAZE P TABLET

ACEPHAZE P TABLET is used for pain management associated with osteoarthritis, rheumatoid arthritis and ankylosing spondylitis. It can also be used to reduce pain caused due to sprains, strains, sports injuries, tendon pain, bone fracture pain and minor surgical and other pains. It is a combination of Aceclofenac + Paracetamol which are pain relieving agents.

Take ACEPHAZE P TABLET after food to avoid gastric irritation. Do not take this medicine more than the duration recommended by your doctor. Before taking this medicine inform your doctor if you are having any liver, kidney or heart problems. You must also inform your doctor if you have stomach ulcers, gut inflammation, inflammatory bowel diseases or chronic alcoholism, or if you are pregnant or breastfeeding as a precaution.

The most common side effects of taking ACEPHAZE P TABLET are indigestion, stomach pain, bloating and headache which can be managed by taking this medicine with meals and by following simple diet with less spicy food and limiting alcohol consumption.

mechanismOfAction:
How ACEPHAZE P TABLET Works

ACEPHAZE P TABLET contains aceclofenac and paracetamol which works together to relieve pain and inflammation. Aceclofenac is a non-steroidal anti-inflammatory drug (NSAID) that blocks enzymes called cyclooxygenase (COX) enzymes, reducing the production of chemicals called prostaglandins, which are responsible for causing pain and inflammation.

Paracetamol, on the other hand, works by reducing the perception of pain in the brain and also helps lower fever by acting on the heat-regulating centers in the brain. Together, they provide stronger pain relief and reduce inflammation.

The usual dose is one tablet 1-2 times a day, depending on the condition being treated and your doctor's instructions.
Do not exceed the prescribed dose, and follow the timing as recommended for the best results.
Always consult your doctor for personalized advice on dosage and duration.

introduction:
Introduction About LORNOXISTIN TABLET

LORNOXISTIN TABLET is a combination of Lornoxicam and Paracetamol which belongs to the group of medicines called Non-steroidal anti-inflammatory drugs and Analgesics, respectively. It is used to manage mild to moderate joint pain and provides relief from inflammation of joints caused by certain types of rheumatic diseases (autoimmune and inflammatory disease) in affected individuals.

LORNOXISTIN TABLET is not recommended for use in patients allergic to Lornoxicam, Paracetamol, other NSAIDs including acetylsalicylic acid. It is also not recommended for use in patients suffering from thrombocytopenia (low blood platelet count that causes increased risk of bleeding/unusual bruising), gastrointestinal bleeding, rupture and bleeding of blood vessel in brain/other bleeding disorders. The medicine is also not indicated for use in patients suffering from active peptic ulcer or with a history of recurrent peptic ulcer, and/or in patients with severe heart/liver/kidney problems.

LORNOXISTIN TABLET is not recommended for use in pregnant women especially in first 6 months and last 3 months of pregnancy. It is also not recommended for use in breastfeeding women unless it is clearly necessary. LORNOXISTIN TABLET is not recommended for use in children and adolescents (aged below 18 years) which is advised to be used with caution in elderly patients (aged 60 years and above) after consulting the doctor. The most common side effects of taking LORNOXISTIN TABLET are mild headache, dizziness, abdominal pain, upset stomach, nausea, vomiting, and/or diarrhea. Consult your doctor if any of these symptoms worsens.

How LORNOXISTIN TABLET Works

LORNOXISTIN TABLET provides relief from pain and inflammation from rheumatic diseases where Lornoxicam and Paracetamol works by blocking the production of certain chemical messengers in the body that cause inflammation and pain thus managing and providing relief from acute pain and inflammation caused by certain rheumatic diseases in affected individuals.

Take LORNOXISTIN TABLET as advised by your physician. Swallow the medicine with a glass of water. Do not crush or chew the medicine. Your doctor will decide the correct dose and duration for you depending upon your age, body weight and disease condition.

introduction:
Introduction About SUPPOL CHILD SUPPOSITORIES

SUPPOL CHILD SUPPOSITORIES contains Paracetamol which belongs to the group of medicines called Analgesics and Antipyretics. It is used to manage pain and fever (high temperature) in children (from 3 months to 12 years of age) who find it difficult to take the medicine orally.                  

Before administering SUPPOL CHILD SUPPOSITORIES to your child, inform the child’s doctor if your child has liver or kidney problems or any allergies. Do not give your child medicines containing alcohol. Consult your child’s doctor for advice.

SUPPOL CHILD SUPPOSITORIES is not recommended for use in elderly patients, pregnant and breastfeeding women as it is used only in children.

The most common side effect of using SUPPOL CHILD SUPPOSITORIES is redness or soreness in and around the back passage. Consult your child’s doctor if any of the side effects get worse.

Uses Of SUPPOL CHILD SUPPOSITORIES
Manage pain and fever in children (from 3 months to 12 years of age), who finds it difficult to take the medicine orally
mechanismOfAction:
How SUPPOL CHILD SUPPOSITORIES Works

SUPPOL CHILD SUPPOSITORIES relieves pain by increasing the pain threshold by inhibiting certain enzymes (COX-1 and COX-2) involved in the synthesis of chemicals responsible for inducing pain (prostaglandins). It reduces fever by directly acting on heat-regulating centers in the brain, resulting in vessel relaxation, sweating and loss of body heat.
usageDetails:
How to use SUPPOL CHILD SUPPOSITORIES

Administer SUPPOL CHILD SUPPOSITORIES to your child as advised by the physician. It is for rectal use only. Your child’s bowel needs to be empty when you administer it. Wash your hands and peel the wrapping apart. Do not break the medicine before use. Smoothly push into the back passage of the child with the pointed end first. Slightly warm it between your hands beforehand to make it easier. Tell your child to keep still for a minute or two and then clean your hands.

Your child’s doctor will decide the correct dose and duration for your child based on the child’s age, body weight and disease condition.

Introduction About HOSPIMOL 1000MG INFUSION

HOSPIMOL 1000MG INFUSION contains Paracetamol which belongs to the group of medicines called Analgesics and Antipyretics. It is used for short-term management of moderate pain (especially after surgery) and fever when administered by the intravenous route is clinically justified.

Before receiving HOSPIMOL 1000MG INFUSION, inform your doctor if you have heart, lung, liver or kidney problems or if you suffer from alcoholism or alcohol abuse, malnourishment and severely low blood volume due to dehydration or blood loss.

name: MEDICAM Injection 2ml
introduction:
Introduction About MEDICAM INJECTION

MEDICAM INJECTION contains Piroxicam, which belongs to the group of medicines called Non-Steroidal Anti-Inflammatory Drugs. It is used in the management of musculoskeletal disorders (injuries or disorders of muscle, ligaments, joints, and tendons characterised by pain, stiffness, swelling, and restricted movements), acute gout (a form of arthritis with severe pain, redness, and tenderness in joints), postoperative trauma pain (pain due to trauma after surgical intervention), and primary dysmenorrhea (sudden cramping pain in the lower abdomen occurring before or during menstruation).

MEDICAM INJECTION exerts its anti-inflammatory actions by inhibiting the enzyme cyclooxygenase-1, thereby, blocking the release of prostaglandins (a substance produced during injury and inflammation that causes pain and swelling) and other chemical mediators that cause pain and swelling. Your doctor may advise you to take relevant tests before recommending this medicine.

MEDICAM INJECTION is not recommended for use in patients with liver, kidney, or heart problems. MEDICAM INJECTION is not recommended for use by a pregnant or breastfeeding woman. It should be used with caution in children aged 12 years and older. The most common side effects by receiving this medicine are nausea (feeling sick), vomiting, and stomach pain. Contact your doctor if your symptom does not improve.

introduction:
Introduction About P U C 125MG SUSPENSION

P U C Suspension is an analgesic- antipyretic medicine used to reduce fever and manages teething pain, immunisation pain, headache, and earache. It contains paracetamol as an active ingredient.

Paracetamol reduces pain by blocking the production of certain chemicals in the brain called prostaglandins, which are responsible for pain and inflammation. It also reduces fever by acting on the hypothalamus (an area of the brain), that regulates the body temperature.

Always give P U C Suspension to your child exactly as advised by your doctor. Shake well before use. Administer drops onto your child’s tongue with the help of a dropper. Do not exceed the stated daily dose as it may lead to liver damage in your child. Before giving P U C Suspension let your child’s doctor knows if your child has liver or kidney diseases, fructose, or any other sugar intolerance. Do not give P U C Suspension to your child if he/she is allergic to paracetamol or taking any other medicines containing paracetamol.

name: UNO 125 TASTY PLUM GRANNY FLAVOURED KIDS Suspension 60ml
introduction:
Introduction About UNO 125 TASTY PLUM GRANNY FLAVOURED KIDS SUSPENSION

UNO 125 KIDS Suspension TASTY PLUM GRANNY FLAVOURED is used to manage mild to moderate pain, including headache, toothache, sore throat, aches and pains in children. It is also used for the reduction of fever and to be used as an adjunctive therapy to relieve symptoms of cold and flu. It contains Paracetamol as an active ingredient.

Paracetamol acts predominantly by inhibiting prostaglandin synthesis in the central nervous system (CNS) and, to a lesser extent, through a peripheral action by blocking pain impulse generation. The peripheral action may also be due to inhibition of prostaglandin synthesis or to inhibition of the synthesis or actions of other substances that sensitize pain receptors to mechanical or chemical stimulation. Paracetamol produces antipyresis by acting centrally on the hypothalamic heat regulating center to produce peripheral vaso-dilation resulting in increased blood flow through the skin, sweating and heat loss. The central action probably involves inhibition of prostaglandin synthesis in the hypothalamus.

Administer UNO 125 KIDS Suspension to your child as instructed by your doctor. Shake well before use. It is for oral administration only. Do not give this medicine to your child for more than 3 days without consulting your doctor. UNO 125 KIDS Suspension is not recommended for use in babies under 2 months old. Do not give more than 4 doses of UNO 125 KIDS Suspension in any 24 hour period.
sideEffectsDetails:
Side Effects Of UNO 125 TASTY PLUM GRANNY FLAVOURED KIDS SUSPENSION

Generally, UNO 125 KIDS Suspension does not cause any side effects. In case, if your child experience any unusual side effects, consult your doctor for advice.

name: Freenac SP Tablet 10'S
introduction:
Introduction About FREENAC SP TABLET

FREENAC SP TABLET is used to relieve inflammation and pain due to bone and soft tissue injuries in affected individuals. It is also used to reduce high temperatures and provide relief from cold (while sneezing) in affected individuals. This medicine is also indicated for use to resolve post-operative inflammation, oedema, and pain. It is also used to provide relief from illnesses such as headaches, moderate migraines, and musculoskeletal pain.

FREENAC SP TABLET is a combination of Aceclofenac, Paracetamol, and Serratiopeptidase, which belong to the group of medicines called Nonsteroidal anti-inflammatory agents, Analgesics and Antipyretics, and Proteolytic enzymes, respectively. It helps to reduce pain and inflammation by blocking certain chemical messengers in the brain, and it also promotes healing by breaking down abnormal proteins at the site of inflammation, thereby healing the infected site.

FREENAC SP TABLET is not recommended for use in patients allergic to Aceclofenac, Paracetamol, or Serratiopeptidase. It is also not recommended for use in patients with active or recurrent peptic ulcers or haemorrhages (bleeding), severe heart, liver, or kidney diseases. Before taking FREENAC SP TABLET, inform your doctor if you suffer from uncontrolled high blood pressure, diabetes, hyperlipidaemia (high-fat level in the blood), gastrointestinal diseases such as ulcerative colitis (inflammatory bowel disease), and/or aseptic meningitis (inflammation of the brain).

FREENAC SP TABLET is not recommended for use by pregnant and breastfeeding women. It is also not recommended for use in children and adolescents (below 18 years old). Consult your doctor before taking the medicine. The most common side effects of taking FREENAC SP TABLET are abdominal pain, nausea, vomiting, diarrhea, flatulence, constipation, indigestion, and/or dizziness. Consult and inform your doctor if any of these side effects get worse.

Nephrotoxicity (deterioration of the kidney due to drugs) includes interstitial nephritis (kidney disorder), nephritic syndrome (kidney disease marked by blood in urine), and renal failure
Abnormal liver function, an inflamed liver, and signs of jaundice such as yellowing of the eyes and skin

Neurological effects such as visual disturbances, optic neuritis (inflammation of the optic nerve of the eye), headaches, paraesthesia (abnormal sensation), and reports of aseptic meningitis (inflammation of the brain) are especially common in patients with existing autoimmune disorders, such as sle and mixed connective tissue disorders, with symptoms( such as stiff neck, headache, nausea, vomiting, fever or disorientation, depression, confusion, hallucinations, tinnitus, vertigo, dizziness, malaise, fatigue, and drowsiness)

Haematological effects such as thrombocytopenia (low platelet level), neutropenia (low white blood cell count), agranulocytosis (a condition marked by an inability to make white blood cells), aplastic anemia (bone marrow disorder), and hemolytic anemia (red blood cell count)

Signs of exfoliative and bullous dermatoses (autoimmune skin disorders), including epidermal necrolysis and erythema multiforme, such as lesions that crust over, areas of thickened skin, fever, and weakness

Skin rash with disease or fever

FREENAC SP TABLET is not recommended for use in patients with moderate and severe renal impairment. Consult your doctor before taking the medicine.

FREENAC SP TABLET should be used with caution with elderly patients. Consult your doctor before taking FREENAC SP TABLET.

Suffer from severe hypertension (high blood pressure)

Have diabetes
Are a smoker
Suffer from hyperlipidemia

Have bleeding disorders such as hemophilia, von Willebrand disease
Have signs of cerebrovascular bleeding, such as sudden, severe headaches or seizures
Are on diuretic therapy

introduction:
Introduction About KABIPARA INFUSION

KABIPARA INFUSION contains Paracetamol which belongs to the group of medicines called Analgesics and Antipyretics. It is used for short-term management of moderate pain (especially after surgery) and fever when administered by the intravenous route is clinically justified.

Before receiving KABIPARA INFUSION, inform your doctor if you have heart, lung, liver or kidney problems or if you suffer from alcoholism or alcohol abuse, malnourishment and severely low blood volume due to dehydration or blood loss.

KABIPARA INFUSION should be used with caution in pregnant and breastfeeding women only if clearly advised by the doctor. KABIPARA INFUSION should be used with caution in children and elderly patients.

The most common side effects of receiving KABIPARA INFUSION are nausea, vomiting, headache, sleep problems and itching. Inform your doctor if any of these side effect worsens.
uses: For short-term management of moderate pain (especially after surgery) and fever
usesDetails:
Uses Of KABIPARA INFUSION
For short-term management of moderate pain (especially after surgery) and fever
mechanismOfAction:
How KABIPARA INFUSION Works

KABIPARA INFUSION relieves pain by increasing the pain threshold by inhibiting certain enzymes (COX-1 and COX-2) involved in the synthesis of chemicals responsible for inducing pain (prostaglandins). It reduces fever by directly acting on heat-regulating centers in the brain, resulting in vessel relaxation, sweating and loss of body heat.
usageDetails:
How to use KABIPARA INFUSION

KABIPARA INFUSION will be given to you only by a doctor or a nurse into the vein as an intravenous infusion. Your doctor will decide the correct dose and duration for you based on your age, body weight and disease condition.
sideEffects: Serious allergic reaction or skin rash

Serious allergic reaction or skin rash

introduction:
Introduction About FREENAC P TABLET

FREENAC P TABLET is used for pain management associated with osteoarthritis, rheumatoid arthritis and ankylosing spondylitis. It can also be used to reduce pain caused due to sprains, strains, sports injuries, tendon pain, bone fracture pain and minor surgical and other pains. It is a combination of Aceclofenac + Paracetamol which are pain relieving agents.

Take FREENAC P TABLET after food to avoid gastric irritation. Do not take this medicine more than the duration recommended by your doctor. Before taking this medicine inform your doctor if you are having any liver, kidney or heart problems. You must also inform your doctor if you have stomach ulcers, gut inflammation, inflammatory bowel diseases or chronic alcoholism, or if you are pregnant or breastfeeding as a precaution.

The most common side effects of taking FREENAC P TABLET are indigestion, stomach pain, bloating and headache which can be managed by taking this medicine with meals and by following simple diet with less spicy food and limiting alcohol consumption.
