mechanismOfAction:
How FREENAC P TABLET Works

FREENAC P TABLET contains aceclofenac and paracetamol which works together to relieve pain and inflammation. Aceclofenac is a non-steroidal anti-inflammatory drug (NSAID) that blocks enzymes called cyclooxygenase (COX) enzymes, reducing the production of chemicals called prostaglandins, which are responsible for causing pain and inflammation.

Paracetamol, on the other hand, works by reducing the perception of pain in the brain and also helps lower fever by acting on the heat-regulating centers in the brain. Together, they provide stronger pain relief and reduce inflammation.

introduction:
Introduction About FREENAC TH TABLET

FREENAC TH TABLET is used in adults to manage painful inflammatory conditions associated with muscle spasms. It can also be used to manage pain associated with musculoskeletal (bone) disorders such as osteoarthritis, rheumatoid arthritis (inflammation of joints), or ankylosing spondylitis (back pain caused by inflammation of bones in the spine).

FREENAC TH TABLET is a combination of aceclofenac and thiocolchicoside, which belong to the group of medicines called Non-Steroidal Anti-inflammatory Drugs and Muscle relaxants, respectively. It works by blocking the production of certain chemicals that cause pain and inflammation in the body. It also relaxes the muscles by blocking the action of certain chemical messengers (GABA) in the brain that cause muscle spasm. As a result, FREENAC TH TABLET relieves painful muscle spasms associated with inflammatory disease conditions.

Before taking FREENAC TH TABLET, inform your doctor if you have any problems in your liver, liver, kidney, heart, or stomach. You should also inform your doctor if you have diabetes, high blood cholesterol, or fits.

Do not take FREENAC TH TABLET if you have asthma or varicella infection. Consult your doctor before taking FREENAC TH TABLET if you are pregnant, think you may be pregnant, or are breastfeeding.

Take FREENAC TH TABLET only as advised by your doctor. Do not take FREENAC TH TABLET longer than recommended by your doctor, as it may cause serious side effects. Avoid smoking and consumption of alcohol while undergoing therapy with FREENAC TH TABLET to achieve better results.

The most common side effects of taking FREENAC TH TABLET are dizziness, drowsiness, nausea, and stomach pain. Consult your doctor if any of these side effects worsen.

CIPMOL INFUSION contains Paracetamol which belongs to the group of medicines called Analgesics and Antipyretics. It is used for short-term management of moderate pain (especially after surgery) and fever when administered by the intravenous route is clinically justified.

Before receiving CIPMOL INFUSION, inform your doctor if you have heart, lung, liver or kidney problems or if you suffer from alcoholism or alcohol abuse, malnourishment and severely low blood volume due to dehydration or blood loss.

CIPMOL INFUSION should be used with caution in pregnant and breastfeeding women only if clearly advised by the doctor. CIPMOL INFUSION should be used with caution in children and elderly patients.

The most common side effects of receiving CIPMOL INFUSION are nausea, vomiting, headache, sleep problems and itching. Inform your doctor if any of these side effect worsens.

Others

Have anaemia

Have severe hypovolemia (low blood volume due to dehydration or blood loss)
Have chronic malnutrition

name: PARAVID DS STRAWBERRY FLAVOUR Suspension 60ml
introduction:
Introduction About PARAVID DS STRAWBERRY FLAVOUR SUSPENSION

PARAVID DS STRAWBERRY FLAVOUR SUSPENSION is used to relieve mild to moderate pain like headache, migraine, nerve pain, toothache, sore throat, period pains, teething, immunization, earache, and general aches and pains. It can also be used to manage fever (high temperature) and symptoms of the cold or flu.

It contains Paracetamol, which belongs to the group of medicines called Analgesics and Antipyretics. relieves pain by increasing the pain threshold by inhibiting certain enzymes (COX-1 and COX-2) involved in the synthesis of chemicals responsible for inducing pain (prostaglandins). It reduces fever by directly acting on heat-regulating centers in the brain, resulting in vessel relaxation, sweating, and loss of body heat.

Take PARAVID DS STRAWBERRY FLAVOUR SUSPENSION as advised by your physician. Shake well before use. Your doctor will decide the correct dose and duration for you based upon your age, body weight, and disease condition.

Before taking PARAVID DS STRAWBERRY FLAVOUR SUSPENSION, inform your doctor if you have liver or kidney problems, fructose intolerance, Gilberts syndrome, glucose-6-phosphate dehydrogenase deficiency, hemolytic anaemia, reduced glutathione levels, malnourishment, dehydration, or if you weigh less than 50 kg.

PARAVID DS STRAWBERRY FLAVOUR SUSPENSION should be used in pregnant women only if considered necessary. Avoid consumption of alcohol during management with PARAVID DS STRAWBERRY FLAVOUR SUSPENSION, as it might make you more susceptible to side effects.

PARAVID DS STRAWBERRY FLAVOUR SUSPENSION is not recommended for use in children (2–3 months old, weighing less than 4 kg, or born before 37 weeks). Contact your doctor if you have any side effects or if any of the symptoms get worse.

Are glucose-6-phosphate dehydrogenase deficient (enzyme deficiency)
Have haemolytic anaemia (decreased red blood cells, which can make the skin pale yellow and cause weakness or breathlessness)

A. Drug-Drug interactions:

Before receiving MEDOMOL INJECTION, inform your doctor if you are taking any of the following medicines:

Other medicines containing paracetamol or propacetamol
Probenecid (used to manage gout)
Medicines used for blood thinning (Ex. warfarin)

Overdosage:

MEDOMOL INJECTION will be administered to you only by a doctor or a nurse in a hospital and so it is unlikely to receive an overdose. However, consult your doctor if you experience any unusual symptoms such as nausea, vomiting, anorexia (eating disorder), paleness, stomach pain and a risk of liver injury.

introduction:
Introduction About SARIDON + TABLETS

Saridon + Tablet is used to manage mild to moderate headache. It contains paracetamol and caffeine as active ingredients that helps to provide relief from headache.

Paracetamol blocks the release of certain chemical substances in the brain called prostaglandins which are responsible for pain whereas caffeine blocks adenosine receptors that influences pain signalling.

Always take Saridon + Tablet exactly as advised by your doctor. Swallow the medicine as a whole with a glass of water and do not crush or chew the medicine. Do not exceed the recommended daily dosage. Do not take this medicine if you are allergic to any of its components.
